front: Define force.
back:
A force is a push or a pull that acts on
an object due to the interaction with
another object. Forces can cause
changes in speed, direction, or shape of
bodies.
frontZh: 定义力。
backZh: 力是由于物体与另一个物体相互作用而产生的推或拉。力可以使物体的速率、方向或形状发生改变。

front:
True or False?
Balanced forces produce a resultant
force.
back:
False.
Unbalanced forces produce a resultant
force.
frontZh: 判断正误：平衡力产生一个合力。
backZh: 错误。非平衡力会产生合力。

front: What is a resultant force?
back:
A resultant force is a single force that
represents the combined effect of all
forces acting on an object. It determines
both the direction and the magnitude
of the overall force experienced by the
object.
frontZh: 什么是合力？
backZh: 合力是一个单一的力， 表示作用在物体上的所有力的合成效果。 它决定物体所受总力的方向和大小。

front:
State the two possible outcomes when
forces combine.
back:
Forces can combine to produce either
balanced or unbalanced forces.
frontZh: 说明该两个可能的 outcomes 什么时候力 combine。
backZh: 多个力可以组合成平衡力或非平衡力。

front: Define balanced forces.
back:
Balanced forces occur when the forces
acting on an object are equal in
magnitude and opposite in direction,
resulting in no net force acting on the
object.
frontZh: 定义平衡力。
backZh: 当作用在物体上的力大小相等、方向相反时，力是平衡的，因此物体所受净力为零。

front: When do unbalanced forces occur?
back:
Unbalanced forces occur when the
forces acting on an object are unequal
in magnitude or not opposite in
direction, resulting in a net force that
causes the object to accelerate in the
direction of the net force.
frontZh: 什么时候非平衡力发生？
backZh: 非平衡力发生什么时候该 力作用在物体上是 不相等大小上或 不方向相反， 导致在 一个净力， 导致物体到 accelerate 在该 方向的 该净力。

front:
An object is travelling forward at a
constant speed in a straight line. A force
is applied perpendicular to the direction
of the object's motion. What is the
effect of the force on the object's
motion?
back:
If a force is applied perpendicularly to
the direction of an object's motion, the
object will change direction.
frontZh: 物体是 运动/传播向前以恒定速率沿直线。 一个力 是施加的垂直到 该方向的 物体's 运动。 什么是该 效应/影响的 该力 在物体's 运动？
backZh: If 一个力 是施加的 perpendicularly 到该 方向的 物体's 运动， 物体将会改变方向。

front:
An object is travelling forward at a
constant speed in a straight line. What
is the effect on the object's motion if a
forward acting force is applied?
back:
If a forward acting force is applied to an
object travelling at a constant speed in a
straight line, the object will speed up
(accelerate).
frontZh: 物体是 运动/传播向前以恒定速率沿直线。 什么是该 效应/影响在 物体's 运动 if 一个向前作用力 是施加的？
backZh: If 一个向前作用力 是施加的到 物体运动/传播以恒定速率沿直线， 物体将会加速 (accelerate)。

front:
True or False?
Newton's first law states that objects
will continue to move at the same
velocity even if a resultant force acts
on them.
back:
False.
Newton's first law states that objects
will continue to move at the same
velocity when there is no resultant
force acting on them.
frontZh: 判断正误：牛顿第一定律说明， 物体将会继续运动 at 该相同速度 even if 一个合力作用在 它们。
backZh: 错误。 牛顿第一定律说明， 物体将会继续运动 at 该相同速度什么时候有 没有合力作用在 它们。

front:
What is the effect of a zero resultant
force on an object's motion?
back:
The effect of a zero resultant force on
the motion of an object is that the
object will:
remain stationary if it is at rest
continue to move with the same
velocity if it is already moving
frontZh: 什么是该效应/影响的 一个合力为零在 物体's 运动？
backZh: 该效应/影响的 一个合力为零在 该运动的 物体是， 物体将会： 保持静止 if 它是 静止继续运动与该 相同速度 if 它是 已经在运动

front:
How is Newton's first law applied to
objects with constant velocity?
back:
Newton's first law states that objects
with constant velocity will experience no
change in their motion unless a
resultant force is applied.
frontZh: ……如何牛顿第一定律施加的到 物体与恒定速度？
backZh: 牛顿第一定律说明， 物体与恒定速度将会经历/受到 no 变化在 它们的运动 unless 一个合力是 施加的。

front: Define constant velocity.
back:
Constant velocity refers to motion at a
steady speed and in a straight line.
frontZh: 定义恒定速度。
backZh: 恒定速度指物体以稳定速率沿直线运动。

front:
In what situation does an object
experience no resultant force?
back:
The situation when an object
experiences no resultant force when
the forces acting on it are balanced,
meaning the net force is zero.
frontZh: 在什么情况下做/会物体经历/受到没有合力？
backZh: 该 situation 什么时候物体 experiences 没有合力什么时候该 力作用在 它是 平衡的， 含义该 净力是 零。

front:
What is the value of the frictional force
on a car moving at a constant velocity
with no external forces acting on it?
back:
The value of the frictional force is equal
to the driving force, as both forces are
balanced when the car moves at a
constant velocity.
frontZh: 什么是该数值的 该摩擦力在 一个 car 运动以恒定速度与 no external 力作用在 它？
backZh: 该数值的 该摩擦力是 相等到 该驱动力， 因为两个力是平衡的什么时候该 car 移动以恒定速度。

front: State Newton's first law of motion.
back:
Newton's first law of motion states that:
objects will remain at rest, or move with
a constant velocity unless acted on by a
resultant force.
frontZh: 说明牛顿第一运动定律。
backZh: 牛顿第一运动定律说明，： 物体将会 remain 静止， 或移动与一个恒定速度 unless acted 在由一个合力。

front:
When a non-zero resultant force is
applied to an object, what are the two
possible changes in the object's
motion?
back:
When a non-zero force acts on an
object, the object can:
change its speed
change its direction
frontZh: 什么时候一个 non-合力为零是 施加的到 物体， 什么是该 两个可能的变化在 物体's 运动？
backZh: 什么时候一个 non-零力 作用在物体上， 物体可以： 改变其速率改变其方向

front:
Define Newton's second law of
motion.
back:
Newton's second law of motion states
that the acceleration of an object is
proportional to the resultant force
acting on it and inversely proportional
to the object's mass.
frontZh: 定义牛顿第二运动定律。
backZh: 牛顿第二运动定律说明， 该加速度的 物体是 成比例到 该合力作用在 它和 与……成反比物体's 质量。

front:
True or False?
Newton's second law states that
acceleration is directly proportional to
the object's mass. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
False.
Newton's second law states that
acceleration is directly proportional to
the object's resultant force, and
inversely proportional to its mass.
frontZh: 判断正误：牛顿第二定律说明， 加速度与……成正比： 物体's 质量。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 牛顿第二定律说明， 加速度与……成正比： 物体's 合力， 和与……成反比它的质量。

front:
How does Newton's second law build
on Newton's first law ?
back:
Newton's first law states that an object's
motion will change if acted upon by a
resultant force, and Newton's second
law describes that change in motion.
frontZh: ……如何牛顿第二定律 build 在牛顿第一定律？
backZh: 牛顿第一定律说明， 物体's 运动将会变化 if acted upon 由一个合力， 和牛顿第二定律 describes， 运动的变化。

front:
What is the equation for Newton's
second law? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The equation for Newton's second law
is F = ma
Where:
F = resultant force, measured in
Newtons (N)
m = mass, measured in kilograms
(kg)
a = acceleration, measured in
metres per second squared (m/s2)
frontZh: 公式是什么？ 牛顿第二定律？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: ……的公式为牛顿第二定律是 F = ma 其中： F = 合力， 单位为牛顿 (N) m = 质量， 单位为千克 (kg) 一个 = 加速度， 单位为米每二次方秒 (m/s²)

front:
True or False?
In the equation F = ma , the force and
acceleration act in opposite directions.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
False.
In the equation F = ma , the force and
acceleration act in the same direction.
frontZh: 判断正误：在公式中 F = ma， 力和加速度作用方向相反。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 在公式中 F = ma， 力和加速度作用方向相同。

front:
State the relationship between mass
and acceleration according to
Newton's second law. (Extended Tier
Only) experience smaller accelerations for the
back:
According to Newton's second law,
acceleration is inversely proportional
to mass, meaning a larger mass will
same applied force.
frontZh: 说明该 关系在……之间质量和 加速度根据到 牛顿第二定律。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 根据到 牛顿第二定律， 加速度与……成反比： 质量， 含义一个更大质量将会经历/受到更小 accelerations 对于/为了该 相同施加的力。

front:
According to Newton's second law,
increasing the resultant force acting on
an object will have what effect on its
acceleration? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
According to Newton's second law,
increasing the resultant force acting on
an object will increase the acceleration
of the object by the same factor.
frontZh: 根据到 牛顿第二定律， 增大该 合力作用在物体上将会有 什么效应/影响在 它的加速度？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 根据到 牛顿第二定律， 增大该 合力作用在物体上将会增大该 加速度的 物体由该 相同因素。

front:
True or False?
According to Newton's second law, the
acceleration of an object is inversely
proportional to its mass. (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
True.
According to Newton's second law, the
acceleration of an object is inversely
proportional to its mass.
frontZh: 判断正误：根据到 牛顿第二定律， 该加速度的 物体与……成反比： 它的质量。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 根据到 牛顿第二定律， 该加速度的 物体与……成反比： 它的质量。

front:
Define Hooke's Law. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
Hooke’s law states that the extension
of a spring is proportional to the applied
force.
frontZh: 定义胡克定律。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: Hooke’s 定律说明， 该伸长量的 一个弹簧是 成比例到 该施加的力。

front:
What is the equation for Hooke's law?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
The equation for Hooke's law is F = kx
Where:
F = force applied, measured in
newtons (N)
k = spring constant, measured in
newtons per kilogram (N/m)
x = extension of the spring,
measured in metres (m)
frontZh: 公式是什么？ 胡克定律？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: ……的公式为胡克定律是 F = kx 其中： F = 施加的力， 单位为牛顿 (N) k = 弹簧常数， 单位为牛顿 per 千克 (N/m) x = 伸长量的 该弹簧， 单位为米 (m)

front:
True or False?
Hooke's Law states that the extension
of a spring is inversely proportional to
the applied force. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
False.
Hooke's Law states that the extension
of a spring is directly proportional to
the applied force.
frontZh: 判断正误：胡克定律说明， 该伸长量的 一个弹簧与……成反比： 该施加的力。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 胡克定律说明， 该伸长量的 一个弹簧与……成正比： 该施加的力。

front:
What does Hooke's Law describe?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
Hooke's Law describes the relationship
between the extension of a spring and
the applied force, stating that they are
proportional.
frontZh: 表示什么胡克定律描述？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 胡克定律 describes 该关系在……之间该 伸长量的 一个弹簧和 该施加的力， stating， 它们是 成比例。

front:
What is the spring constant in Hooke's
Law? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The spring constant (k) is the force per
unit extension and measures how stiff
the spring is.
frontZh: 什么是该 弹簧常数在 胡克定律？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该弹簧常数 (k) 是单位……上的力： 伸长量和 measures 如何 stiff 该弹簧是。

front:
True or False?
The spring constant (k) has units of
N/kg. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
False.
The spring constant (k) has units of
N/m.
frontZh: 判断正误：该弹簧常数 (k) 有单位的 N/kg。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 该弹簧常数 (k) 有单位的 N/m。

front:
What does the elastic limit represent
in Hooke's Law? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The elastic limit represents the point
beyond which an object will no longer
return to its original length when
stretched, violating Hooke's Law.
frontZh: 表示什么该 弹性的极限表示在 胡克定律？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该弹性的极限表示该 点 beyond 哪一个物体将会 no 更长 return 到它的 original 长度什么时候 stretched， violating 胡克定律。

front:
What does the green arrow represent
on this force-extension graph?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
The green arrow shows the linear
portion of the graph. This is the section
that obeys Hooke's law, where force
and extension are directly
proportional.
frontZh: 表示什么该 green 箭头表示在 这力-伸长量图像？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该 green 箭头显示该 linear portion 的该 图像。 这是 该 section， obeys 胡克定律， 其中力 和伸长量是 正比地成比例。

front:
What does the green arrow represent
on this force-extension graph?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
The green arrow shows the non-linear
section of the graph where Hooke's law
is not obeyed. Force and extension are
no longer proportional.
frontZh: 表示什么该 green 箭头表示在 这力-伸长量图像？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该 green 箭头显示该 non-linear section 的该 图像其中胡克定律是 不 obeyed。 力和 伸长量是 no 更长成比例。

front:
What does the red cross represent on
this force-extension graph? (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
The red cross represents the limit of
proportionality. Beyond this point, force
and extension are no longer directly
proportional.
frontZh: 表示什么该 red 交叉/横截面表示在 这力-伸长量图像？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该 red 交叉/横截面表示该 比例极限。 Beyond 这点， 力和 伸长量是 no 更长正比地成比例。

front:
Define circular motion. (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
Circular motion is the movement of an
object along a circular path, where the
object's velocity is constantly changing
due to the change in direction.
frontZh: 定义圆周的运动。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 圆周的运动是 该 movement 的物体 along 一个圆周的 path， 其中物体's 速度是 constantly 变化的由于该 变化在 方向。

front:
True or False?
In circular motion, an object's speed
and velocity remain constant.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
False.
In circular motion, an object's speed
may be constant, but its velocity is
constantly changing due to the change
in direction.
frontZh: 判断正误：在圆周的运动， 物体's 速率和 速度 remain 恒定。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 在圆周的运动， 物体's 速率 may 是恒定， 但是它的速度是 constantly 变化的由于该 变化在 方向。

front:
What happens to an object's velocity in
circular motion? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
In circular motion, an object's velocity is
always changing as it moves along the
circular path.
frontZh: 什么发生到 物体's 速度在 圆周的运动？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 在圆周的运动， 物体's 速度是 总是变化的 as 它移动 along 该圆周的 path。

front:
How does a force cause an object to
change direction in circular motion?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
A force causes an object to change
direction in circular motion when it acts
at 90 degrees to the direction of travel.
frontZh: ……如何一个力 导致物体到 改变方向在 圆周的运动？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 一个力 导致物体到 改变方向在 圆周的运动什么时候它 作用 at 90 度到 该方向的 传播。

front:
What factors determine the force
needed to maintain circular motion?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
The factors that determine the force
needed to maintain circular motion
depend on the mass of the object, the
speed of the object, and the radius of
the circular path.
frontZh: 什么因素决定该 力需要到 maintain 圆周的运动？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该因素， 决定该 力需要到 maintain 圆周的运动 depend 在该 质量的 物体， 该速率的 物体， 和该 半径的 该圆周的 path。

front:
True or False?
A smaller radius of the circular path
requires a smaller force to maintain
circular motion at constant speed.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
False.
A smaller radius requires a greater
force to maintain constant speed in
circular motion.
frontZh: 判断正误：一个更小半径的 该圆周的 path 需要一个更小力 到 maintain 圆周的运动 at 恒定速率。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 一个更小半径需要一个更大力 到 maintain 恒定速率在 圆周的运动。

front:
True or False?
Velocity is defined as the rate of
change of displacement. (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
True.
Velocity is defined as the rate of
change of displacement.
frontZh: 判断正误：速度定义为该 率的 变化的 位移。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 速度定义为该 率的 变化的 位移。

front:
What two factors are affected by the
size of the radius of an object in
circular motion? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The two factors that are affected by the
size of the radius of an object in circular
motion are how large the circular path
is and the force required to maintain
the motion.
frontZh: 哪两个因素是 affected 由该 大小的 该半径的 物体在 圆周的运动？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该两个因素， 是 affected 由该 大小的 该半径的 物体在 圆周的运动是 如何大 该圆周的 path 是和 该力 required 到 maintain 该运动。

front:
True or False?
A satellite orbiting a planet is an
example of circular motion.
back:
True.
A satellite orbiting a planet is an
example of circular motion.
frontZh: 判断正误：一个卫星 orbiting 一个行星是 一个例子的 圆周的运动。
backZh: 正确。 一个卫星 orbiting 一个行星是 一个例子的 圆周的运动。

front:
True or False?
The speed of an object in circular
motion will increase if the force is
increased providing that the mass and
radius remain constant.
back:
True.
The speed of an object in circular
motion will increase if the force is
increased providing that the mass and
radius remain constant.
frontZh: 判断正误：该速率的 物体在 圆周的运动将会增大 if 该力 是增大 providing， 该质量和 半径 remain 恒定。
backZh: 正确。 该速率的 物体在 圆周的运动将会增大 if 该力 是增大 providing， 该质量和 半径 remain 恒定。

front:
True or False?
The radius of an object in circular
motion will increase if the force is
increased providing that the mass and
speed remain constant.
back:
False.
The radius of an object in circular
motion will decrease if the force is
increased providing that the mass and
speed remain constant.
frontZh: 判断正误：该半径的 物体在 圆周的运动将会增大 if 该力 是增大 providing， 该质量和 速率 remain 恒定。
backZh: 错误。 该半径的 物体在 圆周的运动将会减小 if 该力 是增大 providing， 该质量和 速率 remain 恒定。

front:
True or False?
For an object in circular motion, an
increased mass requires an increased
force to keep the speed and radius
constant.
back:
True.
For an object in circular motion, an
increased mass requires an increased
force to keep the speed and radius
constant.
frontZh: 判断正误：对于/为了物体在 圆周的运动， 一个增大质量需要一个增大力 到 keep 该速率和 半径恒定。
backZh: 正确。 对于/为了物体在 圆周的运动， 一个增大质量需要一个增大力 到 keep 该速率和 半径恒定。

front: Define friction.
back:
Friction is the force between two
surfaces that impedes motion and
produces heating.
frontZh: 定义摩擦。
backZh: 摩擦是 该力 在……之间两个表面， impedes 运动和 产生加热。

front:
True or False?
Friction speeds up the motion of an
object.
back:
False.
Friction opposes the motion of an
object, slowing it down.
frontZh: 判断正误：摩擦 speeds 向上该 运动的 物体。
backZh: 错误。 摩擦 opposes 该运动的 物体， slowing 它向下。

front:
True or False?
Friction increases the temperature of
an object.
back:
True.
Friction causes heating, which raises the

frontZh: 什么是该差异/差值在……之间速率和 速度？
backZh: 该差异/差值在……之间速率和 速度是， 速率是 一个标量， 当……时速度是 一个矢量 as 它 includes 方向。

front:
How do you calculate the total distance
from the average speed?
back:
The total distance is calculated from the
average speed by multiplying the
average speed by the total time taken.
frontZh: ……如何你 计算该 总距离从 该平均速率？
backZh: 该总 距离是 计算出的从 该平均速率由 multiplying 该平均速率由该 总所用时间。

front:
What is acceleration? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
Acceleration is the rate of change of
velocity.
frontZh: 什么是加速度？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 加速度是……变化率： 速度。

front:
True or False?
Acceleration measures the rate of
change of velocity. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
True.
Acceleration measures the rate of
change of velocity.
frontZh: 判断正误：加速度 measures 该率 的变化的 速度。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 加速度 measures 该率 的变化的 速度。

front:
State the equation for calculating
average acceleration. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
The equation for average acceleration is
a = ∆ v
∆ t
Where:
a = acceleration in metres per
second squared (m/s2)
∆ v = change in velocity in metres
per second (m/s)
∆ t = time taken in seconds (s)
frontZh: 写出计算……的公式： average 加速度。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: ……的公式为 average 加速度是 一个 = ∆v ∆t 其中： 一个 = 加速度在 米每二次方秒 (m/s ) ∆v = 变化在 速度在 米每秒 (m/s) ∆t = 所用时间在 秒 (s) 2

front:
What units are used to measure
acceleration? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
Acceleration is measured in metres per
second squared (m/s2).
frontZh: 什么单位用于测量加速度？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 加速度的单位是米每二次方秒 (m/s²)。

front:
How can you find the change in
velocity? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
You can find the change in velocity by
obtaining the difference between final
and initial velocity.
frontZh: 怎样可以你 找到/求出该 变化在 速度？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 你可以找到/求出该 变化在 速度由 obtaining 该差异/差值在……之间 final 和 initial 速度。

front:
What does a positive acceleration
indicate? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
A positive acceleration indicates that
the object is speeding up.
frontZh: 表示什么一个正 加速度 indicate？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 一个正 加速度表示， 物体是 speeding 向上。

front:
Define acceleration. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
Acceleration is the change in an object's
velocity over time.
frontZh: 定义加速度。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 加速度是 该变化在 物体's 速度在……上/超过时间。

front:
What does a negative acceleration
indicate? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
Negative acceleration indicates that the
object is slowing down.
frontZh: 表示什么一个负 加速度 indicate？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 负加速度表示， 物体是 slowing 向下。

front:
Define deceleration. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
Deceleration is negative acceleration,
it shows an object is slowing down.
frontZh: 定义减速度。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 减速度是 负加速度， 它显示物体是 slowing 向下。

front:
What is the acceleration of an object
with constant velocity? (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
The acceleration of an object with
constant velocity is zero.
frontZh: 什么是该 加速度的 物体与恒定速度？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该加速度的 物体与恒定速度是 零。

front:
How do you calculate acceleration from
a velocity-time graph? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
Acceleration is calculated as the
gradient of a velocity-time graph.
frontZh: ……如何你 计算加速度从 一个速度-时间图像？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 加速度是 计算出的 as 该斜率的 一个速度-时间图像。

front:
How is direction represented in a
numerical value for acceleration?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
The direction of acceleration is
represented by a positive or negative
value.
frontZh: ……如何方向表示为在 一个 numerical 数值对于/为了加速度？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该方向的 加速度是 表示为由一个正 或负 数值。

front:
Which type of graph shows the distance
travelled by a moving object over a
period of time?
back:
A distance-time graph shows the
distance travelled by a moving object
over a period of time.
frontZh: 哪一个类型的 图像显示该 通过的距离由一个运动物体在……上/超过一个周期的 时间？
backZh: 一个距离-时间图像显示该 通过的距离由一个运动物体在……上/超过一个周期的 时间。

front:
How is constant speed represented on
a distance-time graph?
back:
On a distance time graph, constant
speed is represented by a straight line:
a steeper slope shows a greater
constant speed
a shallower slope shows a lower
constant speed
a flat, horizontal line shows a
constant speed of zero
frontZh: ……如何恒定速率表示为在 一个距离-时间图像？
backZh: 在一个距离时间图像， 恒定速率是 表示为由一个直 线： 一个 steeper 斜率显示一个更大恒定速率一个 shallower 斜率显示一个更低恒定速率一个平的， 水平线 显示一个恒定速率的 零

front:
How is changing speed represented on
a distance-time graph?
back:
On a distance-time graph, changing
speed is represented by a curved line.
frontZh: ……如何变化的速率表示为在 一个距离-时间图像？
backZh: 在一个距离-时间图像， 变化的速率是 表示为由一个弯曲线。

front:
State the equation used to find the
gradient of a distance-time graph.
back:
The equation used to find the gradient
of a distance-time graph is
speed = gradient = ∆ y
∆ x
Where:
∆ y = change in distance
∆ x = change in time
frontZh: 说明该公式用于找到/求出该 斜率的 一个距离-时间图像。
backZh: 该公式用于找到/求出该 斜率的 一个距离-时间图像是 速率 = 斜率 = ∆y ∆x 其中： ∆y = 变化在 距离 ∆x = 变化在 时间

front:
Which line on the distance-time graph
shows the slowest speed?
back:
On a distance-time graph, the line with
the smallest gradient has the slowest
speed. This is the shallowest line (the
orange line).
frontZh: 哪一个线 在该 距离-时间图像显示该 slowest 速率？
backZh: 在一个距离-时间图像， 该线 与该 smallest 斜率有 该 slowest 速率。 这是 该 shallowest 线 (该 orange 线)。

front:
True or False?
This distance-time graph shows a
stationary object.
back:
True.
A flat, horizontal line on a distance-time
graph shows that the object is
stationary. The distance the object has
travelled is not changing with time.
frontZh: 判断正误：这距离-时间图像显示一个静止物体。
backZh: 正确。 一个平的， 水平线 在一个距离-时间图像显示， 物体是 静止。 该距离物体有 通过是 不变化的与时间。

front:
Describe the motion of the object
shown in this distance-time graph.
back:
The object in this distance-time graph
has an increasing speed. The distance
it travels in each interval of time is
increasing; therefore, the line curves
upward.
frontZh: 描述该 运动的 物体显示的在 这距离-时间图像。
backZh: 物体在 这距离-时间图像有 一个增大速率。 该距离它 传播在 每个 interval 的时间是 增大； 因此， 该线 curves upward。

front: What does a speed-time graph show?
back:
A speed-time graph shows how the
speed of a moving object varies with
time.
frontZh: 表示什么一个速率-时间图像 show？
backZh: 一个速率-时间图像显示如何该 速率的 一个运动物体 varies 与时间。

front:
What is constant acceleration on a
speed-time graph?
back:
Constant acceleration on a speed-time
graph is represented by a straight,
sloping line.
frontZh: 什么是恒定加速度在 一个速率-时间图像？
backZh: 恒定加速度在 一个速率-时间图像是 表示为由一个直， sloping 线。

front:
True or False?
A gentle slope on a speed-time graph
represents large acceleration.
back:
False.
A gentle slope on a speed-time graph
represents a small acceleration.
frontZh: 判断正误：一个 gentle 斜率在 一个速率-时间图像表示大 加速度。
backZh: 错误。 一个 gentle 斜率在 一个速率-时间图像表示一个小 加速度。

front:
Describe the motion shown in this
speed-time graph.
back:
The speed-time graph shows
decreasing acceleration.
The change in speed per unit time
decreases.
frontZh: 描述该 运动显示的在 这速率-时间图像。
backZh: 该速率-时间图像显示 decreasing 加速度。 该变化在 速率每单位时间减小。

front:
What does a flat , horizontal line
represent on a speed-time graph?
back:
A flat, horizontal line indicates that the
acceleration is zero, meaning the
object is moving at a constant speed.
frontZh: 表示什么一个平的， 水平线 表示在 一个速率-时间图像？
backZh: 一个平的， 水平线 表示， 该加速度是 零， 含义物体是 运动以恒定速率。

front:
What does the area under a speed-time
graph represent?
back:
The area under a speed-time graph
represents the distance travelled by
the object.
frontZh: 表示什么该 面积在……下一个速率-时间图像表示？
backZh: 该面积在……下一个速率-时间图像表示该 通过的距离由物体。

front:
How do you calculate the total area
under a speed-time graph?
back:
The total area under a speed-time
graph shows the total distance
travelled. The total area is the sum of
the areas of each enclosed section
(triangle or rectangle).
frontZh: ……如何你 计算该 总面积在……下一个速率-时间图像？
backZh: 该总 面积在……下一个速率-时间图像显示该 总通过的距离。 该总 面积是 该 sum 的该 areas 的每个 enclosed section (triangle 或 rectangle)。

front:
What is the formula to calculate the
area of a triangle?
back:
The formula to calculate the area of a
triangle is A = 1 × b × h
Where:
b = base of triangle, measured in
metres (m) or centimetres (cm)
h = height of triangle, measured in
metres (m) or centimetres (cm)
frontZh: 什么是该公式到 计算该 面积的 一个 triangle？
backZh: 该公式到 计算该 面积的 一个 triangle 是一个 = 1 2 × b × h 其中： b = 底部/基底的 triangle， 单位为米 (m) 或厘米 (cm) h = 高度的 triangle， 单位为米 (m) 或厘米 (cm)

front:
What is the formula to calculate the
area of a rectangle?
back:
The formula to calculate the area of a
rectangle is A = b × h
Where:
b = base of rectangle, measured in
metres (m) or centimetres (cm)
h = height of rectangle, measured
in metres (m) or centimetres (cm)
frontZh: 什么是该公式到 计算该 面积的 一个 rectangle？
backZh: 该公式到 计算该 面积的 一个 rectangle 是一个 = b × h 其中： b = 底部/基底的 rectangle， 单位为米 (m) 或厘米 (cm) h = 高度的 rectangle， 单位为米 (m) 或厘米 (cm)

front:
What shape does the area beneath a
speed-time graph form for an object
with constant speed?
back:
The area under a speed-time graph
forms a rectangle.
frontZh: 什么形状做/会该 面积 beneath 一个速率-时间图像形式对于/为了物体与恒定速率？
backZh: 该面积在……下一个速率-时间图像形式一个 rectangle。

front:
True or False?
A flat line on a speed-time graph
indicates constant acceleration.
back:
False.
A flat line on a speed-time graph
indicates constant speed.
frontZh: 判断正误：一个平的线 在一个速率-时间图像表示恒定加速度。
backZh: 错误。 一个平的线 在一个速率-时间图像表示恒定速率。

front:
True or False?
The starting speed of this object is zero.
back:
False.
The starting speed is not zero because
the line does not start from the origin.
frontZh: 判断正误：该 starting 速率的 这物体是 零。
backZh: 错误。 该 starting 速率是 不零 因为该 线做/会不 start 从该 origin。

front: Define acceleration of free fall.
back:
Acceleration of free fall is the constant
rate at which all objects fall in the
absence of air resistance, typically
denoted by the symbol g and equal to
approximately 9.81 m/s2 near the
surface of the Earth.
frontZh: 定义加速度的 自由落体。
backZh: 加速度的 自由落体是 该恒定率 at 哪一个所有物体 fall 在该 absence 的空气阻力， 通常表示为由该 符号 g 和相等到 大约 9。81 m/s² near 该表面的 该地球。

front:
True or False?
All objects fall with the same
acceleration in the presence of air
resistance.
back:
False.
In the presence of air resistance
different objects fall at different
accelerations and not at g. In most
Physics questions we assume that air
resistance is negligible.
frontZh: 判断正误：所有物体 fall 与该 相同加速度在 该 presence 的空气阻力。
backZh: 错误。 在该 presence 的空气阻力不同物体 fall at 不同 accelerations 和不 at g。 在大多数 Physics questions we assume， 空气阻力是 negligible。

front:
What is the value of the constant
acceleration of free fall?
back:
The value of the acceleration of free fall
is g = 9.81m/s2
frontZh: 什么是该数值的 该恒定加速度的 自由落体？
backZh: 该数值的 该加速度的 自由落体是 g = 9。81m/s2

front:
True or False?
Acceleration of free fall remains
constant regardless of an object's
mass.
back:
True.
Acceleration of free fall remains
constant regardless of an object's mass.
frontZh: 判断正误：加速度的 自由落体保持恒定 regardless 的物体's 质量。
backZh: 正确。 加速度的 自由落体保持恒定 regardless 的物体's 质量。

front:
Define terminal velocity. (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
Terminal velocity is the constant speed
reached by a falling object when the
upward force of drag equals the
downward force of weight, resulting in
zero acceleration.
frontZh: 定义终端速度。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 终端速度是 该恒定速率 reached 由一个下落物体什么时候该 upward 力的 drag equals 该 downward 力的 重量， 导致在 零加速度。

front: What is the equation for weight?
back:
The equation for weight is W = mg
Where:
W = weight measured in newtons
(N)
m = mass measured in kilograms
(kg)
g = acceleration of freefall (m/s2)
frontZh: 什么是……的公式为重量？
backZh: ……的公式为重量是 W = mg 其中： W= 重量单位为牛顿 (N) m = 质量单位为千克 (kg) g = 加速度的 freefall (m/s ) 2

front: Define air resistance.
back:
Air resistance is the frictional force
exerted by air particles on objects
moving through air, which opposes the
direction of motion.
frontZh: 定义空气阻力。
backZh: 空气阻力是 该摩擦力 exerted 由空气粒子在 物体运动通过空气， 哪一个 opposes 该方向的 运动。

front:
How does air resistance affect the
motion of falling objects? (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
Air resistance opposes the motion of
objects falling through air, exerting an
upward force that increases with the
object's speed.
frontZh: ……如何空气阻力影响该 运动的 下落物体？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 空气阻力 opposes 该运动的 物体下落通过空气， exerting 一个 upward 力， 增大与物体's 速率。

front:
True or False?
Air resistance decreases as the speed of
a falling object increases. (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
False.
Air resistance increases as the speed of
a falling object increases.
frontZh: 判断正误：空气阻力减小 as 该速率的 一个下落物体增大。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 空气阻力增大 as 该速率的 一个下落物体增大。

front:
What is the relationship between the
forces of weight and air resistance
during free fall? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
During free fall, weight acts
downwards while air resistance acts
upwards. As the speed of the object
increases, air resistance increases until
it equals the weight and terminal
velocity is reached.
frontZh: 什么是该 关系在……之间该 力的 重量和 空气阻力在……期间自由落体？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 在……期间自由落体， 重量作用 downwards 当……时空气阻力作用 upwards。 As 该速率的 物体增大， 空气阻力增大 until 它 equals 该重量和 终端速度是 reached。

front:
How does terminal velocity affect the
acceleration of a falling object?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
Terminal velocity occurs when the
acceleration of a falling object
becomes zero because the upward drag
force equals the downward force of
weight, resulting in a constant speed.
frontZh: ……如何终端速度影响该 加速度的 一个下落物体？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 终端速度发生什么时候该 加速度的 一个下落物体 becomes 零因为该 upward 阻力 equals 该 downward 力的 重量， 导致在 一个恒定速率。

front:
True or False?
Air resistance remains constant during
the fall of a skydiver. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
False.
The air resistance changes with speed
during the fall of a skydiver.
frontZh: 判断正误：空气阻力保持恒定在……期间该 fall 的一个 skydiver。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 该空气阻力变化与速率在……期间该 fall 的一个 skydiver。

front:
What factors affect the acceleration of
freefall? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The acceleration of free fall is affected
by the gravitational field strength . It
is independent of the mass of the falling
object.
frontZh: 什么因素影响该 加速度的 freefall？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该加速度的 自由落体是 affected 由该 重力场强。 它是 independent 的该 质量的 该下落物体。

front: Define weight.
back:
Weight is the gravitational force exerted
on an object with mass.
frontZh: 定义重量。
backZh: 重量是 该重力的力 exerted 在物体与质量。

subtopicFull: T1.8 — physical quantities and measurement techniques
front: What is a ruler?
back:
A ruler is a device used to measure
small distances of a few centimetres.
frontZh: 什么是一个直尺？
backZh: 一个直尺是 一个装置用于测量小 distances 的一个 few 厘米。

subtopicFull: T1.8 — physical quantities and measurement techniques
front:
True or False?
Rulers measure to the nearest
millimetre.
back:
True.
Rulers measure to the nearest
millimetre.
frontZh: 判断正误：Rulers 测量到 该最接近的毫米。
backZh: 正确。 Rulers 测量到 该最接近的毫米。

subtopicFull: T1.8 — physical quantities and measurement techniques
front: What is the purpose of a tape measure?
back:
A tape measure is appropriate for
measuring distances of a few metres.
frontZh: 什么是该目的 一个卷尺？
backZh: 一个卷尺是 appropriate 对于/为了 measuring distances 的一个 few 米。

subtopicFull: T1.8 — physical quantities and measurement techniques
front:
Which device can be used to measure
distances of up to a kilometre?
back:
A trundle wheel is used to measure
large distances up to a kilometre.
frontZh: 哪种装置可用于测量 distances 的向上到 一个千米？
backZh: 一个测距轮用于测量大 distances 向上到 一个千米。

subtopicFull: T1.8 — physical quantities and measurement techniques
front: What is a measuring cylinder?
back:
A measuring cylinder is a device used to
measure the volume of liquids.
frontZh: 什么是一个量筒？
backZh: 一个量筒是 一个装置用于测量该 体积的 液体。

subtopicFull: T1.8 — physical quantities and measurement techniques
front:
What device can be used to measure
time intervals?
back:
A stopwatch can be used to measure
time intervals.
frontZh: 什么装置可用于测量时间 intervals？
backZh: 一个秒表可用于测量时间 intervals。

subtopicFull: T1.8 — physical quantities and measurement techniques
front: Define the term reaction time.
back:
Reaction time is how long it takes
someone to react to an event.
frontZh: 定义该术语反应时间。
backZh: 反应时间是 如何长 它需要/花费 someone 到 react 到一个 event。

subtopicFull: T1.8 — physical quantities and measurement techniques
front:
True or False?
Human reaction time has more of an
impact on short-time measurements
than long-time measurements.
back:
True.
Human reaction time has more of an
impact on short-time measurements
than long-time measurements.
frontZh: 判断正误：Human 反应时间有 更多的 一个 impact 在短-时间 measurements 比长-时间 measurements。
backZh: 正确。 Human 反应时间有 更多的 一个 impact 在短-时间 measurements 比长-时间 measurements。

subtopicFull: T1.8 — physical quantities and measurement techniques
front:
State the equation for calculating an
average.
back:
The equation for calculating an average
is average = total value
number of values
frontZh: 说明……的公式为计算一个 average。
backZh: ……的公式为计算一个 average 是 average = 总数值数量/数目的 values

subtopicFull: T1.8 — physical quantities and measurement techniques
front:
What is the purpose of taking multiple
readings in Physics?
back:
The purpose of taking multiple readings
in Physics is to obtain an accurate
measurement value.
frontZh: 什么是该目的 taking multiple readings 在 Physics？
backZh: 该目的 taking multiple readings 在 Physics 是到 obtain 一个 accurate measurement 数值。

subtopicFull: T1.8 — physical quantities and measurement techniques
front:
Define a scalar quantity. (Extended Tier
Only)

What is displacement? (Extended Tier

Distance is a scalar quantity.

subtopicFull: T1.8 — physical quantities and measurement techniques

Energy is a scalar. (Extended Tier Only)

True
Energy is a scalar.

backZh: True 能量是 一个标量。

Is temperature a scalar or a vector?

How are vectors represented?

Vectors are represented by an arrow

front:
State the equation to calculate the
resultant vector using Pythagoras'
Theorem. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
c 2 = b 2 + a 2
Where:
c = longest side length of a right-
angled triangle, measured
depending on the quantity it
represents
b = one of the side lengths of a
right-angled triangle, measured
depending on the quantity it
represents
a = the other side length of a right
angles triangle, measured
depending on the quantity it
represents
frontZh: 写出公式到 计算该 合成的矢量使用 Pythagoras' Theorem。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: c2 = b2 + 一个2 其中： c = longest 侧长度的 一个右- angled triangle， 测量 depending 在该 量它 表示 b = 一个的 该侧 lengths 的一个右-angled triangle， 测量 depending 在该 量它 表示一个 = 该其他侧 长度的 一个右 角 triangle， 测量 depending 在该 量它 表示

What is the SOH-CAH-TOA mnemonic

The SOH-CAH-TOA mnemonic in

to apply sine and cosine to resolve the
sides of a triangle when calculating
vectors.
frontZh: 什么是该 SOH-CAH-TOA mnemonic 使用对于/为了在 trigonometry？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该 SOH-CAH-TOA mnemonic 在 trigonometry 用于 remember 如何到 apply sine 和 cosine 到 resolve 该 sides 的一个 triangle 什么时候计算矢量。

subtopicFull: T1.8 — physical quantities and measurement techniques
front:
How can you find the angle of the
resultant vector? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
Trigonometry can be used to find the
angle of the resultant vector.
frontZh: 怎样可以你 找到/求出该 angle 的该 合成的矢量？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: Trigonometry 可用于找到/求出该 angle 的该 合成的矢量。

subtopicFull: T1.8 — physical quantities and measurement techniques
front:
How can vectors be calculated
graphically? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
Vectors can be calculated graphically by
carefully producing a scale drawing
with all lengths and angles correct using
a pencil, ruler and protractor.
frontZh: 怎样可以矢量是 计算出的 graphically？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 矢量可以是/被计算出的 graphically 由 carefully 产生一个刻度 drawing 与所有 lengths 和角 正确使用一个 pencil， 直尺和 protractor。

Pythagoras' theorem is essential for
calculating the magnitude of vectors at
right angles to each other.
frontZh: 哪一个 theorem 是 essential 对于/为了计算该 大小的 矢量 at 右角 到每个其他？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: Pythagoras' theorem 是 essential 对于/为了计算该 大小的 矢量 at 右角 到每个其他。

subtopicFull: T1.8 — physical quantities and measurement techniques
front:
Define resultant vector. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
A resultant vector is a single vector
with the same effect as two or more
vectors combined.
frontZh: 定义合成的矢量。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 一个合成的矢量是 一个单一矢量与该 相同效应/影响 as 两个或 更多矢量合成的。

subtopicFull: T1.8 — physical quantities and measurement techniques
front:

back:
False.
The graphical method doesn't require
an exact scale.
frontZh: 判断正误：该 graphical calculation 方法的 resolving 矢量需要一个 exact 刻度。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 该 graphical 方法 doesn't 需要一个 exact 刻度。

subtopicFull: T1.8 — physical quantities and measurement techniques
front:
What does the length of the vector
arrow represent? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The length of the arrow represents the
magnitude of the vector.
frontZh: 表示什么该 长度的 该矢量箭头表示？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该长度的 该箭头表示该 大小的 该矢量。

front: What is pressure?
back:
Pressure is defined as the concentration
of a force or the force per unit area.
frontZh: 什么是压强？
backZh: 压强表示力作用的集中程度，也就是单位面积上受到的力。

front:
State the equation relating pressure,
force and area.
back:
The equation for pressure, force and
area is P = F
A
Where:
P = pressure, measured in pascals
(Pa)
F = force, measured in newton's (N)
A = surface area, measured in
metres squared (m2)
frontZh: 写出压强、力和面积之间的关系式。
backZh:
压强、力和面积之间的关系式为：
P = F/A
其中：
P = 压强，单位是帕斯卡（Pa）
F = 力，单位是牛顿（N）
A = 受力面积，单位是平方米（m²）

front:
True or False?
Pressure is measured in pascals (Pa).
back:
True.
Pressure is measured in pascals (Pa).
frontZh: 判断正误：压强的单位是帕斯卡（Pa）。
backZh:
正确。
压强的单位是帕斯卡（Pa）。

front:
What is the relationship between
force, pressure and surface area?
back:
A force applied over a large area will
result in a small pressure, and vice
versa.
frontZh: 力、压强和受力面积之间有什么关系？
backZh: 同一个力作用在较大的面积上时，产生的压强较小；作用在较小的面积上时，产生的压强较大。

front:
True or False?
A high-heeled shoe produces the same
pressure on the ground as a flat-soled
shoe when worn by the same person.
back:
False.
A high-heeled shoe produces a higher
pressure on the ground than a flat-
soled shoe when worn by the same
person.
This is because the same force is
applied over a smaller surface area.
frontZh: 判断正误：同一个人穿高跟鞋和穿平底鞋时，对地面的压强相同。
backZh:
错误。
同一个人穿高跟鞋时，对地面的压强比穿平底鞋时更大。
这是因为相同的力作用在更小的受力面积上。

front: Why do tractors need large tyres?
back:
Tractors need large tyres to spread their
weight over a large area to reduce the
pressure they exert on the ground.
This prevents them from sinking into
the mud.
frontZh: 为什么拖拉机需要较大的轮胎？
backZh:
拖拉机需要较大的轮胎，把自身的重力分散到较大的接触面积上，从而减小它对地面的压强。
这样可以防止拖拉机陷入泥地中。

front:
What happens when a force is applied
to a nail placed against a wall?
back:
When a force is applied to the nail, it
pierces and enters the wall.
This is because the applied force is
concentrated at the sharp pointed end,
which produces a large pressure over a
small area.
frontZh: 当一个力作用在靠着墙的钉子上时，会发生什么？
backZh:
当力作用在钉子上时，钉子会刺入并进入墙中。
这是因为施加的力集中在尖锐的钉尖上，在很小的面积上产生很大的压强。

front:
True or False?
The area used in calculating the
pressure should always be the cross-
sectional area of the object.
back:
True.
The area used in calculating the
pressure should always be the cross-
sectional area of the object.
This is the area which is perpendicular
(90 degrees) to the applied force.
frontZh: 判断正误：计算压强时使用的面积应始终是物体的横截面积。
backZh:
正确。
计算压强时使用的面积应是物体的横截面积。
这个面积与所施加的力垂直（成 90°）。

front:
A box is placed on a table. Calculate the
pressure applied by the grey face of the
box onto the table.
back:
The pressure applied by the grey face of
the box onto the table is 4 Pa.
surface area = 3 × 2 = 6 m2
P = F = 24 = 4 Pa
A 6
frontZh: 一个盒子放在桌面上。计算盒子灰色面作用在桌面上的压强。
backZh:
盒子灰色面作用在桌面上的压强为 4 Pa。
受力面积 = 3 × 2 = 6 m²
P = F/A = 24/6 = 4 Pa

front: Define a fluid .
back: A fluid is either a liquid or a gas.
frontZh: 定义流体。
backZh: 流体是指液体或气体。

front:
How does a liquid exert force on an
object suspended in it?
back:
When an object is suspended in a liquid,
it exerts pressure evenly across the
whole surface of the object and in all
directions.
This pressure creates a force which acts
at 90 degrees (right angles) to each
surface.
frontZh: 液体如何对悬浮在其中的物体施加力？
backZh:
当物体悬浮在液体中时，液体会在物体整个表面、各个方向上施加压强。
这种压强产生的力垂直于每一个表面，即与表面成 90°。

front:
How does increasing depth and
density affect the pressure of a liquid?
back:
The pressure of a liquid increases with
both increased depth and increased
density of the liquid.
frontZh: 深度和密度增大时，液体的压强会怎样变化？
backZh: 液体的压强会随着深度增大而增大，也会随着液体密度增大而增大。

front:
True or False?
The force created by pressure in a liquid
is exerted on an object in one direction
only.
back:
False.
The force created by pressure in a liquid
is exerted evenly across the whole
surface of an object.
frontZh: 判断正误：液体中由压强产生的力只沿一个方向作用在物体上。
backZh:
错误。
液体中由压强产生的力会均匀地作用在物体的整个表面上。

front:
State the equation for the pressure
difference of an object in a fluid.
back:
The equation for pressure difference in
a fluid is ∆ p = ρg ∆ h
Where:
∆ p = change in pressure,
measured in pascals (Pa)
ρ = density of the liquid, measured
in kilograms per metre cubed
(kg/m3)
g = gravitational field strength on
Earth, measured in newtons per
kilogram (N/kg)
∆ h = change in depth of the object
in the liquid, measured in metres
(m)
frontZh: 说明一个物体在流体中的压强差值公式。
backZh:
流体中的压强差值公式为：
∆p = ρg∆h
其中：
∆p = 压强的变化量，单位是帕斯卡（Pa）
ρ = 液体的密度，单位是千克每立方米（kg/m³）
g = 地球上的重力场强，单位是牛顿每千克（N/kg）
∆h = 物体在液体中深度的变化量，单位是米（m）

front:
State the meaning of ∆ p in equation
∆ p = ρg ∆ h . (Extended Tier Only)
back:
In the pressure equation for liquids ∆ p
represents the change in pressure in
pascals (Pa).
frontZh: 说明公式 ∆p = ρg∆h 中 ∆p 的含义。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 在液体压强公式中，∆p 表示压强的变化量，单位是帕斯卡（Pa）。

front:
State the meaning of ρ in the equation
∆ p = ρg ∆ h . (Extended Tier Only)
back:
ρ in the pressure equation for liquids
stands for the density of the liquid,
measured in kilograms per metre cubed
(kg/m3).
frontZh: 说明公式 ∆p = ρg∆h 中 ρ 的含义。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 在液体压强公式中，ρ 表示液体的密度，单位是千克每立方米（kg/m³）。

front:
What quantities are needed to calculate
the depth of water in a swimming pool?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
The depth of water in a swimming pool
can be calculated using the pressure
equation: ∆ p = ρg ∆ h
The quantities needed to calculate
depth ∆ h are:
∆ p = the pressure of the water at
the bottom of the pool
ρ = the density of the water
g = the gravitational field strength
of Earth
frontZh: 要计算游泳池中水的深度，需要哪些物理量？（仅拓展内容）
backZh:
游泳池中水的深度可以用压强公式计算：
∆p = ρg∆h
要计算深度 ∆h，需要：
∆p = 池底处水的压强
ρ = 水的密度
g = 地球的重力场强

front:
State the property of pressure in a
liquid demonstrated in the diagram.
back:
The property of pressure in a liquid
demonstrated in the diagram is that
pressure increases with depth.
frontZh: 说明图中展示的液体压强性质。
backZh: 图中展示的液体压强性质是：液体压强随深度增加而增大。

What are the three different states of
matter?
back:
The three states of matter are:
solid
liquid
gas

backZh: 该三个物态是： 固体液体气体

compressible.

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter

Which state of matter has no definite
shape and a fixed volume?

Liquids have no definite shape and a
fixed volume.
frontZh: 哪种物态有 no 固定形状和 一个固定体积？
backZh: 液体有 no 固定形状和 一个固定体积。

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front:
True or False?
Gases have a definite volume.

False.
Solids have a definite volume. Gases
have no fixed volume.
frontZh: 判断正误：气体有 一个 definite 体积。
backZh: 错误。 固体有 一个 definite 体积。 气体有 no 固定体积。

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front: Which state of matter is compressible?
back:
Gases are the only state of matter that
is compressible.
frontZh: 哪种物态是 可压缩？
backZh: 气体是 该只有/仅物态， 是可压缩。

front: What are the properties of a solid?
back:
The properties of a solid are:
definite shape
definite volume
cannot flow
not compressible
frontZh: 该性质的 一个固体是什么？
backZh: 该性质的 一个固体是： 固定形状 definite 体积不能流动不 可压缩

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front: What are the properties of a liquid?
back:
The properties of a liquid are:
no definite shape
fixed volume
can flow
not compressible
frontZh: 该性质的 一个液体是什么？
backZh: 该性质的 一个液体是： no 固定形状固定体积可以流动不 可压缩

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front: What are the properties of a gas?
back:
The properties of a gas are:
no definite shape
no fixed volume
can flow
are compressible
frontZh: 该性质的 一个气体是什么？
backZh: 该性质的 一个气体是： no 固定形状 no 固定体积可以流动是 可压缩

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front:
Identify the particle arrangement that

back:
The first particle arrangement
represents a solid.
frontZh: 识别该 粒子 arrangement， 表示一个固体。
backZh: 该第一粒子 arrangement 表示一个固体。

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front:

represents a gas.
back:
The third particle arrangement
represents a gas.
frontZh: 识别该 粒子 arrangement， 表示一个气体。
backZh: 该第三粒子 arrangement 表示一个气体。

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front:
In which state of matter do the particles

back:
The particles in solids vibrate about
their fixed positions
frontZh: 在哪种物态 do 该粒子振动 about 它们的固定 positions？
backZh: 该粒子在 固体振动 about 它们的固定 positions

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front:
True or False?
The particles are closer together in a
gas than in a liquid.
back:
False.
The particles in a gas are further apart
than the particles in a liquid.
frontZh: 判断正误：该粒子是 closer 一起在 一个气体比 在一个液体。
backZh: 错误。 该粒子在 一个气体是 进一步 apart 比该 粒子在 一个液体。

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front:
In which state of matter are the
particles free to slide past one another?
back:
The particles in a liquid are free to slide
past one another?
frontZh: 在哪种物态是 该粒子 free 到 slide past 一个另一个？
backZh: 该粒子在 一个液体是 free 到 slide past 一个另一个？

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front:
In which state of matter are the
particles widely separated?
back:
The particles in a gas are widely
separated.
frontZh: 在哪种物态是 该粒子 widely separated？
backZh: 该粒子在 一个气体是 widely separated。

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front:
In which states of matter are the
particles randomly arranged?
back:
The particles in gases and liquids are
randomly arranged.
frontZh: 在哪一个物态是 该粒子 randomly arranged？
backZh: 该粒子在 气体和 液体是 randomly arranged。

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front:
True or False?
The particles in a liquid are arranged in
a regular pattern.
back:
False.
The particles in a solid are arranged in a
regular pattern. The particles in a liquid
are randomly arranged.
frontZh: 判断正误：该粒子在 一个液体是 arranged 在一个 regular pattern。
backZh: 错误。 该粒子在 一个固体是 arranged 在一个 regular pattern。 该粒子在 一个液体是 randomly arranged。

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front:
In which state of matter do particles
have the most energy? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
The particles in a gas have the most
energy. They are energetic enough to
have overcome the intermolecular
forces of attraction.

as the fixed points of water.
frontZh: 该熔化和 沸腾点 的 pure 水 at standard atmospheric 压强是什么？
backZh: Pure 水 ice melts at 0 °C， 和 pure 液体水 boils at 100 °C at standard atmospheric 压强。 这些是 称为/已知 as 该固定点 的水。

front:
True or False?
Energy is transferred away from a
substance when it solidifies.
back:
True.
Energy is transferred away from a
substance when it solidifies.
frontZh: 判断正误：能量是 转移远离从 一个物质什么时候它 solidifies。
backZh: 正确。 能量是 转移远离从 一个物质什么时候它 solidifies。

front:
True or False?
The temperature of a substance
increases while the substance is
melting.
back:
False.
The temperature of a substance does
not increase while the substance is
melting. There is no change in
temperature during a change of state.
The energy is used to change the state
of the substance rather than to increase
its temperature.
frontZh: 判断正误：该温度的 一个物质增大当……时该 物质是 熔化。
backZh: 错误。 该温度的 一个物质做/会不 增大当……时该 物质是 熔化。 有 no 变化在 温度在……期间一个变化的 说明。 该能量用于变化该 说明的 该物质 rather 比到 增大它的温度。

front:
True or False?
Liquids freeze at the melting point of
the substance.
back:
True.
Liquids do freeze at the melting point of
the substance. The state change
between solids and liquids occurs at the
melting point.
frontZh: 判断正误：液体 freeze at 该熔点的 该物质。
backZh: 正确。 液体 do freeze at 该熔点的 该物质。 该说明变化在……之间固体和 液体发生 at 该熔点。

front:
True or False?
Gases condense at the boiling point of
the substance.
back:
True.
Gases do condense at the boiling point
of the substance. The state change
between liquids and gases occurs at the
boiling point of the substance.
frontZh: 判断正误：气体 condense at 该沸点的 该物质。
backZh: 正确。 气体 do condense at 该沸点的 该物质。 该说明变化在……之间液体和 气体发生 at 该沸点的 该物质。

front:
When a substance is melting or boiling,
why does the temperature of the
substance not change even though
energy is being transferred into the
system? proximity, rather than increasing the
back:
The energy transferred into a substance
that is melting or boiling is used to
overcome the intermolecular forces of
attraction holding the particles in close
temperature of the substance.
frontZh: 什么时候一个物质是 熔化或 沸腾， 为什么该 温度的 该物质不 变化 even though 能量是 被转移进入该 系统？
backZh: 该能量转移进入一个物质， 是熔化或 沸腾用于 overcome 该 intermolecular 力的 attraction holding 该粒子在 靠近 proximity， rather 比增大该 温度的 该物质。

front:
True or False?
Freezing and melting happen at the
same temperature.
back:
True.
Freezing and melting do happen at the
same temperature, the melting point of
the substance.
frontZh: 判断正误：凝固和 熔化 happen at 该相同温度。
backZh: 正确。 凝固和 熔化 do happen at 该相同温度， 该熔点的 该物质。

front: Define the term evaporation.
back:
Evaporation is the change of state from
a liquid to a gas. It happens at any
temperature and only from the surface
of the liquid.
frontZh: 定义该术语蒸发。
backZh: 蒸发是 该变化的 说明从 一个液体到 一个气体。 它发生 at 任何温度和 只有/仅从 该表面的 该液体。

front:
True or False?
Evaporation results in the heating of a
liquid.
back:
False.
Evaporation results in the cooling of a
liquid.
frontZh: 判断正误：蒸发 results 在该 加热的 一个液体。
backZh: 错误。 蒸发 results 在该 cooling 的一个液体。

front: How does evaporation occur?
back:
Evaporation occurs when more
energetic particles at the surface of
the liquid overcome the intermolecular
forces of attraction holding them in
close proximity.
frontZh: ……如何蒸发发生？
backZh: 蒸发发生什么时候更多 energetic 粒子 at 该表面的 该液体 overcome 该 intermolecular 力的 attraction holding 它们在 靠近 proximity。

front:
What are the three steps in the cooling
effect of evaporation?
back:
Evaporation cools a substance because:
The more energetic particles at the
surface escape the liquid.
This reduces the average energy
of the particles in the liquid.
Since temperature is a measure of
the average kinetic energy of the
particles in a substance, the
temperature decreases and the
substance is cooled.
frontZh: 该三个 steps 在该 cooling 效应/影响的 蒸发是什么？
backZh: 蒸发 cools 一个物质因为： 该更多 energetic 粒子 at 该表面 escape 该液体。 这 reduces 该 average 能量的 该粒子在 该液体。 Since 温度是对……的度量： 该 average 动能的 该粒子在 一个物质， 该温度减小和 该物质是 cooled。

front:
What are the factors affecting the rate
of evaporation? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The factors affecting the rate of
evaporation are:
temperature
surface area
air movement
frontZh: 什么是该 因素 affecting 该率 的蒸发？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该因素 affecting 该率 的蒸发是： 温度表面面积空气 movement

front:
What is the difference between boiling
and evaporation? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
Boiling only happens at the boiling
point of a substance, and it occurs
throughout the liquid. Evaporation
can occur at any temperature and it
only happens at the surface of a liquid.
frontZh: ……之间有什么区别？ 沸腾和 蒸发？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 沸腾只有/仅发生 at 该沸点的 一个物质， 和它 发生 throughout 该液体。 蒸发可以发生 at 任何温度和 它只有/仅发生 at 该表面的 一个液体。

front:
True or False?
Objects can be cooled when a liquid
evaporates from the surface of an
object. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
Objects can be cooled when a liquid
evaporates from the surface of an
object. For example, when sweat
evaporates from the skin:
Energy is transferred from the
warmer skin to the cooler liquid.
The more energetic particles at the
surface of the liquid escape
reducing the average energy of the
liquid.
This increases the temperature
difference between the skin and
the liquid so more energy is
transferred from the skin to the
liquid.
This process has a cooling effect
on the skin.
frontZh: 判断正误：物体可以是/被 cooled 什么时候一个液体 evaporates 从该 表面的 物体。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 物体可以是/被 cooled 什么时候一个液体 evaporates 从该 表面的 物体。 例如， 什么时候 sweat evaporates 从该 skin： 能量是 转移从 该 warmer skin 到该 cooler 液体。 该更多 energetic 粒子 at 该表面的 该液体 escape reducing 该 average 能量的 该液体。 这增大该 温度差异/差值在……之间该 skin 和该 液体 so 更多能量是 转移从 该 skin 到该 液体。 这过程有 一个 cooling 效应/影响在 该 skin。

front:
Define thermal conduction.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
Thermal conduction is the transfer of
thermal energy through a substance.
frontZh: 定义热传导。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 热传导是 该转移的 热能通过一个物质。

front:
True or False?
Thermal conduction in solids occurs
when hotter, more energetic atoms or
ions vibrate faster and collide with
neighbouring atoms or ions. (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
True.
Thermal conduction in solids occurs
when hotter, more energetic atoms or
ions vibrate faster and collide with
neighbouring atoms or ions,
transferring energy throughout the
structure of the solid.
frontZh: 判断正误：热传导在 固体发生什么时候更热， 更多 energetic 原子或 离子振动更快和 碰撞与相邻的原子或 离子。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 热传导在 固体发生什么时候更热， 更多 energetic 原子或 离子振动更快和 碰撞与相邻的原子或 离子， transferring 能量 throughout 该 structure 的该 固体。

front:
Why does thermal conduction generally
occur faster in metals than non-metals?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
Thermal conduction occurs faster in
metals because metals have free
(delocalised) electrons, which speed up
the energy transfer throughout the
substance.
frontZh: 为什么热传导 generally 发生更快在 metals 比 non-metals？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 热传导发生更快在 metals 因为 metals 有 free (delocalised) 电子， 哪一个加速该 能量转移 throughout 该物质。

front:
When does thermal conduction end?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
Thermal conduction ends when thermal
equilibrium is reached.
frontZh: 什么时候热传导结束/末端？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 热传导 ends 什么时候热平衡是 reached。

front:
Define thermal equilibrium.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
Thermal equilibrium is a state in which
no net energy transfer takes place
because a consistent temperature has
been reached.
frontZh: 定义热平衡。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 热平衡是 一个说明在 哪一个 no net 能量转移需要/花费位置/发生因为一个 consistent 温度有 被 reached。

front:
True or False?
Thermal conduction does not happen in
liquids or gases because the particles
are too far apart. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
False.
Thermal conduction does happen in
liquids and gases, but they tend to be
poor conductors because the particles
are further apart than in solids.
frontZh: 判断正误：热传导做/会不 happen 在液体或 气体因为该 粒子是 too far apart。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 热传导做/会 happen 在液体和 气体， 但是它们 tend 到是 poor 导体因为该 粒子是 进一步 apart 比在 固体。

front:
True or False?
Convection cannot happen in solids.
back:
True.
Convection only happens in liquids and
gases because the particles are free to
move around. It cannot happen in
solids because the particles are held in
a rigid structure.
frontZh: 判断正误：对流不能 happen 在固体。
backZh: 正确。 对流只有/仅发生在 液体和 气体因为该 粒子是 free 到移动周围。 它不能 happen 在固体因为该 粒子是 held 在一个 rigid structure。

front:
How is a convection current set up
when a fluid is heated?
back:
When a fluid is heated, the space
between particles increases, so the
density of the fluid decreases which
causes it to rise, and cooler, denser fluid
takes its place.
frontZh: ……如何一个对流电流 set 向上什么时候一个流体是 被加热？
backZh: 什么时候一个流体是 被加热， 该太空在……之间粒子增大， so 该密度的 该流体减小哪一个导致它 到 rise， 和 cooler， 更密流体需要/花费它的位置/发生。

front:
In a convection current hot fluid
expands and rises. What is this
replaced by?
back:
In a convection current hot fluid
expands and rises. In a convection
current, this is replaced by cooler,
denser fluid.
frontZh: 在一个对流电流热 流体膨胀和 rises。 什么是这 replaced 由？
backZh: 在一个对流电流热 流体膨胀和 rises。 在一个对流电流， 这是 replaced 由 cooler， 更密流体。

front:
What substance is used as a purple dye
to demonstrate convection in water?
back:
Potassium permanganate is used as a
purple dye to demonstrate convection
in water.
frontZh: 什么物质是 使用 as 一个 purple dye 到 demonstrate 对流在 水？
backZh: Potassium permanganate 是使用 as 一个 purple dye 到 demonstrate 对流在 水。

front:
True or False?
Heat rises.
back:
False.
Heat is not a substance so it cannot rise.
It is the heated region of the fluid that
rises as its density decreases.
frontZh: 判断正误：热 rises。
backZh: 错误。 热是 不一个物质 so 它不能 rise。 它是 该被加热区域的 该流体， rises as 它的密度减小。

front:
True or False?
Convection currents form when a fluid
is cooled.
back:
True.
When a fluid is cooled, the movement of
the particles slows down and they come
closer together increasing the density.
The denser fluid sinks and less dense
fluid takes its place.
frontZh: 判断正误：对流 currents 形式什么时候一个流体是 cooled。
backZh: 正确。 什么时候一个流体是 cooled， 该 movement 的该 粒子 slows 向下和 它们 come closer 一起增大该 密度。 该更密流体 sinks 和较少致密流体需要/花费它的位置/发生。

front:
True or False?
All objects emit thermal radiation.
back:
True.
All objects emit thermal radiation. The
hotter an object is, the more thermal
radiation it emits.
frontZh: 判断正误：所有物体发射热辐射。
backZh: 正确。 所有物体发射热辐射。 该更热物体是， 该更多热辐射它 发射。

front:
True or False?
The colour of an object affects its ability
to emit and absorb radiation.
back:
True.
The colour of an object does affect its
ability to emit and absorb thermal
radiation.
frontZh: 判断正误：该 colour 的物体 affects 它的 ability 到发射和 absorb 辐射。
backZh: 正确。 该 colour 的物体做/会影响它的 ability 到发射和 absorb 热辐射。

front:
True or False?
Thermal radiation requires a medium to
travel through.
back:
False.
Thermal radiation is an
electromagnetic wave, so it can travel
through a vacuum.
frontZh: 判断正误：热辐射需要一个介质到 传播通过。
backZh: 错误。 热辐射是 一个电磁的波， so 它可以传播通过一个真空。

front:
What type of electromagnetic wave is
thermal radiation?
back: Thermal radiation is infrared radiation.
frontZh: 什么类型的 电磁的波 是热辐射？
backZh: 热辐射是 红外辐射。

front:
In terms of the rate of energy transfer,
how does an object maintain a constant
temperature? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
An object maintains a constant
temperature when the rate of energy
transfer away from the object is equal
to the rate of energy transfer to the
object.
frontZh: 用……来表示该 率的 能量转移， ……如何物体 maintain 一个恒定温度？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 物体 maintains 一个恒定温度什么时候该 率的 能量转移远离从 物体是 相等到 该率 的能量转移到 物体。

front:
True or False?
White surfaces are good emitters and
good absorbers of thermal radiation.
back:
False.
White surfaces are poor emitters and
poor absorbers of thermal radiation.
frontZh: 判断正误：白色表面是 good emitters 和 good absorbers 的热辐射。
backZh: 错误。 白色表面是 poor emitters 和 poor absorbers 的热辐射。

front:
True or False?
When an object emits less thermal
radiation than it absorbs, its
temperature increases. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
True.
When an object emits less thermal
radiation than it absorbs, its
temperature increases.
frontZh: 判断正误：什么时候物体发射较少热辐射比 它 absorbs， 它的温度增大。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 什么时候物体发射较少热辐射比 它 absorbs， 它的温度增大。

front:
What colour surface is the best emitter
of thermal radiation?
back:
Black surfaces are the best emitters of
thermal radiation.
frontZh: 什么 colour 表面是 该 best 发射体的 热辐射？
backZh: Black 表面是 该 best emitters 的热辐射。

front:
True or False?
Shiny surfaces are very good emitters of
thermal radiation.
back:
False.
Shiny surfaces are very poor emitters of
thermal radiation. They are also very
poor absorbers because they reflect the
infrared radiation.
frontZh: 判断正误：Shiny 表面是 非常 good emitters 的热辐射。
backZh: 错误。 Shiny 表面是 非常 poor emitters 的热辐射。 它们是 也非常 poor absorbers 因为它们 reflect 该红外辐射。

front:
True or False?
When an object emits more thermal
radiation than it absorbs, its
temperature increases. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
False.
When an object emits more thermal
radiation than it absorbs, its
temperature decreases.
frontZh: 判断正误：什么时候物体发射更多热辐射比 它 absorbs， 它的温度增大。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 什么时候物体发射更多热辐射比 它 absorbs， 它的温度减小。

front:
True or False?
If the Earth had no atmosphere, the
temperature on the surface would
remain the same as it is currently.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
False.
If the Earth had no atmosphere, the
temperature on the surface would drop
to about −180 °C at night, the same as
that of the Moon at night.
frontZh: 判断正误：If 该地球 had no 大气层， 该温度在 该表面会 remain 与……相同它 是 currently。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 If 该地球 had no 大气层， 该温度在 该表面会 drop 到 about −180 °C at 夜晚， 与……相同， 的该 月球 at 夜晚。

front:
Define the Greenhouse Effect .
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
The Greenhouse Effect is the process by
which certain gases in the Earth's
atmosphere trap and reradiate infrared
radiation, leading to an increase in the
temperature of the Earth's surface.
frontZh: 定义该 温室效应/影响。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该温室效应/影响是 该过程由哪一个 certain 气体在 该地球's 大气层 trap 和 reradiate 红外辐射， leading 到一个增大在 该温度的 该地球's 表面。

front:
What are the factors affecting the
Earth's temperature? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
The factors affecting the Earth's
temperature are the rate of reflection ,
absorption, and emission of light and
infrared radiation from the Sun.
frontZh: 什么是该 因素 affecting 该地球's 温度？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该因素 affecting 该地球's 温度是 该率 的反射， 吸收， 和发射的 光和 红外辐射从 该太阳。

front:
True or False?
The Earth receives thermal radiation
from the Sun but does not emit its own
thermal radiation. (Extended Tier
Only) emit thermal radiation.
back:
False.
The Earth receives thermal radiation
from the Sun and emits its own thermal
radiation. Remember that all objects
frontZh: 判断正误：该地球 receives 热辐射从 该太阳但是做/会不 发射它的 own 热辐射。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 该地球 receives 热辐射从 该太阳和 发射它的 own 热辐射。 Remember， 所有物体发射热辐射。

front:
Define Greenhouse Gases. (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
Greenhouse gases are gases in the
atmosphere that absorb and reradiate
longer-wavelength infrared radiation
emitted by the Earth, preventing it from
escaping into space, and causing
warming of the Earth's surface.
frontZh: 定义温室气体。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 温室气体是 气体在 该大气层， absorb 和 reradiate 更长-波长红外辐射发射由该 地球， preventing 它从 escaping 进入太空， 和 causing warming 的该 地球's 表面。

front:
How does the Greenhouse Effect cause
warming of the Earth's surface?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
The Greenhouse Effect causes warming
of the Earth's surface because of the
Sun's thermal radiation reaching the
Earth's atmosphere. Here some
radiation is reflected back into space,
and the rest is absorbed and reradiated
by greenhouse gases, warming the
atmosphere and Earth's surface.
frontZh: ……如何该 温室效应/影响导致 warming 的该 地球's 表面？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该温室效应/影响导致 warming 的该 地球's 表面因为的 该太阳's 热辐射 reaching 该地球's 大气层。 Here some 辐射是 reflected back 进入太空， 和该 静止是 吸收和 reradiated 由温室气体， warming 该大气层和 地球's 表面。

front:
What is an example of a greenhouse
gas? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
Examples of greenhouse gases are:
carbon dioxide
methane (natural gas)
water vapour
frontZh: 什么是一个例子的 一个温室气体？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 例子的 温室气体是： carbon dioxide methane (天然气) 水 vapour

front:
True or False?
The electromagnetic spectrum is
arranged in a specific order based on
the wavelengths or frequencies.
back:
True.
The electromagnetic spectrum is
arranged in a specific order based on
the wavelengths or frequencies.
frontZh: 判断正误：该电磁波谱是 arranged 在一个 specific 顺序 based 在该 wavelengths 或 frequencies。
backZh: 正确。 该电磁波谱是 arranged 在一个 specific 顺序 based 在该 wavelengths 或 frequencies。 该顺序的 该电磁的

front:
What is the order of the
electromagnetic spectrum from longest
to shortest wavelength?
back:
The order of the electromagnetic
spectrum from longest to shortest
wavelength is:
Radio waves
Microwaves
Infrared
Visible light
Ultraviolet
X-rays
Gamma rays
frontZh: 什么是该顺序的 该电磁波谱从 longest 到 shortest 波长？
backZh: 该顺序的 该电磁波谱从 longest 到 shortest 波长是： 无线电波微波红外线可见光紫外线 X射线 γ射线

front:
What are the properties of
electromagnetic waves?
back:
All electromagnetic waves share the
following properties:
transverse
can through a vacuum
travel at the same speed in a
vacuum
form a continuous spectrum
frontZh: 该性质的 电磁波是什么？
backZh: 所有电磁波 share 以下性质： 横向的可以通过一个真空传播 at 该相同速率在 一个真空形式一个 continuous 光谱

front:
Define the term electromagnetic
waves.
back:
Electromagnetic waves are transverse
waves with oscillating electric and
magnetic fields that transfer energy
from the source of the waves to an
absorber.

suitable for certain applications

The equation linking time period, T and
frequency, f is:
T = 1
f
Where:
T = time period, measured in
seconds (s)
f = frequency, measured in hertz
(Hz)
frontZh: 什么是该公式 linking 时间周期， T 和频率， f？
backZh: 该公式 linking 时间周期， T 和频率， f 是： T = 1 f 其中： T= 时间周期， 单位为秒 (s) f = 频率， 单位为 hertz (Hz)

front: Define the term transverse wave.
back:
A transverse wave is a wave where the
oscillations are at right angles
(perpendicular) to the direction of
energy transfer.
frontZh: 定义该术语横波。
backZh: 一个横波是 一个波 其中该 振荡是 at 右角 (垂直) 到该 方向的 能量转移。

front:
What are three examples of transverse
waves?
back:
Examples of transverse waves include:
ripples on the surface of water
vibrations on a guitar string
S-waves (secondary seismic waves)
electromagnetic waves
frontZh: 三个例子的 横向的波是什么？
backZh: 例子的 横向的波 include： ripples 在该 表面的 水振动在 一个 guitar string S-波 (secondary seismic 波) 电磁波

front: Define the term longitudinal wave.
back:
A longitudinal wave is a wave where the
oscillations are parallel to the direction
of energy transfer.
frontZh: 定义该术语纵波。
backZh: 一个纵波是 一个波 其中该 振荡是 并联到 该方向的 能量转移。

front:
What are three examples of longitudinal
waves?
back:
Examples of longitudinal waves are:
sound waves
P-waves (primary seismic waves)
pressure waves in liquids or gases
frontZh: 三个例子的 longitudinal 波是什么？
backZh: 例子的 longitudinal 波是： 声波 P-波 (主要 seismic 波) 压强波 在液体或 气体

front:
True or False?
Longitudinal waves can travel in a
vacuum.
back:
False.
Longitudinal waves require a medium
to travel through, so they cannot travel
in a vacuum since there are no particles
in a vacuum.
frontZh: 判断正误：Longitudinal 波可以传播在 一个真空。
backZh: 错误。 Longitudinal 波需要一个介质到 传播通过， so 它们不能传播在 一个真空 since 有 no 粒子在 一个真空。

front:
What is the name for the part of a
longitudinal wave where the particles
are close together?
back:
In a longitudinal wave, the area where
the particles are close together is called
a compression.
frontZh: 什么是该说出对于/为了该 part 的一个纵波其中该 粒子是 靠近一起？
backZh: 在一个纵波， 该面积其中该 粒子是 靠近一起称为一个密部。

front:
What is the name for the part of a
longitudinal wave where the particles
are spaced far apart?
back:
In a longitudinal wave, the area where
the particles are spaced far apart is
called a rarefaction.
frontZh: 什么是该说出对于/为了该 part 的一个纵波其中该 粒子是 spaced far apart？
backZh: 在一个纵波， 该面积其中该 粒子是 spaced far apart 称为一个疏部。

front:
True or False?
Visible light is an example of a
transverse wave.
back:
True.
Visible light is part of the
electromagnetic spectrum. All
electromagnetic waves are transverse
waves.
frontZh: 判断正误：可见光是 一个例子的 一个横波。
backZh: 正确。 可见光是 part 的该 电磁波谱。 所有电磁波是 横向的波。

front:
True or False?
Transverse waves can travel through a
vacuum.
back:
True.
Electromagnetic waves are transverse
waves and they can travel through a
vacuum. However, other types of
transverse waves such as water waves
and S-waves are mechanical waves that
require a medium.
frontZh: 判断正误：横向的波 可以传播通过一个真空。
backZh: 正确。 电磁波是 横向的波 和它们可以传播通过一个真空。 然而， 其他类型的 横向的波 例如/这样的 as 水波 和 S-波是 mechanical 波， 需要一个介质。

front:
What is the key difference between
transverse and longitudinal waves?
back:
The key difference between transverse
and longitudinal waves is the direction
of the vibrations with respect to the
direction of the energy transfer. For
transverse waves, the vibrations are
perpendicular to the direction of energy
transfer, while for longitudinal waves,
the vibrations are parallel to the
direction of energy transfer.
frontZh: 什么是该 key 差异/差值在……之间横向的和 longitudinal 波？
backZh: 该 key 差异/差值在……之间横向的和 longitudinal 波是 该方向的 该振动与 respect 到该 方向的 该能量转移。 对于/为了横向的波， 该振动是 垂直到 该方向的 能量转移， 当……时对于/为了 longitudinal 波， 该振动是 并联到 该方向的 能量转移。

front:
True or False?
The highest point above the rest
position of a transverse wave is called
the peak of the wave.
back:
True.
The highest point above the rest
position of a transverse wave is called
the peak or the crest of the wave.
frontZh: 判断正误：该 highest 点上方该 静止 position 的一个横波称为该 peak 的该 波。
backZh: 正确。 该 highest 点上方该 静止 position 的一个横波称为该 peak 或该 crest 的该 波。

front:
What is the name of the lowest point
below the rest position of a transverse
wave? the trough.
back:
The name of the lowest point below
the rest position of a transverse wave is
frontZh: 什么是该说出的 该 lowest 点 below 该静止 position 的一个横波？
backZh: 该说出的 该 lowest 点 below 该静止 position 的一个横波是 该 trough。

front:
What type of wave is shown in the
diagram?
back:
The wave shown is a transverse wave
because it oscillates at right angles of
the direction of wave motion.
frontZh: 什么类型的 波是 显示的在 该图示？
backZh: 该波 显示的是 一个横波因为它 oscillates at 右角 的该 方向的 波运动。

Sketch a longitudinal wave.
Include the following labels:
direction of vibration
direction of energy transfer
compression
rarefaction
back:
A correctly labelled longitudinal wave is
