front: Define the term reflection .
back:
Reflection occurs when a wave meets a
boundary between two media and does
not pass through, but instead stays in
the original medium.
frontZh: 定义该术语反射。
backZh: 反射发生什么时候一个波 meets 一个边界在……之间两个 media 和做/会不 通过通过， 但是 instead stays 在该 original 介质。

front: State the law of reflection .
back:
The law of reflection states that the
angle of incidence is equal to the angle
of reflection.
frontZh: 说明该定律的 反射。
backZh: 该定律的 反射说明， 该入射角是 相等到 该反射角。

front: Define the term refraction.
back:
Refraction occurs when a wave passes a
boundary between two different
transparent media and undergoes a
change in speed causing it to change
direction.
frontZh: 定义该术语折射。
backZh: 折射发生什么时候一个波 passes 一个边界在……之间两个不同 transparent media 和 undergoes 一个变化在 速率 causing 它到 改变方向。

front: Define the term diffraction .
back:
Diffraction is when waves pass around
an obstacle or through a narrow gap,
and the waves spread out.
frontZh: 定义该术语衍射。
backZh: 衍射是 什么时候波 通过周围一个 obstacle 或通过一个 narrow gap， 和该 波分散外/出。

front:
True or False?
Diffraction only happens when the gap
the wave is passing through is smaller
than the wavelength of the wave.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
False.
Diffraction is greatest when the gap the
wave is passing through is of a similar
size to the wavelength of the wave. If
the wavelength is much greater than, or
much smaller than the gap then no
diffraction will occur.
frontZh: 判断正误：衍射只有/仅发生什么时候该 gap 该波 是 passing 通过是 小于该 波长的 该波。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 衍射是 greatest 什么时候该 gap 该波 是 passing 通过是 的一个类似大小到 该波长的 该波。 If 该波长是 很多大于， 或很多小于该 gap 然后 no 衍射将会发生。

front:
True or False?
The angle of incidence is measured
between the incident ray and the
boundary surface.
back:
False.
The angle of incidence is measured
between the incident ray and the
normal.
frontZh: 判断正误：该入射角是 测量在……之间该 入射光线和 该边界表面。
backZh: 错误。 该入射角是 测量在……之间该 入射光线和 该法线。

front:
True or False?
The angle of reflection is measured
between the incident ray and the
normal.
back:
False.
The angle of reflection is measured
between the reflected ray and the
normal.
frontZh: 判断正误：该反射角是 测量在……之间该 入射光线和 该法线。
backZh: 错误。 该反射角是 测量在……之间该 反射光线和 该法线。

front:
What is the key difference between
reflection and refraction?
back:
Reflection is when a wave stays in the
same medium, while refraction is when
a wave passes into a different medium
and changes speed.
frontZh: 什么是该 key 差异/差值在……之间反射和 折射？
backZh: 反射是 什么时候一个波 stays 在该 相同介质， 当……时折射是 什么时候一个波 passes 进入一个不同介质和 变化速率。

front:
True or False?
The angle of incidence is equal to the
angle of refraction.
back:
False.
The law of reflection states that the
angle of incidence is equal to the angle
of reflection . In refraction, the angle
of refraction is dependent upon the
angle of incidence and the media
through which the wave travels.
frontZh: 判断正误：该入射角是 相等到 该折射角。
backZh: 错误。 该定律的 反射说明， 该入射角是 相等到 该反射角。 在折射， 该折射角是 dependent upon 该入射角和 该 media 通过哪一个该 波传播。

front:
How do you measure the angle of
refraction?
back:
The angle of refraction is measured with
a protractor between the refracted ray
and the normal.
frontZh: ……如何你 测量该 折射角？
backZh: 该折射角是 测量与一个 protractor 在……之间该 折射光线和 该法线。

front:
What types of wave behaviour can a
ripple tank be used to demonstrate?
back:
A ripple tank can be used to
demonstrate the following types of
wave behaviour:
reflection
refraction
diffraction
frontZh: 什么类型的 波 behaviour 可以一个 ripple tank 是用于 demonstrate？
backZh: 一个 ripple tank 可用于 demonstrate 以下类型的 波 behaviour： 反射折射衍射

front:
True or False?
The amount of diffraction depends on
the size of the gap compared to the
wavelength. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
The amount of diffraction depends on
the size of the gap compared to the
wavelength of the wave.
frontZh: 判断正误：该量 的衍射取决于该 大小的 该 gap compared 到该 波长。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 该量 的衍射取决于该 大小的 该 gap compared 到该 波长的 该波。

front:
What happens to the wavelength of
water waves in a ripple tank when the
frequency is reduced?
back:
When the frequency of water waves in a
ripple tank is reduced, the wavelength
increases.
frontZh: 什么发生到 该波长的 水波 在一个 ripple tank 什么时候该 频率是 reduced？
backZh: 什么时候该 频率的 水波 在一个 ripple tank 是 reduced， 该波长增大。

front:
How do you decrease the wavelength of
water waves in a ripple tank?
back:
You decrease the wavelength of the
waves in a ripple tank by increasing the
frequency of the waves.
frontZh: ……如何你 减小该 波长的 水波 在一个 ripple tank？
backZh: 你减小该 波长的 该波 在一个 ripple tank 由增大该 频率的 该波。

front:
True or False?
The image formed in a mirror is a real
image.
back:
False.
The image formed in a mirror is a
virtual image.
frontZh: 判断正误：该像 形成在 一个镜 是一个实像。
backZh: 错误。 该像 形成在 一个镜 是一个虚像。

front:
True or False?
An image formed in a plane mirror will
be smaller than the object.
back:
False.
The image formed in a plane mirror will
be the same size as the object.
frontZh: 判断正误：一个像 形成在 一个平面镜将会是 小于物体。
backZh: 错误。 该像 形成在 一个平面镜将会是 与……大小相同物体。

front: What is the normal?
back:
The normal is a line drawn
perpendicular (at 90°) to the boundary
of a material.
frontZh: 什么是法线？
backZh: 该法线是 一个线 drawn 垂直 (at 90°) 到该 边界的 一个材料。

front:
True or False?
The image formed in a plane mirror will
be the same distance behind the mirror
as the object is in front of it.
back:
True.
The image formed in a plane mirror will
be the same distance behind the mirror
as the object is in front of it.
frontZh: 判断正误：该像 形成在 一个平面镜将会是 相同距离 behind 该镜 as 物体是 在 front 的它。
backZh: 正确。 该像 形成在 一个平面镜将会是 相同距离 behind 该镜 as 物体是 在 front 的它。

front:
Define the term angle of incidence for
light rays at the boundary of a material.
back:
The angle of incidence is the angle
between the incident ray and the
normal line at the boundary of a
material.
frontZh: 定义该术语入射角对于/为了光 射线 at 该边界的 一个材料。
backZh: 该入射角是 该 angle 在……之间该 入射光线和 该法线 at 该边界的 一个材料。

front:
True or False?
The image formed in a plane mirror will
be laterally inverted.
back:
True.
The image formed in a plane mirror will
be laterally inverted. The left hand side
of the object will appear on the right
hand side of the image and vice versa.
frontZh: 判断正误：该像 形成在 一个平面镜将会是 laterally inverted。
backZh: 正确。 该像 形成在 一个平面镜将会是 laterally inverted。 该左 hand 侧的 物体将会 appear 在该 右 hand 侧的 该像 反之亦然。

front: Define the term angle of reflection .
back:
The angle of reflection is the angle
between the reflected ray and the
normal at the boundary of a material.
frontZh: 定义该术语反射角。
backZh: 该反射角是 该 angle 在……之间该 反射光线和 该法线 at 该边界的 一个材料。

front:
True or False?
The law of reflection applies to
reflection in plane mirrors.
back:
True.
The law of reflection is when the angle
of incidence is equal to the angle of
reflection and applies to a plane mirror.
frontZh: 判断正误：该定律的 反射 applies 到反射在 plane mirrors。
backZh: 正确。 该定律的 反射是 什么时候该 入射角是 相等到 该反射角和 applies 到一个平面镜。

front:
True or False?
An image formed in a plane mirror will
be virtual.
back:
True.
An image formed in a plane mirror will
be virtual.
frontZh: 判断正误：一个像 形成在 一个平面镜将会是 虚。
backZh: 正确。 一个像 形成在 一个平面镜将会是 虚。

front:
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror, what is the
independent variable? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror the
independent variable is the angle of
incidence.
frontZh: 在一个实验到 研究反射由一个平面镜， 什么是该 independent 可变？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 在一个实验到 研究反射由一个平面镜该 independent 可变是 该入射角。

front:
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror, what is the
dependent variable? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
The dependent variable in the reflection
investigation is the angle of reflection .
frontZh: 在一个实验到 研究反射由一个平面镜， 什么是该 dependent 可变？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该 dependent 可变在 该反射 investigation 是该 反射角。

front:
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror, what
equipment is needed? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror the
equipment needed is:
a ray box
a protractor
a sheet of paper
a pencil
a ruler
frontZh: 在一个实验到 研究反射由一个平面镜， 什么 equipment 是需要？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 在一个实验到 研究反射由一个平面镜该 equipment 需要是： 一个射线 box 一个 protractor 一个 sheet 的纸/试卷一个 pencil 一个直尺

front:
True or False?
Looking directly into a ray box the light
may damage the eyes. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
True.
Looking directly into a ray box light may
damage the eyes.
frontZh: 判断正误：Looking 正比地进入一个射线 box 该光 may 损伤该 eyes。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 Looking 正比地进入一个射线 box 光 may 损伤该 eyes。

front:
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror, what
results would you expect to find?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror, the results
you would expect to find are that the
angle of reflection is equal to the angle
of incidence at all angles tested.
frontZh: 在一个实验到 研究反射由一个平面镜， 什么 results 会你 expect 到找到/求出？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 在一个实验到 研究反射由一个平面镜， 该 results 你会 expect 到找到/求出是， 该反射角是 相等到 该入射角 at 所有角 tested。

front:
What action should be taken if a light
ray box causes burns? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
If the light ray box causes burns, the
burn should be held under cold running
water for at least five minutes.
frontZh: 什么 action 应该是 所用 if 一个光 射线 box 导致 burns？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: If 该光 射线 box 导致 burns， 该 burn 应该是 held 在……下 cold running 水对于/为了 at least five minutes。

front:
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror, which
factors should be controlled?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror, control
variables include:
distance of the ray box from the
mirror
width of the light beam
frequency/wavelength of the light
frontZh: 在一个实验到 研究反射由一个平面镜， 哪一个因素应该是 controlled？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 在一个实验到 研究反射由一个平面镜， control variables include： 距离的 该射线 box 从该 镜 width 的该 光 beam 频率/波长的 该光

front:
True or False?
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror, an error
could occur in measuring the angles of
incidence and reflection if the normal
lines are not drawn perpendicular to
the surface of the mirror. This is an
example of a systematic error.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
Systematic errors are errors in the use
of apparatus or the experimental
method. Errors in measuring angles due
to drawing normal lines incorrectly are
systematic errors.
frontZh: 判断正误：在一个实验到 研究反射由一个平面镜， 一个 error could 发生在 measuring 该角 的 incidence 和反射 if 该法线 lines 是不 drawn 垂直到 该表面的 该镜。 这是 一个例子的 一个 systematic error。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 Systematic errors 是 errors 在该 use 的 apparatus 或该 experimental 方法。 Errors 在 measuring 角由于 drawing 法线 lines incorrectly 是 systematic errors。

front:
True or False?
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror, a sharp
pencil should be used to mark the
centre of the beam to then draw the
ray. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
Using a sharp pencil and marking the
centre of the beam to then draw the ray
will reduce random errors in the results.
frontZh: 判断正误：在一个实验到 研究反射由一个平面镜， 一个 sharp pencil 应该是 用于 mark 该中心的 该 beam 到然后 draw 该射线。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 使用一个 sharp pencil 和 marking 该中心的 该 beam 到然后 draw 该射线将会 reduce 随机 errors 在该 results。

front:
What is the symbol for the angle of
incidence of a light ray on a boundary?
back:
The symbol for the angle of incidence of
a light ray on a boundary is i .
frontZh: 什么是该符号对于/为了该 入射角的 一个光 射线在 一个边界？
backZh: 该符号对于/为了该 入射角的 一个光 射线在 一个边界是 i。

front:
What is the symbol for the angle of
refraction of a light ray on a boundary?
back:
The symbol for the angle of refraction of
a light ray on a boundary is r .
frontZh: 什么是该符号对于/为了该 折射角的 一个光 射线在 一个边界？
backZh: 该符号对于/为了该 折射角的 一个光 射线在 一个边界是 r。

front:
True or False?
When light refracts by passing from a
less dense medium into a denser
medium, the ray bends away from the
normal.
back:
False.
When light refracts by passing from a
less dense medium to a more dense
medium, it bends towards the normal.
frontZh: 判断正误：什么时候光 refracts 由 passing 从一个较少致密介质进入一个更密介质， 该射线 bends 远离从 该法线。
backZh: 错误。 什么时候光 refracts 由 passing 从一个较少致密介质到 一个更多致密介质， 它 bends 朝向该 法线。

front:
True or False?
The frequency of light changes during
refraction.
back:
False.
The frequency of light does not change
during refraction.
frontZh: 判断正误：该频率的 光变化在……期间折射。
backZh: 错误。 该频率的 光做/会不 变化在……期间折射。

front:
True or False?
When light passes along the normal,
perpendicular to the surface of a
medium, the ray does not change
direction.
back:
True.
When light passes along the normal,
perpendicular to the surface of a
medium, the ray does not change
direction.
frontZh: 判断正误：什么时候光 passes along 该法线， 垂直到 该表面的 一个介质， 该射线做/会不 改变方向。
backZh: 正确。 什么时候光 passes along 该法线， 垂直到 该表面的 一个介质， 该射线做/会不 改变方向。

front:
True or False?
When light refracts by passing from a
denser medium into a less dense
medium, the ray bends toward the
normal. normal.
back:
False.
When light refracts by passing from a
denser medium into a less dense
medium, the ray bends away from the
frontZh: 判断正误：什么时候光 refracts 由 passing 从一个更密介质进入一个较少致密介质， 该射线 bends toward 该法线。
backZh: 错误。 什么时候光 refracts 由 passing 从一个更密介质进入一个较少致密介质， 该射线 bends 远离从 该法线。

front:
What properties of light change during
refraction?
back:
During refraction, the speed and
wavelength of light change, but not the
frequency.
frontZh: 什么性质的 光变化在……期间折射？
backZh: 在……期间折射， 该速率和 波长的 光变化， 但是不 该频率。

front:
In a ray diagram of refraction through a
glass block, how many boundary
surfaces does the ray pass through?
back:
In a ray diagram for refraction through
a glass block, the ray passes through 2
boundary surfaces:
air-to-glass
glass-to-air
frontZh: 在一个射线图示的 折射通过一个玻璃 block， 多少边界表面做/会该 射线通过通过？
backZh: 在一个射线图示对于/为了折射通过一个玻璃 block， 该射线 passes 通过 2 边界表面： 空气-到-玻璃玻璃-到-空气

front:
True or False?
When light refracts through a glass
block, the incident ray at the boundary
of glass-to-air is the ray inside the glass.
back:
True.
When light refracts through a glass
block, the first boundary is air-to-glass,
and the second boundary is glass-to-air.
The refracted ray at the air-to-glass
boundary becomes the incident ray at
the glass-to-air boundary.
frontZh: 判断正误：什么时候光 refracts 通过一个玻璃 block， 该入射光线 at 该边界的 玻璃-到-空气是 该射线 inside 该玻璃。
backZh: 正确。 什么时候光 refracts 通过一个玻璃 block， 该第一边界是 空气-到-玻璃， 和该 秒边界是 玻璃-到-空气。 该折射光线 at 该空气-到-玻璃边界 becomes 该入射光线 at 该玻璃-到-空气边界。

front:
Define refractive index. (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
The refractive index is the ratio of the
speed of light in a vacuum and the
speed of light in a material.
frontZh: 定义折射率。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该折射率是 该比值的 该光速在 一个真空和 该光速在 一个材料。

front:
True or False?
The refractive index has no units.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
Since the refractive index is a ratio, it
has no units.
frontZh: 判断正误：该折射率有 no 单位。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 Since 该折射率是 一个比值， 它有 no 单位。

front:
True or False?
When i < r, the refracted ray bends
toward the normal. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
False.
When the angle of incidence i is less
than the angle of refraction r , or i< r,
the refracted ray bends away from the
normal.
frontZh: 判断正误：什么时候 i <r， 该折射光线 bends toward 该法线。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 什么时候该 入射角 i 是小于该 折射角 r， 或 i <r， 该折射光线 bends 远离从 该法线。

front:
State the equation for the refractive
index. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The equation for the refractive index is
n = speed of light in a vacuum
speed of light in material
Where:
n = the refractive index
frontZh: 写出公式对于/为了该 折射率。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: ……的公式为该 折射率是 n = 光速在 一个真空光速在 材料其中： n = 该折射率

front:
True or False?
The value for the refractive index of a
material will always be less than the
speed of light in a vacuum. (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
True.
The value for the refractive index of a
material will always be less than the
speed of light in a vacuum.
frontZh: 判断正误：该数值对于/为了该 折射率的 一个材料将会总是是 小于该 光速在 一个真空。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 该数值对于/为了该 折射率的 一个材料将会总是是 小于该 光速在 一个真空。

front:
What trigonometric function is used in
Snell's Law? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The trigonometric function used in
Snell's Law is sine.
frontZh: 什么 trigonometric function 是使用在 Snell's 定律？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该 trigonometric function 使用在 Snell's 定律是 sine。

front:
True or False?
When i > r, the refracted ray bends
toward the normal. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
True.
When the angle of incidence i is
greater than the angle of refraction r,
or i > r, the refracted ray bends toward
the normal.
frontZh: 判断正误：什么时候 i >r， 该折射光线 bends toward 该法线。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 什么时候该 入射角 i 是大于该 折射角 r， 或 i >r， 该折射光线 bends toward 该法线。

front:
State the equation for Snell's Law in
terms of refractive index. (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
The equation for Snell's law in terms of
the refractive index is n = sin i
sin r
Where:
n = refractive index of the material,
which has no units
i = angle of incidence, measured in
degrees (°)
r = angle of refraction, measured in
degrees (°)
frontZh: 写出公式对于/为了 Snell's 定律用……来表示折射率。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: ……的公式为 Snell's 定律用……来表示该 折射率是 n = sin i sin r 其中： n = 折射率的 该材料， 哪一个有 no 单位 i = 入射角， 单位为度 (°) r = 折射角， 单位为度 (°)

front:
State the angle of incidence shown in
the diagram.
back:
The angle of incidence shown in the
diagram is 39 degrees.
frontZh: 说明该入射角显示的在 该图示。
backZh: 该入射角显示的在 该图示是 39 度。

front:
State the angle of refraction shown in
the diagram.
back:
The angle of incidence shown in the
diagram is 25 degrees.
frontZh: 说明该折射角显示的在 该图示。
backZh: 该入射角显示的在 该图示是 25 度。

front: Define the term critical angle.
back:
The critical angle is the angle of
incidence that gives an angle of
refraction of exactly 90°.
frontZh: 定义该术语临界角。
backZh: 该临界角是 该入射角， gives 一个折射角的 exactly 90°。

front:
When does total internal reflection (TIR)
occur?
back:
Total internal reflection (TIR) occurs
when the angle of incidence is greater
than the critical angle, and the ray is
travelling from a denser material into a
less dense material.
frontZh: 什么时候全内反射 (TIR) 发生？
backZh: 全内反射 (TIR) 发生什么时候该 入射角是 大于该 临界角， 和该 射线是 运动/传播从 一个更密材料进入一个较少致密材料。

front:
How is total internal reflection used in
communications?
back:
Total internal reflection is used to
transmit information through optical
fibre cables for television and internet
communications.
frontZh: ……如何全内反射使用在 communications？
backZh: 全内反射用于 transmit information 通过 optical fibre cables 对于/为了 television 和 internet communications。

front:
What are the two conditions required
for total internal reflection to occur?
back:
The two conditions required for total
internal reflection to occur are:
angle of incidence > critical angle
ray is travelling from a denser
material to a less dense material
frontZh: 该两个 conditions required 对于/为了全内反射到 发生是什么？
backZh: 该两个 conditions required 对于/为了全内反射到 发生是： 入射角 > 临界角射线是 运动/传播从 一个更密材料到 一个较少致密材料

front:
State the equation for the critical angle
in terms of the refractive index.
back:
The equation for the critical angle in
terms of the refractive index is
n = 1
sin c
Where:
n = refractive index, which has no
units
c = critical angle, measured in
degrees (°)
frontZh: 说明……的公式为该 临界角用……来表示该 折射率。
backZh: ……的公式为该 临界角用……来表示该 折射率是 n = 1 sin c 其中： n = 折射率， 哪一个有 no 单位 c = 临界角， 单位为度 (°)

front:
True or False?
A periscope is an example of an
application of total internal reflection.
back:
True.
In a periscope, two right-angled prisms
utilise total internal reflection to reflect
light.
frontZh: 判断正误：一个 periscope 是一个例子的 一个应用的 全内反射。
backZh: 正确。 在一个 periscope， 两个右-angled prisms utilise 全内反射到 reflect 光。

front:
What is the refractive index of a
material?
back:
The refractive index is a measure of the
change in the speed of light as it travels
from a vacuum into a material. The
refractive index is a ratio, so it has no
units, and its value is always greater
than 1.
frontZh: 什么是该折射率的 一个材料？
backZh: 该折射率是对……的度量： 该变化在 该光速 as 它传播从 一个真空进入一个材料。 该折射率是 一个比值， so 它有 no 单位， 和它的数值是 总是大于 1。

front:
True or False?
Total internal reflection can occur when
light travels from a less dense medium
into a denser medium.
back:
False.
Total internal reflection only occurs
when light travels from a denser
material into a less dense material.
frontZh: 判断正误：全内反射可以发生什么时候光 传播从 一个较少致密介质进入一个更密介质。
backZh: 错误。 全内反射只有/仅发生什么时候光 传播从 一个更密材料进入一个较少致密材料。

front:
Describe what happens to the ray of

back:
The behaviour of the light ray at the

total internal reflection (TIR).

backZh: 该 behaviour 的该 光射线 at 该玻璃-液体边界 at X 定义为全内反射 (TIR)。

back:

front: Define the term principal axis.
back:
The principal axis is a line which passes
through the centre of a lens.
frontZh: 定义该术语主轴。
backZh: 该主轴是 一个线 哪一个 passes 通过该 中心的 一个透镜。

front:
Define the term principal focus or
focal point.
back:
The principal focus or focal point, is the
point at which rays of light travelling
parallel to the principal axis intersect
the principal axis and converge at the
point where the diverging rays appear
to proceed.
frontZh: 定义该术语主焦点或 focal 点。
backZh: 该主焦点或 focal 点， 是该 点 at 哪一个射线的 光运动/传播并联到 该主轴 intersect 该主轴和 converge at 该点 其中该 diverging 射线 appear 到 proceed。

front: Define the term focal length.
back:
Focal length is the distance between the
centre of the lens and the principal
focus.
frontZh: 定义该术语焦距。
backZh: 焦距是 该距离在……之间该 中心的 该透镜和 该主焦点。

front: What are the two types of lenses?
back:
The two types of lenses are:
converging lenses (convex)
diverging lenses (concave)
frontZh: 该两个类型的 透镜是什么？
backZh: 该两个类型的 透镜是： converging 透镜 (convex) diverging 透镜 (concave)

front:
True or False?
In a converging lens, parallel rays are
brought to a focus.
back:
True.
In a converging lens, parallel rays are
brought to a focus at a point called the
principal focus.
frontZh: 判断正误：在一个会聚透镜， 并联射线是 brought 到一个 focus。
backZh: 正确。 在一个会聚透镜， 并联射线是 brought 到一个 focus at 一个点 称为该 主焦点。

front:
True or False?
The more curved the converging lens,
the longer the focal length.
back:
False.
The more curved the converging lens is,
the shorter the focal length.
frontZh: 判断正误：该更多弯曲该 会聚透镜， 该更长该 焦距。
backZh: 错误。 该更多弯曲该 会聚透镜是， 该 shorter 该焦距。

front:
True or False?
In a diverging lens, parallel rays are
made to diverge from a point.
back:
True.
In a diverging lens, parallel rays are
made to diverge (spread out) from a
point called the principal focus.
frontZh: 判断正误：在一个发散透镜， 并联射线是 制成到 diverge 从一个点。
backZh: 正确。 在一个发散透镜， 并联射线是 制成到 diverge (分散外/出) 从一个点 称为该 主焦点。

front:
What are the two types of images that
can be produced by lenses?
back:
The two types of images that can be
produced by lenses are:
real images
virtual images
frontZh: 该两个类型的 像， 可以是/被产生由透镜是什么？
backZh: 该两个类型的 像， 可以是/被产生由透镜是： 实像 虚像

front:
True or False?
Real images are always inverted.
back:
True.
Real images are always inverted.
frontZh: 判断正误：实像 是总是 inverted。
backZh: 正确。 实像 是总是 inverted。

front: Define the term real image.
back:
A real image is an image that is formed
when the light rays from an object
converge and meet each other and can
be projected onto a screen.
frontZh: 定义该术语实像。
backZh: 一个实像是 一个像， 是形成什么时候该 光射线从 物体 converge 和 meet 每个其他和 可以是/被 projected 到……上一个 screen。

front:
True or False?
Real images cannot be projected onto a
screen.
back:
False.
Real images can be projected onto a
screen.
frontZh: 判断正误：实像 不能是 projected 到……上一个 screen。
backZh: 错误。 实像 可以是/被 projected 到……上一个 screen。

front: How is a real image produced?
back:
A real image is produced by the
convergence of light toward a focus.
frontZh: ……如何一个实像产生？
backZh: 一个实像是 产生由该 convergence 的光 toward 一个 focus。

front:
True or False?
Virtual images are always upright.
back:
True.
Virtual images are always upright.
frontZh: 判断正误：虚像 是总是 upright。
backZh: 正确。 虚像 是总是 upright。

front: Define the term virtual image.
back:
A virtual image is an image that is
formed when the light rays from an
object do not meet but appear to meet
behind the lens. Virtual images cannot
be projected onto a screen.
frontZh: 定义该术语虚像。
backZh: 一个虚像是 一个像， 是形成什么时候该 光射线从 物体 do 不 meet 但是 appear 到 meet behind 该透镜。 虚像 不能是 projected 到……上一个 screen。

front:
True or False?
Virtual images can be projected onto a
screen.
back:
False.
Virtual images cannot be projected
onto a screen.
frontZh: 判断正误：虚像 可以是/被 projected 到……上一个 screen。
backZh: 错误。 虚像 不能是 projected 到……上一个 screen。

front: How are virtual images formed?
back:
Virtual images are formed by the
divergence of light away from a point.
frontZh: 如何是 虚像 形成？
backZh: 虚像 是形成由该 divergence 的光 远离从 一个点。

front:
True or False?
A converging lens will form a real image
of an object if the object is placed at a
distance less than the focal length of
the lens.
back:
False.
A converging lens will form a real image
of an object if the object is placed at a
distance greater than the focal length
of the lens.
frontZh: 判断正误：一个会聚透镜将会形式一个实像的 物体 if 物体是 放置 at 一个距离小于该 焦距的 该透镜。
backZh: 错误。 一个会聚透镜将会形式一个实像的 物体 if 物体是 放置 at 一个距离大于该 焦距的 该透镜。

front:
True or False?
A converging lens will form a virtual
image of an object if the object is placed
at a distance less than the focal length
of the lens. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
A converging lens will form a virtual
image of an object if the object is placed
at a distance less than the focal length
of the lens.
frontZh: 判断正误：一个会聚透镜将会形式一个虚像的 物体 if 物体是 放置 at 一个距离小于该 焦距的 该透镜。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 一个会聚透镜将会形式一个虚像的 物体 if 物体是 放置 at 一个距离小于该 焦距的 该透镜。

front:
True or False?
Both converging and diverging lenses
are commonly used to correct defects
of sight. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
Both converging and diverging lenses
are commonly used to correct defects
of sight.
frontZh: 判断正误：两者 converging 和 diverging 透镜是 commonly 用于正确 defects 的 sight。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 两者 converging 和 diverging 透镜是 commonly 用于正确 defects 的 sight。

front:
True or False?
Short-sighted vision is caused by the
eye refracting light and bringing it to a
focal point in front of the retina.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
Short-sighted vision is caused by the
eye refracting light and bringing it to a
focal point in front of the retina.
frontZh: 判断正误：短-视力的视觉由……引起： 该 eye refracting 光和 bringing 它到 一个 focal 点在 front 的该 retina。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 短-视力的视觉由……引起： 该 eye refracting 光和 bringing 它到 一个 focal 点在 front 的该 retina。

front:
Which type of lens is used to correct
long-sighted vision? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
Converging lenses are used to correct
long-sighted vision.
frontZh: 哪一个类型的 透镜用于正确长-视力的视觉？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: Converging 透镜用于正确长-视力的视觉。

front:
Which type of lens is used to correct
short-sighted vision? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
Diverging lenses are used to correct
short-sighted vision.
frontZh: 哪一个类型的 透镜用于正确短-视力的视觉？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: Diverging 透镜用于正确短-视力的视觉。

front:
Define the term short-sighted vision.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
People with short-sighted vision can
only see objects which are close to
them, they can not see objects which
are far away.
frontZh: 定义术语短-视力的视觉。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: People 与短-视力的视觉可以只有/仅 see 物体哪一个是 靠近到 它们， 它们可以不 see 物体哪一个是 far 远离。

front:
Define the term long-sighted vision.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
People with long-sighted vision can only
see objects which are far away, they
cannot see objects which are close to
them.
frontZh: 定义术语长-视力的视觉。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: People 与长-视力的视觉可以只有/仅 see 物体哪一个是 far 远离， 它们不能 see 物体哪一个是 靠近到 它们。

front:
True or False?
Long-sighted vision is caused by the eye
refracting light and bringing it to a focal
point behind the retina. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
True.
Long-sighted vision is caused by the eye
refracting light and bringing it to a focal
point behind the retina.
frontZh: 判断正误：长-视力的视觉由……引起： 该 eye refracting 光和 bringing 它到 一个 focal 点 behind 该 retina。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 长-视力的视觉由……引起： 该 eye refracting 光和 bringing 它到 一个 focal 点 behind 该 retina。

front:
True or False?
Convex lenses are used to correct the
vision of short-sighted people.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
False.
Convex or converging lenses are used
to correct the vision of long-sighted
people.
frontZh: 判断正误：Convex 透镜用于正确该 视觉的 短-视力的 people。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 Convex 或 converging 透镜用于正确该 视觉的 长-视力的 people。

front:
True or False?
White light contains all the colours of
the visible spectrum.
back:
True.
White light contains all the colours of
the visible spectrum.
frontZh: 判断正误：白色光 包含所有该 colours 的该 可见光谱。
backZh: 正确。 白色光 包含所有该 colours 的该 可见光谱。

front:
Which spectrum is visible light a small
part of?
back:
Visible light is a small part of the
electromagnetic spectrum.
frontZh: 哪一个光谱是 可见光一个小 part 的？
backZh: 可见光是 一个小 part 的该 电磁波谱。

front:
What object can split white light into its
constituent colours when light passes
through it?
back:
A prism can be used to split white light
into its constituent colours when light is
passed through it.
frontZh: 什么物体可以 split 白色光 进入它的 constituent colours 什么时候光 passes 通过它？
backZh: 一个 prism 可用于 split 白色光 进入它的 constituent colours 什么时候光 是通过通过它。

front:
What is the name given to the process
of splitting white light into its
constituent colours?
back:
The process of splitting white light into
its constituent colours is called
dispersion.
frontZh: 什么是该说出给定的到 该过程的 splitting 白色光 进入它的 constituent colours？
backZh: 该过程的 splitting 白色光 进入它的 constituent colours 称为 dispersion。

front:
What type of wave behaviour causes
dispersion?
back:
Dispersion is caused by the refraction
of light through a prism. Violet light is
refracted the most and red light is
refracted the least.
frontZh: 什么类型的 波 behaviour 导致 dispersion？
backZh: Dispersion 由……引起： 该折射的 光通过一个 prism。 Violet 光是 refracted 该大多数和 red 光是 refracted 该 least。

front:
What are the seven colours that make
up white light?
back:
The seven colours that make up white
light are:
red
orange
yellow
green
blue
indigo
violet
frontZh: 该 seven colours， make 向上白色光是什么？
backZh: 该 seven colours， make 向上白色光 是： red orange yellow green blue indigo violet

front:
Which colour of the spectrum of visible
light has the longest wavelength?
back:
Red light has the longest wavelength of
all the colours in the visible spectrum.
frontZh: 哪一个 colour 的该 光谱的 可见光有 该 longest 波长？
backZh: Red 光有 该 longest 波长的 所有该 colours 在该 可见光谱。

front:
True or False?
Blue light has a longer wavelength than
yellow light.
back:
False.
Blue light has a shorter wavelength
than yellow light.
frontZh: 判断正误：Blue 光有 一个更长波长比 yellow 光。
backZh: 错误。 Blue 光有 一个 shorter 波长比 yellow 光。

front:
True or False?
Orange light has a higher frequency
than violet light.
back:
False.
Orange light has a lower frequency
(and a longer wavelength) than violet
light.
frontZh: 判断正误：Orange 光有 一个更高频率比 violet 光。
backZh: 错误。 Orange 光有 一个更低频率 (和一个更长波长) 比 violet 光。

front:
Define the term monochromatic light.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
Monochromatic light is light with a
single frequency (or wavelength).
frontZh: 定义术语 monochromatic 光。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: Monochromatic 光是 光与一个单一频率 (或波长)。

front: How are sound waves produced?
back:
Sound waves are produced by vibrating
(or oscillating) sources.
frontZh: 声波是如何产生的？
backZh: 声波由振动（或振荡）的声源产生。

front:
What is the name of the region of a
sound wave that contains a lower
density of particles? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
The region of a sound wave that
contains a lower density of particles is
called a rarefaction.
frontZh: ……的名称是什么？ 该区域的 一个声音波， 包含一个更低密度的 粒子？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该区域的 一个声音波， 包含一个更低密度的 粒子称为一个疏部。

front:
True or False?
Sound waves are transverse waves.
back:
False.
Sound waves are longitudinal waves.
frontZh: 判断正误：声波是 横向的波。
backZh: 错误。声波是纵波。

front:
True or False?
Sound waves require a medium to
travel through.
back:
True.
Sound waves are longitudinal waves so
they do require a medium to travel
through.
frontZh: 判断正误：声波需要一个介质到 传播通过。
backZh: 正确。 声波是 longitudinal 波 so 它们 do 需要一个介质到 传播通过。

front:
What is the name of the region of a
sound wave that contains a higher
density of particles? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
The region of a sound wave that
contains a higher density of particles is
called a compression.
frontZh: ……的名称是什么？ 该区域的 一个声音波， 包含一个更高密度的 粒子？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该区域的 一个声音波， 包含一个更高密度的 粒子称为一个密部。

front:
What is the difference between
compressions and rarefactions?
back:
Compressions are regions with a high
density of particles, while rarefactions
are regions with a low density of
particles.
frontZh: 什么是该差异/差值在……之间 compressions 和 rarefactions？
backZh: Compressions 是 regions 与一个高 密度的 粒子， 当……时 rarefactions 是 regions 与一个低 密度的 粒子。

front:
True or False?
Sound is a type of pressure wave.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
Sound is a type of pressure wave
consisting of compressions and
rarefactions, which cause changes in
pressure that vary with the wave.
frontZh: 判断正误：声音是 一个类型的 压强波。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 声音是 一个类型的 压强波 consisting 的 compressions 和 rarefactions， 哪一个导致变化在 压强， vary 与该 波。

front:
True or False?
Sound waves can travel through a
vacuum.
back:
False.
Sound waves require a medium to
travel through, so they cannot travel
through a vacuum where there are no
particles.
frontZh: 判断正误：声波可以传播通过一个真空。
backZh: 错误。 声波需要一个介质到 传播通过， so 它们不能传播通过一个真空其中有 no 粒子。

front:
What happens when sound waves hit a
solid? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
When sound waves hit a solid, the
variations in pressure cause the surface
of the solid to vibrate in sync with the
sound wave.
frontZh: 当……时会发生什么？ 声波 hit 一个固体？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 什么时候声波 hit 一个固体， 该 variations 在压强导致该 表面的 该固体到 振动在 sync 与该 声音波。

front: Define the speed of sound.
back:
The speed of sound is the speed which
sound travels through a particular
medium.
frontZh: 定义该速率的 声音。
backZh: 该速率的 声音是 该速率哪一个声音传播通过一个 particular 介质。

front:
What is the typical speed of sound in air
at room temperature?
back:
The speed of sound in air at room
temperature is about 340 m/s.
frontZh: 什么是该 typical 速率的 声音在 空气 at room 温度？
backZh: 该速率的 声音在 空气 at room 温度是 about 340 m/s。

front:
True or False?
The speed of sound in air varies from
330 – 350 m/s.
back:
True.
The speed of sound in air varies from
330 – 350 m/s, with higher
temperatures leading to a greater
speed of sound.
frontZh: 判断正误：该速率的 声音在 空气 varies 从 330 - 350 m/s。
backZh: 正确。 该速率的 声音在 空气 varies 从 330 - 350 m/s， 与更高 temperatures leading 到一个更大速率的 声音。

front:
Through which state of matter does
sound travel the fastest? (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
Sound travels fastest in solids because
the particles in a solid are closer
together.
frontZh: 通过哪种物态做/会声音传播该 fastest？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 声音传播 fastest 在固体因为该 粒子在 一个固体是 closer 一起。

front:
Through which state of matter does
sound travel the slowest? (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
Sound travels the slowest in gases
because the particles are furthest apart.
frontZh: 通过哪种物态做/会声音传播该 slowest？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 声音传播该 slowest 在气体因为该 粒子是 furthest apart。

front:
True or False?
Measuring the speed of sound using an
oscilloscope is the most accurate
method.
back:
True.
Measuring the speed of sound using an
oscilloscope is the most accurate
method because the timing is done
automatically.
frontZh: 判断正误：Measuring 该速率的 声音使用一个 oscilloscope 是该 大多数 accurate 方法。
backZh: 正确。 Measuring 该速率的 声音使用一个 oscilloscope 是该 大多数 accurate 方法因为该 timing 是完成/做功 automatically。

front:
What is the relationship between the
frequency of a sound wave and its
pitch?
back:
Sounds with a high frequency (or short
wavelength) have a high pitch, and
sounds with a low frequency (or long
wavelength) have a low pitch.
frontZh: 什么是该关系在……之间该 频率的 一个声音波 和它的音调？
backZh: Sounds 与一个高 频率 (或短 波长) 有一个高 音调， 和 sounds 与一个低 频率 (或长 波长) 有一个低 音调。

front:
What is the relationship between the
amplitude of a sound wave and its
volume?
back:
Sounds with a large amplitude have a
high volume, and sounds with a small
amplitude have a low volume.
frontZh: 什么是该关系在……之间该 振幅的 一个声音波 和它的体积？
backZh: Sounds 与一个大 振幅有 一个高 体积， 和 sounds 与一个小 振幅有 一个低 体积。

front:
True or False?
Decreasing the amplitude of a sound
wave will increase its volume.
back:
False.
Decreasing the amplitude of a sound
wave will decrease its volume.
frontZh: 判断正误：Decreasing 该振幅的 一个声音波 将会增大它的体积。
backZh: 错误。 Decreasing 该振幅的 一个声音波 将会减小它的体积。

front:
True or False?
Increasing the frequency of a sound
wave will increase its volume.
back:
False.
Increasing the frequency of a sound
wave will increase its pitch.
frontZh: 判断正误：增大该 频率的 一个声音波 将会增大它的体积。
backZh: 错误。 增大该 频率的 一个声音波 将会增大它的音调。

front:
How do you decrease the pitch of a
soundwave?
back:
Decreasing the frequency of a sound
wave will decrease the pitch of the
sound.
frontZh: ……如何你 减小该 音调的 一个 soundwave？
backZh: Decreasing 该频率的 一个声音波 将会减小该 音调的 该声音。

front:
What effect would increasing the
amplitude of a sound wave have on the
sound?
back:
Increasing the amplitude of a
soundwave would increase the volume
of the sound.
frontZh: 什么效应/影响会 增大该 振幅的 一个声音波 有在 该声音？
backZh: 增大该 振幅的 一个 soundwave 会增大该 体积的 该声音。

front: State the range of human hearing.
back:
The range of human hearing is 20 to 20
000 Hz.
frontZh: 说明该 range 的 human hearing。
backZh: 该 range 的 human hearing 是 20 到 20 000 Hz。

front: Define the term ultrasound.
back:
Ultrasound is the name given to sound
waves with a frequency greater than
20,000 Hz.
frontZh: 定义该术语超声波。
backZh: 超声波是 该说出给定的到 声波与一个频率大于 20，000 Hz。

front:
True or False?
Ultrasound is not audible to humans.
back:
True.
Ultrasound is not audible to humans
because it has a frequency greater than
20,000 Hz, which is beyond the range of
human hearing.
frontZh: 判断正误：超声波是 不 audible 到 humans。
backZh: 正确。 超声波是 不 audible 到 humans 因为它 有一个频率大于 20，000 Hz， 哪一个是 beyond 该 range 的 human hearing。

front:
What happens when ultrasound
reaches a boundary between two
media? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
When ultrasound reaches a boundary
between two media, some of the waves
are partially reflected, while the
remainder are transmitted through the
material.
frontZh: 当……时会发生什么？ 超声波 reaches 一个边界在……之间两个 media？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 什么时候超声波 reaches 一个边界在……之间两个 media， some 的该 波是 partially reflected， 当……时该 remainder 是 transmitted 通过该 材料。

front:
What is the typical range of human
hearing?
back:
Humans can hear sounds between
about 20 Hz and 20,000 Hz in
frequency, although this range
decreases with age.
frontZh: 什么是该 typical range 的 human hearing？
backZh: Humans 可以 hear sounds 在……之间 about 20 Hz 和 20，000 Hz 在频率， although 这 range 减小与 age。

front:
What do ultrasound transducers do?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
Ultrasound transducers emit ultrasound
and receive ultrasound.
frontZh: 什么 do 超声波 transducers do？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 超声波 transducers 发射超声波和 receive 超声波。

front:
What property of ultrasound allows it to
be used for medical and industrial
imaging? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The time taken for ultrasound
reflections to reach a detector can be
used to determine how far away a
boundary is, as ultrasound travels at
different speeds through different
media. This allows ultrasound waves to
be used for both medical and industrial
imaging.
frontZh: 什么性质的 超声波 allows 它到 是使用对于/为了 medical 和 industrial imaging？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该所用时间对于/为了超声波 reflections 到 reach 一个探测器可用于决定如何 far 远离一个边界是， as 超声波传播 at 不同 speeds 通过不同 media。 这 allows 超声波波 到是 使用对于/为了两者 medical 和 industrial imaging。

front:
True or False?
Ultrasound is invasive and potentially
harmful. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
False.
Unlike many other medical imaging
techniques, ultrasound is non-invasive
and is believed to be harmless.
frontZh: 判断正误：超声波是 invasive 和 potentially harmful。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 Unlike many 其他 medical imaging techniques， 超声波是 non-invasive 和是 believed 到是 harmless。

front:
True or False?
Ultrasound can be used to detect cracks
inside metal objects. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
True.
In industry, ultrasound can be used to
check for cracks inside metal objects
and generate images beneath surfaces.
frontZh: 判断正误：超声波可用于 detect cracks inside metal 物体。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 在 industry， 超声波可用于 check 对于/为了 cracks inside metal 物体和 产生像 beneath 表面。

front:
True or False?
Ultrasound can be used to treat kidney
stones. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
Ultrasound can be used as a medical
treatment, such as removing kidney
stones.
frontZh: 判断正误：超声波可用于 treat kidney stones。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 超声波可以是/被使用 as 一个 medical treatment， 例如/这样的 as removing kidney stones。

front:
Can a human hear a sound with a
frequency of 18 kHz?
back:
Yes. Humans can detect sounds with
frequencies in the range of 20 Hz to 20
kHz.
frontZh: 可以一个 human hear 一个声音与一个频率的 18 kHz？
backZh: Yes。 Humans 可以 detect sounds 与 frequencies 在该 range 的 20 Hz 到 20 kHz。

front:
What is the name given to a group of
cells in an electric circuit?
back: A group of cells is called a battery.
frontZh: 什么是该说出给定的到 一个 group 的电池在 一个电路？
backZh: 一个 group 的电池称为一个电池组。

front:
What is the difference between the
circuit symbols for a fixed resistor
a variable resistor?
back:
The symbol for a variable resistor has
and an arrow going through it, whereas the
symbol for a fixed resistor does not.
frontZh: 什么是该差异/差值在……之间该 电路符号对于/为了一个定值电阻器和 一个可变电阻器？
backZh: 该符号对于/为了一个可变电阻器有 一个箭头 going 通过它， 而该 符号对于/为了一个定值电阻器做/会不。

front:
What is the function of a relay in a
circuit?
back:
A relay uses a small current in one
circuit to switch on a much larger
current in another circuit.
frontZh: 什么是该 function 的一个继电器在 一个电路？
backZh: 一个继电器 uses 一个小 电流在 一个电路到 开关在 一个很多更大电流在 另一个电路。

front: What is a thermistor?
back:
A thermistor is a temperature-
dependent resistor.
This means its resistance changes
depending on its temperature.
frontZh: 什么是一个热敏电阻？
backZh: 一个热敏电阻是 一个温度- dependent 电阻器。 这意味着它的电阻变化 depending 在它的温度。

front:
What is the effect of increased
temperature on a thermistor?
back:
When the temperature of a thermistor
is increased, its resistance decreases.
frontZh: 什么是该效应/影响的 增大温度在 一个热敏电阻？
backZh: 什么时候该 温度的 一个热敏电阻是 增大， 它的电阻减小。

front: What does LDR stand for?
back:
LDR stands for light-dependent
resistor.
frontZh: 表示什么光敏电阻 stand 对于/为了？
backZh: 光敏电阻 stands 对于/为了光敏电阻。

front:
What is the effect of increased light
intensity on an LDR?
back:
When light intensity on an LDR is
increased, its resistance decreases.
(Remember: Light Decreases Resistance
- LDR)
frontZh: 什么是该效应/影响的 增大光 intensity 在一个光敏电阻？
backZh: 什么时候光 intensity 在一个光敏电阻是 增大， 它的电阻减小。 (Remember： 光减小电阻 - 光敏电阻)

front:
True or False?
Current is different at different points in
a series circuit.
back:
False.
Current is the same everywhere in a
series circuit.
frontZh: 判断正误：电流是 不同 at 不同点 在一个串联电路。
backZh: 错误。 电流是 该相同 everywhere 在一个串联电路。

front:
True or False?
In a parallel circuit, the current from the
power source is larger than the current
in each branch.
back:
True.
In a parallel circuit, the current from the
power source is larger than the current
in each branch.
frontZh: 判断正误：在一个并联电路， 该电流从 该功率来源是 大于该 电流在 每个 branch。
backZh: 正确。 在一个并联电路， 该电流从 该功率来源是 大于该 电流在 每个 branch。

front:
True or False?
The amount of current flowing in a
series circuit depends on the potential
difference and resistance in the circuit.
back:
True.
The amount of current flowing in any
circuit depends on the potential
difference and resistance in the circuit.
frontZh: 判断正误：该量 的电流 flowing 在一个串联电路取决于该 电势差和 电阻在 该电路。
backZh: 正确。 该量 的电流 flowing 在任何电路取决于该 电势差和 电阻在 该电路。

front:
If the e.m.f. of the power source is
increased, but everything else in the
circuit remains constant, what effect
does this have on the current?
back:
If the e.m.f. (potential difference) of the
power source is increased, but
everything else in the circuit remains
constant, the current will increase.
frontZh: If 该电动势的 该功率来源是 增大， 但是 everything else 在该 电路保持恒定， 什么效应/影响做/会这 有在 该电流？
backZh: If 该电动势 (电势差) 的该 功率来源是 增大， 但是 everything else 在该 电路保持恒定， 该电流将会增大。

front:
If the e.m.f. of the power source
remains constant, but more
components are added to a circuit,
what effect does this have on the
current?
back:
Adding components to a circuit
increases the total resistance of the
circuit, so the current would decrease
(for a constant e.m.f.).
frontZh: If 该电动势的 该功率来源保持恒定， 但是更多元件是 added 到一个电路， 什么效应/影响做/会这 有在 该电流？
backZh: Adding 元件到 一个电路增大该 总电阻的 该电路， so 该电流会 减小 (对于/为了一个恒定电动势)。

front:
True or False?
One advantage of a parallel circuit is
that each bulb can be arranged in its
own branch with its own switch.
back:
True.
One advantage of a parallel circuit is
that each bulb can be arranged in its
own branch with its own switch.
frontZh: 判断正误：一个优点的 一个并联电路是， 每个 bulb 可以是/被 arranged 在它的 own branch 与它的 own 开关。
backZh: 正确。 一个优点的 一个并联电路是， 每个 bulb 可以是/被 arranged 在它的 own branch 与它的 own 开关。

front:
True or False?
One advantage of a series circuit is that
if one component stops working the
others will still work.
back:
False.
An advantage of parallel circuits is that
if components in one branch fail, the
components in other branches will still
work.
If one component fails in a series
circuit, then the circuit is broken and
the current cannot flow.
frontZh: 判断正误：一个优点的 一个串联电路是， if 一个元件 stops working 该 others 将会 still 功。
backZh: 错误。 一个优点的 并联 circuits 是， if 元件在 一个 branch fail， 该元件在 其他 branches 将会 still 功。 If 一个元件 fails 在一个串联电路， 然后该 电路是 broken 和该 电流不能流动。

front:
True or False?
Current is conserved at a junction in a
parallel circuit. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
Current is conserved at a junction in a
parallel circuit because charge is always
conserved.
frontZh: 判断正误：电流是 conserved at 一个 junction 在一个并联电路。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 电流是 conserved at 一个 junction 在一个并联电路因为电荷是 总是 conserved。

front:
True or False?
Current always splits equally at a
junction in a parallel circuit. (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
False.
Current will only split equally at a
junction if the resistance in each
branch is equal.
frontZh: 判断正误：电流总是 splits equally at 一个 junction 在一个并联电路。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 电流将会只有/仅 split equally at 一个 junction if 该电阻在 每个 branch 是相等。

front:
True or False?
When several cells are connected in
series, their combined e.m.f. is the
product of their individual e.m.f.s.
back:
False.
When several cells are connected in
series, their combined e.m.f. is the sum
of their individual e.m.f.s.
frontZh: 判断正误：什么时候 several 电池是 连接在 串联， 它们的合成的电动势是 该乘积的 它们的 individual e。m。f。s。
backZh: 错误。 什么时候 several 电池是 连接在 串联， 它们的合成的电动势是 该 sum 的它们的 individual e。m。f。s。

front:
What is the rule for determining the
potential difference in a series circuit?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
The total potential difference across
the components in a series circuit is
equal to the sum of the individual
potential differences across each
component.
frontZh: 什么是该 定则对于/为了 determining 该电势差在 一个串联电路？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该总 电势差跨过/两端该 元件在 一个串联电路是 相等到 该 sum 的该 individual 电势 differences 跨过/两端每个元件。

front:
What is the rule for determining the
potential difference in a parallel circuit?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
The potential difference across an
arrangement of parallel resistances is
the same as the potential difference
across one branch in the arrangement
of the parallel resistances.
frontZh: 什么是该 定则对于/为了 determining 该电势差在 一个并联电路？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该电势差跨过/两端一个 arrangement 的并联 resistances 是与……相同该 电势差跨过/两端一个 branch 在该 arrangement 的该 并联 resistances。

front:
What is the rule for calculating the
combined resistance of two or more
resistors in series?
back:
When two or more resistors are
connected in series, the combined
resistance is the sum of the individual
resistances.
frontZh: 什么是该定则对于/为了计算该 合成的电阻的 两个或 更多电阻器在 串联？
backZh: 什么时候两个或 更多电阻器是 连接在 串联， 该合成的电阻是 该 sum 的该 individual resistances。

front:
True or False?
The combined resistance of two
resistors in parallel is less than that of
either resistor by itself.
back:
True.
The combined resistance of two
resistors in parallel is less than that of
either resistor by itself.
frontZh: 判断正误：该合成的电阻的 两个电阻器在 并联是 小于， 的任一/两者之一电阻器由 itself。
backZh: 正确。 该合成的电阻的 两个电阻器在 并联是 小于， 的任一/两者之一电阻器由 itself。

back:
The equation for the combined

front:
What is the function of a potential
divider? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
A potential divider splits the potential
difference of a power source between
two components.
frontZh: ……的作用是什么？ 一个电势 divider？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 一个电势 divider splits 该电势差的 一个功率来源在……之间两个元件。

front:
True or False?
When a potential divider is used in a
circuit, the resistor with the largest
resistance will have a greater potential
difference across it. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
True.
When a potential divider is used in a
circuit, the resistor with the largest
resistance will have a greater
potential difference across it.
frontZh: 判断正误：什么时候一个电势 divider 是使用在 一个电路， 该电阻器与该 largest 电阻将会有 一个更大电势差跨过/两端它。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 什么时候一个电势 divider 是使用在 一个电路， 该电阻器与该 largest 电阻将会有 一个更大电势差跨过/两端它。

front:
What is a potentiometer? (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
A potentiometer is a type of variable
resistor consisting of a coil of wire and
sliding contact.
frontZh: 什么是一个 potentiometer？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 一个 potentiometer 是一个类型的 可变电阻器 consisting 的一个线圈的 导线和 sliding 接触。

front:
Give one application of a potential
divider. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
Examples of applications of potential
dividers include:
volume controls
sensory circuits using LDRs
sensory circuits using thermistors
frontZh: Give 一个应用的 一个电势 divider。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 例子的 应用的 电势 dividers include： 体积 controls sensory circuits 使用 LDRs sensory circuits 使用 thermistors
