front:
What hazard does damaged insulation
on a wire pose?
back:
Exposed wires can cause electric
shocks if touched.
frontZh: 什么 hazard 做/会 damaged insulation 在一个导线 pose？
backZh: Exposed 导线可以引起电的 shocks if touched。

front:
What hazard does the overheating of
cables pose?
back:
Overheating of cables could lead to
melting of the insulation and exposing
the wires, or fires .
frontZh: 什么 hazard 做/会该 overheating 的 cables pose？
backZh: Overheating 的 cables could 导致/铅到 熔化的 该 insulation 和 exposing 该导线， 或 fires。

front:
Why is it dangerous to use electrical
circuits in damp conditions?
back:
Moisture can conduct electricity, so
using electric circuits in damp
conditions could lead to electric
shocks, or short circuits which may
damage the appliance or even start a
fire.
frontZh: 为什么它 dangerous 到 use 电的 circuits 在 damp conditions？
backZh: Moisture 可以 conduct 电能/电学， so 使用电的 circuits 在 damp conditions could 导致/铅到 电的 shocks， 或短 circuits 哪一个 may 损伤该 appliance 或 even start 一个 fire。

front:
Why is it dangerous to overload plugs,
extension leads and multiple sockets
when using the mains supply?
back:
If plug sockets are overloaded it can
lead to overheating which can cause
melting or even fires.
frontZh: 为什么它 dangerous 到 overload plugs， 伸长量 leads 和 multiple sockets 什么时候使用该 mains supply？
backZh: If plug sockets 是 overloaded 它可以导致/铅到 overheating 哪一个可以引起熔化或 even fires。

front:
True or False?
Mains circuits consist of a live wire, a
neutral wire and an earth wire.
back:
True.
Mains circuits do consist of a live wire, a
neutral wire and an earth wire.
frontZh: 判断正误：Mains circuits consist 的一个火线， 一个零线和 一个接地线。
backZh: 正确。 Mains circuits do consist 的一个火线， 一个零线和 一个接地线。

front:
What circuit component must be
connected to the live wire in order for
the circuit to be turned off safely?
back:
A switch must be connected to the live
wire in order for the circuit to be turned
off safely.
frontZh: 什么电路元件必须是 连接到 该火线在 顺序对于/为了该 电路到 是 turned off safely？
backZh: 一个开关必须是 连接到 该火线在 顺序对于/为了该 电路到 是 turned off safely。

front:
Why does the casing of an electrical
appliance have to be either non-
conducting or earthed?
back:
The casing of an electrical appliance
must be either non-conducting or
earthed to prevent the casing from
becoming electrified and causing an
electric shock to anyone who touches
it.
frontZh: 为什么该 casing 的一个电的 appliance 有到 是任一/两者之一 non- 导电或 earthed？
backZh: 该 casing 的一个电的 appliance 必须是 任一/两者之一 non-导电或 earthed 到 prevent 该 casing 从 becoming electrified 和 causing 一个电的 shock 到 anyone 谁 touches 它。

front: What is the purpose of a fuse?
back:
A fuse is a safety device designed to
break the circuit if the current exceeds
a certain amount.
frontZh: 什么是该目的 一个保险丝？
backZh: 一个保险丝是 一个 safety 装置 designed 到 break 该电路 if 该电流 exceeds 一个 certain 量。

front: What is the function of a trip switch?
back:
A trip switch is a switch on the
consumer unit that will break the
circuit if the current exceeds a certain
amount.
frontZh: 什么是该 function 的一个 trip 开关？
backZh: 一个 trip 开关是 一个开关在 该 consumer 单位， 将会 break 该电路 if 该电流 exceeds 一个 certain 量。

front:
True or False?
A fuse without an earth wire protects
the circuit and the cabling for a double-
insulated appliance.
back:
True.
A fuse without an earth wire protects
the circuit and the cabling for a double-
insulated appliance.
frontZh: 判断正误：一个保险丝没有一个接地线 protects 该电路和 该 cabling 对于/为了一个 double- insulated appliance。
backZh: 正确。 一个保险丝没有一个接地线 protects 该电路和 该 cabling 对于/为了一个 double- insulated appliance。

front:
How many types of electric charge are
there?
back:
There are two types of electric charge:
positive and negative.
frontZh: 电荷有几种类型？
backZh: 有两个类型的 电荷： 正和 负。

front: Define electric charge.
back:
Electric charge is a property of matter
that causes it to experience
electromagnetic forces.
frontZh: 定义电荷。
backZh: 电荷是 一个性质的 物质， 导致它 到经历/受到电磁的力。

front:
True or False?
Opposite charges attract.
back:
True.
Opposite charges attract.
frontZh: 判断正误：异种电荷吸引。
backZh: 正确。异种电荷相互吸引。

front:
What happens when two like charges
are brought close together?
back:
When two like charges are brought
close together, they repel each other.
frontZh: 当……时会发生什么？ 两个同种电荷是 brought 靠近一起？
backZh: 什么时候两个同种电荷是 brought 靠近一起， 它们相互排斥。

front:
What does the saying "opposites-
attract" refer to in the context of
charges?
back:
The saying "opposites attract" refers to
the principle that opposite charges are
attracted to each other.
frontZh: 表示什么该 saying "opposites- 吸引" refer 到在 该 context 的电荷？
backZh: 该 saying "异性相吸" 指的是到 该 principle， 异种电荷是 attracted 到每个其他。

front:
What units are electric charges
measured in? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
Electric charges are measured in units
called coulombs (C).
frontZh: 电荷的单位是什么？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 电荷的单位称为库仑 (C)。

front: Define electrostatic repulsion.
back:
Electrostatic repulsion is the
phenomenon where like charges in an
electric field exert a force on one
another which pushes them apart.
frontZh: 定义electrostatic repulsion。
backZh: Electrostatic repulsion 是该 phenomenon 其中同种电荷在 一个电场 exert 一个力 在一个另一个哪一个 pushes 它们 apart。

front: What causes electrostatic repulsion?
back:
Electrostatic repulsion is caused by the
force between charges in an electric
field. When these charges are the same
the charges repel each other.
frontZh: 什么导致 electrostatic repulsion？
backZh: Electrostatic repulsion 由……引起： 该力 在……之间电荷在 一个电场。 什么时候这些电荷是 该相同该 电荷相互排斥。

front:
What experiment can be used to
demonstrate the production of
electrostatic charges by friction?
back:
The experiment used to demonstrate
the production of electrostatic charges
by friction involves:
Suspending an insulating material
Rubbing it with a cloth to transfer
electrons from the surface
Observing its interaction with
another charged material
frontZh: 什么实验可用于 demonstrate 该 production 的 electrostatic 电荷由摩擦？
backZh: 该实验用于 demonstrate 该 production 的 electrostatic 电荷由摩擦 involves： Suspending 一个绝缘材料 Rubbing 它与一个 cloth 到转移电子从 该表面 Observing 它的 interaction 与另一个带电材料

front: Define the term insulating solids.
back:
Insulating solids are materials that do
not conduct electricity easily and can
hold a static charge. Plastics are an
example of an insulating solid.
frontZh: 定义该术语绝缘固体。
backZh: 绝缘固体是 材料， do 不 conduct 电能/电学 easily 和可以 hold 一个 static 电荷。 Plastics 是一个例子的 一个绝缘固体。

front:
What is the purpose of rubbing
insulating solids with a cloth in
electrostatic experiments?
back:
The purpose of rubbing insulating solids
with a cloth in electrostatic experiments
is to transfer electrons between the
cloth and the insulator leaving them
with opposing net charges.
frontZh: 什么是该目的 rubbing 绝缘固体与一个 cloth 在 electrostatic experiments？
backZh: 该目的 rubbing 绝缘固体与一个 cloth 在 electrostatic experiments 是到 转移电子在……之间该 cloth 和该 绝缘体 leaving 它们与 opposing net 电荷。

front:
How can you determine if two charged
materials have the same charge?
back:
You can determine if two charged
materials have the same charge by
observing their interaction.
If they repel each other, they have
the same charge
If they attract, they have opposite
charges
frontZh: 怎样可以你 决定 if 两个带电材料有 该相同电荷？
backZh: 你可以决定 if 两个带电材料有 该相同电荷由 observing 它们的 interaction。 If 它们相互排斥， 它们有 该相同电荷 If 它们吸引， 它们有 异种电荷

front:
Define electric field. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
An electric field is the region
surrounding a charged object where
other charges will experience a force.
Field lines always point away from
positive charges and towards negative
charges.
frontZh: 定义电场。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 一个电场是 该区域 surrounding 一个带电物体其中其他电荷将会经历/受到一个力。 场线总是点 远离从 正电荷和 朝向负 电荷。

front:
What does the direction of electric field
lines represent? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The direction of electric field lines
shows the direction a positive charge
would move if placed at that point.
frontZh: 表示什么该 方向的 电场 lines 表示？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该方向的 电场 lines 显示该 方向一个正电荷会 移动 if 放置 at， 点。

front:
Describe how the strength of an electric
field changes with distance away from a
charged object. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The strength of an electric field
decreases with distance from a charged
object.
frontZh: 描述如何该 强度的 一个电场变化与距离远离从 一个带电物体。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该强度的 一个电场减小与距离从 一个带电物体。

front:
Define a uniform electric field .
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
A uniform electric field is when the field
strength is constant and the field
lines are parallel and straight.
frontZh: 定义一个均匀电场。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 一个均匀电场是 什么时候该 场强度是 恒定和 该场线是 并联和 直。

front:
Describe the properties of field lines
around a point charge. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
The properties of field lines around a
point charge are:
They extend radially outward
(away) from a positive charge and
radially inward (toward) a negative
charge.
They indicate the direction of the
force on a positively charged
particle at any given point in the
field.
frontZh: 描述该 性质的 场线周围一个点 电荷。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该性质的 场线周围一个点 电荷是： 它们 extend radially outward (远离) 从一个正电荷和 radially inward (toward) 一个负电荷。 它们 indicate 该方向的 该力 在一个 positively 带电粒子 at 任何给定的点 在该 场。

front:
What is the nature of the electric field
between two parallel plates? (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
The electric field between two parallel
plates is uniform, with field lines
directed from the positive to the
negative plate. The lines are parallel
and straight.
frontZh: 什么是该 nature 的该 电场在……之间两个并联 plates？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该电场在……之间两个并联 plates 是均匀， 与场线 directed 从该 正到 该负 plate。 该 lines 是并联和 直。

front:
What causes the symmetry of field lines
around a charged conducting sphere?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
The symmetry of field lines around a
charged conducting sphere is due to the
even distribution of charges on the
sphere's surface, resulting in
symmetrical repulsion.
frontZh: 什么导致该 symmetry 的场线周围一个带电导电 sphere？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该 symmetry 的场线周围一个带电导电 sphere 是由于该 even distribution 的电荷在 该 sphere's 表面， 导致在 symmetrical repulsion。

front:
True or False?
Electric fields always point towards
positive charges. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
False.
Electric fields always point away from
positive charges and towards negative
charges.
frontZh: 判断正误：电的 fields 总是点 朝向正 电荷。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 电的 fields 总是点 远离从 正电荷和 朝向负 电荷。

front:
True or False?
Conductors allow charge to move freely.
back:
True.
Conductors allow charge, usually
electrons, to move freely through them.
frontZh: 判断正误：导体 allow 电荷到 移动 freely。
backZh: 正确。 导体 allow 电荷， usually 电子， 到移动 freely 通过它们。

front: Define the term conductor.
back:
Conductors are materials that permit
the flow of charge, typically electrons,
with ease.
frontZh: 定义该术语导体。
backZh: 导体是 材料， permit 该流动的 电荷， 通常电子， 与 ease。

front:
True or False?
Metals are generally good insulators.
back:
False.
Metals are generally excellent
conductors due to their ability to
facilitate the flow of charge.
frontZh: 判断正误：Metals 是 generally good insulators。
backZh: 错误。 Metals 是 generally excellent 导体由于它们的 ability 到 facilitate 该流动的 电荷。

front:
True or False?
Copper is an example of a conductor.
back:
True.
Copper is an example of conductor.
Most electrical wiring is made of copper.
frontZh: 判断正误：Copper 是一个例子的 一个导体。
backZh: 正确。 Copper 是一个例子的 导体。 大多数电的 wiring 是制成的 copper。

front:
What is the key difference between
conductors and insulators?
back:
The key difference between conductors
and insulators lies in their ability to
allow charge to move.
Conductors allow the movement of
charge, while insulators prevent it.
frontZh: 什么是该 key 差异/差值在……之间导体和 insulators？
backZh: 该 key 差异/差值在……之间导体和 insulators lies 在它们的 ability 到 allow 电荷到 移动。 导体 allow 该 movement 的电荷， 当……时 insulators prevent 它。

front:
State the properties of metal
conductors on an atomic scale.
back:
The properties of metal conductors on
an atomic scale are:
have a lattice structure (of metal
ions)
free (delocalised) electrons.
frontZh: 说明该性质的 metal 导体在 一个 atomic 刻度。
backZh: 该性质的 metal 导体在 一个 atomic 刻度是： 有一个 lattice structure (的 metal 离子) free (delocalised) 电子。

front: What are insulators?
back:
Insulators are materials that prevent
the flow of charge and instead
accumulate a build up of static charge.
frontZh: insulators是什么？
backZh: Insulators 是材料， prevent 该流动的 电荷和 instead accumulate 一个 build 向上的 static 电荷。

front:
How can you distinguish between
conductors and insulators using a gold-
leaf electroscope?
back:
You can distinguish between
conductors and insulators using a gold-
leaf electroscope by:
Charging the plate of the gold-leaf
electroscope and then touching it
with the material being tested.
If the gold leaf falls, the material is a
good conductor.
If it remains in place, the material is
a poor conductor or insulator.
frontZh: 怎样可以你 distinguish 在……之间导体和 insulators 使用一个金- leaf electroscope？
backZh: 你可以 distinguish 在……之间导体和 insulators 使用一个金- leaf electroscope 由： Charging 该 plate 的该 金-leaf electroscope 和然后 touching 它与该 材料被 tested。 If 该金 leaf 下落， 该材料是 一个 good 导体。 If 它保持在 位置/发生， 该材料是 一个 poor 导体或 绝缘体。

front:
What happens to the plate, rod and
gold leaf when the gold leaf
electroscope is charged?
back:
When the gold leaf electroscope is
charged the plate, rod and gold leaf all
have the same charge so they repel
each other and the gold leaf sticks out
to the side.
frontZh: 什么发生到 该 plate， rod 和金 leaf 什么时候该 金 leaf electroscope 是带电？
backZh: 什么时候该 金 leaf electroscope 是带电该 plate， rod 和金 leaf 所有有 该相同电荷 so 它们相互排斥和 该金 leaf sticks 外/出到 该侧。

front: Define current.
back:
Current is the amount of charge
passing a fixed point per unit time.
frontZh: 定义电流。
backZh: 电流是 该量 的电荷 passing 一个固定点 每单位时间。

front:
What is the equation for charge,
current, and time?
back:
The equation for charge, current, and
time is: Q = It
Where:
I = current, measured in amperes
(A)
Q = charge, measured in coulombs
(C)
t= time, measured in seconds (s)
frontZh: 什么是……的公式为电荷， 电流， 和时间？
backZh: ……的公式为电荷， 电流， 和时间是： Q = 它其中： I = 电流， 单位为安培 (一个) Q = 电荷， 单位为库仑 (C) t= 时间， 单位为秒 (s)

front: What is the purpose of an ammeter?
back:
The purpose of an ammeter is to
measure the current in a circuit.
frontZh: 什么是该目的 一个电流表？
backZh: 该目的 一个电流表是 到测量该 电流在 一个电路。

front:
True or False?
Ammeters should be connected in
parallel to measure current.
back:
False.
Ammeters should be connected in
series.
frontZh: 判断正误：Ammeters 应该是 连接在 并联到 测量电流。
backZh: 错误。 Ammeters 应该是 连接在 串联。

front:
What is conventional current?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
Conventional current is the direction
that positive charge would flow around
a circuit, from the positive terminal to
the negative terminal.
frontZh: 什么是传统电流方向？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 传统电流方向是 该方向， 正电荷会 流动周围一个电路， 从该 正接线端到 该负 接线端。

front:
How is electron flow different to
conventional current? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
Electrons flow around a circuit from the
negative terminal to the positive
terminal. This is the opposite direction
to conventional current.
frontZh: ……如何电子流动不同到 传统电流方向？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 电子流动周围一个电路从 该负 接线端到 该正 接线端。 这是 该相反方向到 传统电流方向。

front:
True or False?
Conventional current flows from
negative to positive. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
False. Conventional current is defined
as flowing from positive to negative,
even though electrons (negatively
charged) actually move in the opposite
direction.
frontZh: 判断正误：传统电流方向 flows 从负 到正。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 传统电流方向定义为 flowing 从正 到负， even though 电子 (negatively 带电) actually 移动在 该相反方向。

front:
Which is most accurate, a digital or
analogue ammeter?
back:
A digital ammeter is more accurate than
an analogue ammeter because it has a
greater sensitivity, a larger range and
gives a definite numerical value.
frontZh: 哪一个是 大多数 accurate， 一个 digital 或 analogue 电流表？
backZh: 一个 digital 电流表是 更多 accurate 比一个 analogue 电流表因为它 有一个更大 sensitivity， 一个更大 range 和 gives 一个 definite numerical 数值。

front: What is direct current (d.c.)?
back:
Direct current flows in one direction
only.
frontZh: 什么是直流电 (d。c。)？
backZh: 直流电 flows 在一个方向只有/仅。

front: What is alternating current (a.c.)?
back:
Alternating current continuously
changes direction.
frontZh: 什么是交流电 (一个。c。)？
backZh: 交流电 continuously 变化方向。

front:
How can you distinguish between direct
and alternating current?
back:
You can distinguish between direct and
alternating current because:
direct current flows continuously
in one direction, typically from
negative to positive terminals
alternating current periodically
changes direction
frontZh: 怎样可以你 distinguish 在……之间 direct 和交流电？
backZh: 你可以 distinguish 在……之间 direct 和交流电因为： 直流电 flows continuously 在一个方向， 通常从 负到 正接线端交流电 periodically 变化方向

front: Sketch the graphs for d.c. and a.c.
back: The graphs for d.c. and a.c. are
frontZh: 画出草图该 graphs 对于/为了 d。c。 和一个。c。
backZh: 该 graphs 对于/为了 d。c。 和一个。c。 是

front:
True or False?
Cells and batteries are sources of d.c.
back:
True.
Cells and batteries are sources of d.c.
frontZh: 判断正误：电池和 batteries 是来源的 d。c。
backZh: 正确。 电池和 batteries 是来源的 d。c。

front:
True or False?
An a.c. power source involves a positive
and negative terminal.
back:
False.
An a.c. power source involves two
identical terminals.
frontZh: 判断正误：一个一个。c。 功率来源 involves 一个正 和负 接线端。
backZh: 错误。 一个一个。c。 功率来源 involves 两个 identical 接线端。

front:
True or False?
Electromotive force (e.m.f.) is the
potential difference of the power
source in a circuit.
back:
True.
Electromotive force (e.m.f.) refers to the
potential difference of the power source
in a circuit.
frontZh: 判断正误：Electromotive 力 (电动势) 是该 电势差的 该功率来源在 一个电路。
backZh: 正确。 Electromotive 力 (电动势) 指的是到 该电势差的 该功率来源在 一个电路。

front: Define electromotive force (e.m.f.).
back:
Electromotive force (e.m.f.) is defined as
the electrical work done by the power
source in moving a unit charge around a
complete circuit. It is measured in volts
(V).
frontZh: 定义electromotive 力 (电动势)。
backZh: Electromotive 力 (电动势) 定义为该 电的做功由该 功率来源在 运动一个单位电荷周围一个完成电路。 它的单位是伏特 (V)。

front:
What is the equation for electromotive
force (e.m.f.)? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The equation for electromotive force
(e.m.f.) is: E = W
Q
Where:
E = electromotive force, measured
in volts (V)
W = energy supplied from the
power source, measured in joules
(J)
Q = charge, measured in coulombs
(C)
frontZh: 公式是什么？ electromotive 力 (电动势)？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: ……的公式为 electromotive 力 (电动势) 是： E = W Q 其中： E = electromotive 力， 单位为伏特 (V) W= 能量 supplied 从该 功率来源， 单位为焦耳 (J) Q = 电荷， 单位为库仑 (C)

front: Define potential difference .
back:
Potential difference is the the work
done by a unit charge passing through a
component.
frontZh: 定义电势差。
backZh: 电势差是 该该 做功由一个单位电荷 passing 通过一个元件。

front:
True or False?
Potential difference is measured in
amperes.
back:
False.
Potential difference is measured in
volts (V).
frontZh: 判断正误：电势差的单位是安培。
backZh: 错误。 电势差的单位是伏特 (V)。

front: What is a voltmeter?
back:
A voltmeter is a device used to measure
the potential difference between two
points in an electrical circuit.
frontZh: 什么是一个电压表？
backZh: 一个电压表是 一个装置用于测量该 电势差在……之间两个点 在一个电的电路。

front:
True or False?
Voltmeters are connected in series with
the component being tested.
back:
False.
Voltmeters are connected in parallel
with the component being tested.
frontZh: 判断正误：Voltmeters 是连接在 串联与该 元件被 tested。
backZh: 错误。 Voltmeters 是连接在 并联与该 元件被 tested。

front:
What is the equation for potential
difference (p.d.), charge and work done?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
The equation for potential difference
(p.d.), charge and work done is:
V = W
Q
Where:
V = potential difference, measured
in volts (V)
W = energy transferred to the
components, measured in joules (J)
Q = charge on each charge carrier,
measured in coulombs (C)
frontZh: 公式是什么？ 电势差 (p。d。)， 电荷和 做功？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: ……的公式为电势差 (p。d。)， 电荷和 做功是： V = W Q 其中： V = 电势差， 单位为伏特 (V) W= 能量转移到 该元件， 单位为焦耳 (J) Q = 电荷在 每个电荷 carrier， 单位为库仑 (C)

front:
True or False?
Resistance is a measure of how difficult
it is for current to pass through a
conductor or component.
back:
True.
Resistance is a measure of how difficult
it is for current to pass through a
conductor or component.
frontZh: 判断正误：电阻是对……的度量： 如何 difficult 它是 对于/为了电流到 通过通过一个导体或 元件。
backZh: 正确。 电阻是对……的度量： 如何 difficult 它是 对于/为了电流到 通过通过一个导体或 元件。

front: Define Ohm's law.
back:
Ohm's Law states that the current
flowing through a conductor is directly
proportional to the potential difference
across the conductor.
frontZh: 定义欧姆's 定律。
backZh: 欧姆's 定律说明， 该电流 flowing 通过一个导体与……成正比： 该电势差跨过/两端该 导体。

front: What is the equation for Ohm's law?
back:
The equation for Ohm's law is: V = IR
Where:
R = resistance, measured in ohms
(Ω)
V = potential difference, measured
in volts (V)
I = current, measured in amperes
(A)
frontZh: 什么是……的公式为欧姆's 定律？
backZh: ……的公式为欧姆's 定律是： V = IR 其中： R = 电阻， 单位为欧姆 (Ω) V = 电势差， 单位为伏特 (V) I = 电流， 单位为安培 (一个)

front:
True or False?
The unit of resistance is volts.
back:
False.
The unit of resistance is the ohm,
represented by the Greek symbol
omega (Ω).
frontZh: 判断正误：该单位的 电阻是 伏特。
backZh: 错误。 该单位的 电阻是 该欧姆， 表示为由该 Greek 符号 omega (Ω)。

front:
What is an I-V graph? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
An I-V graph, or current-voltage graph,
is a graphical representation of the
relationship between the current
flowing through a component and the
potential difference across it. It shows
how the current changes with potential
difference.
frontZh: 什么是一个 I-V 图像？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 一个 I-V 图像， 或电流-电压图像， 是一个 graphical representation 的该 关系在……之间该 电流 flowing 通过一个元件和 该电势差跨过/两端它。 它显示如何该 电流变化与电势差。

front:
What is the shape of the I-V graph for a
fixed resistor? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The shape of the I-V graph for a fixed
resistor is a straight line passing
through the origin, indicating that the
current is directly proportional to the
potential difference.
frontZh: 什么是该 形状的 该 I-V 图像对于/为了一个定值电阻器？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该形状的 该 I-V 图像对于/为了一个定值电阻器是 一个直 线 passing 通过该 origin， indicating， 该电流与……成正比： 该电势差。

front:
True or False?
A diode is a non-ohmic conductor.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
A diode is a non-ohmic conductor. This
means current and potential difference
are not directly proportional.
frontZh: 判断正误：一个二极管是 一个 non-欧姆性的导体。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 一个二极管是 一个 non-欧姆性的导体。 这意味着电流和 电势差是 不正比地成比例。

front:
What is the unique characteristic of a
diode's I-V graph? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The unique characteristic of an I-V
graph for a diode is a sharp increase in
current when it is in forward bias, and a
flat line indicating zero current when it
is in reverse bias.
frontZh: 什么是该 unique characteristic 的一个二极管's I-V 图像？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该 unique characteristic 的一个 I-V 图像对于/为了一个二极管是 一个 sharp 增大在 电流什么时候它 是在 向前 bias， 和一个平的线 indicating 零电流什么时候它 是在 reverse bias。

front: Define the resistance of a wire.
back:
The resistance of a wire is the
opposition encountered by electrons as
they pass through a wire due to
collisions with metal ions. It is a
measure of how difficult it is for current
to flow through the wire.
frontZh: 定义该电阻的 一个导线。
backZh: 该电阻的 一个导线是 该 opposition encountered 由电子 as 它们通过通过一个导线由于 collisions 与 metal 离子。 它是对……的度量： 如何 difficult 它是 对于/为了电流到 流动通过该 导线。

front:
How does the length of a wire affect its
resistance? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The resistance of a wire is directly
proportional to its length. This means
that as the length of the wire increases,
its resistance also increases by the
same factor.
frontZh: ……如何该 长度的 一个导线影响它的电阻？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该电阻的 一个导线与……成正比： 它的长度。 这意味着， as 该长度的 该导线增大， 它的电阻也 增大由该 相同因素。

front:
How does the cross-sectional area of a
wire affect its resistance? (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
The resistance of a wire is inversely
proportional to its cross-sectional area.
As the wire's cross-sectional area
(thickness) increases, its resistance
decreases, and vice versa.
frontZh: ……如何该 交叉/横截面-sectional 面积的 一个导线影响它的电阻？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该电阻的 一个导线与……成反比： 它的交叉/横截面-sectional 面积。 As 该导线's 交叉/横截面-sectional 面积 (thickness) 增大， 它的电阻减小， 反之亦然。

front:
True or False?
If a wire is thicker, its resistance is
greater. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
False.
If a wire is thicker (greater diameter), its
resistance is less.
frontZh: 判断正误：If 一个导线是 thicker， 它的电阻是 更大。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 If 一个导线是 thicker (更大 diameter)， 它的电阻是 较少。

front:
True or False?
If a wire is longer, its resistance is
higher. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
If a wire is longer, its resistance is higher
because each electron will collide with
more ions along the wire's length,
resulting in a greater opposition to the
flow of electrons.
frontZh: 判断正误：If 一个导线是 更长， 它的电阻是 更高。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 If 一个导线是 更长， 它的电阻是 更高因为每个电子将会碰撞与更多离子 along 该导线's 长度， 导致在 一个更大 opposition 到该 流动的 电子。

front:
If the length of a wire is increased by a
factor of 3, what is the effect on its
resistance? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The resistance of a wire is directly
proportional to its length, so if the
length is increased by a factor of 3, the
resistance will increase by a factor of 3.
frontZh: If 该长度的 一个导线是 增大由一个因素的 3， 什么是该 效应/影响在 它的电阻？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该电阻的 一个导线与……成正比： 它的长度， so if 该长度是 增大由一个因素的 3， 该电阻将会增大由一个因素的 3。

front:
If the cross-sectional area of a wire is
halved what is the effect on its
resistance? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The resistance of a wire is inversely
proportional to its cross-sectional area,
therefore if its cross-sectional area is
halved, its resistance will double.
frontZh: If 该交叉/横截面-sectional 面积的 一个导线是 halved 什么是该 效应/影响在 它的电阻？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该电阻的 一个导线与……成反比： 它的交叉/横截面-sectional 面积， 因此 if 它的交叉/横截面-sectional 面积是 halved， 它的电阻将会 double。

front: Define electrical energy.
back:
Electrical energy is the energy
transferred by an electric current.
This is typically from a power source to
the components connected in an
electrical circuit, where it is transformed
into other stores of energy, such as
thermal or kinetic energy.
frontZh: 定义电的能量。
backZh: 电的能量是 该能量转移由一个电的电流。 这是 通常从 一个功率来源到 该元件连接在 一个电的电路， 其中它 是 transformed 进入其他 stores 的能量， 例如/这样的 as 热的或 动能。

front:
True or False?
Energy transferred in a circuit is related
to potential difference, current, and
time. as described by the equation
back:
True.
Potential difference, current, and time
are related in electrical energy transfer,
E = V × I × t .
frontZh: 判断正误：能量转移在 一个电路是 related 到电势差， 电流， 和时间。
backZh: 正确。 电势差， 电流， 和时间是 related 在电的能量转移， as described 由该 公式 E = V × I × t。

front: What is the electrical energy equation?
back:
The electrical energy equation is:
E = V × I × t
Where:
E = electrical energy transferred,
measured in joules (J)
V = voltage supplied, measured in
volts (V)
I = current, measured in amperes
(A)
t = time, measured in seconds (s)
frontZh: 什么是该电的能量公式？
backZh: 该电的能量公式是： E = V × I × t 其中： E = 电的能量转移， 单位为焦耳 (J) V = 电压 supplied， 单位为伏特 (V) I = 电流， 单位为安培 (一个) t = 时间， 单位为秒 (s)

front: How is energy transferred in a circuit?
back:
In a circuit, energy is transferred from
the power source to the components
connected in the circuit.
As charge passes through the power
supply, it gains energy in its kinetic
store, which is then transferred to the
energy stores of the components as it
passes through them.
frontZh: ……如何能量转移在 一个电路？
backZh: 在一个电路， 能量是 转移从 该功率来源到 该元件连接在 该电路。 As 电荷 passes 通过该 功率 supply， 它获得能量在 它的动能的/运动的储存形式， 哪一个是 然后转移到 该能量储存形式的 该元件 as 它 passes 通过它们。

front:
What two factors affect the amount of
energy transferred in an appliance?
back:
The amount of energy transferred in an
appliance depends on:
How long the appliance is switched
on for
The power rating of the appliance
frontZh: 哪两个因素影响该 量的 能量转移在 一个 appliance？
backZh: 该量 的能量转移在 一个 appliance 取决于： 如何长 该 appliance 是 switched 在对于/为了该 功率 rating 的该 appliance

front: What does the unit kW mean?
back:
The unit kW stands for kilowatt, equal
to 1000 watts.
frontZh: 表示什么该 单位 kW mean？
backZh: 该单位 kW stands 对于/为了 kilowatt， 相等到 1000 瓦特。

front:
True or False?
Energy in a circuit is transferred from
the power source to the components
and the surroundings.
back:
True.
Energy in a circuit is transferred from
the power source to the components
and the surroundings.
frontZh: 判断正误：能量在 一个电路是 转移从 该功率来源到 该元件和 该 surroundings。
backZh: 正确。 能量在 一个电路是 转移从 该功率来源到 该元件和 该 surroundings。

front:
What are the main energy transfers in a
toaster while it toasts a slice of bread?
back:
In a toaster:
Electrical energy is transferred from the
mains supply to the thermal store of
the heating element and then to the
thermal store of the bread.
frontZh: 该主要能量转移在 一个 toaster 当……时它 toasts 一个 slice 的 bread是什么？
backZh: 在一个 toaster： 电的能量是 转移从 该 mains supply 到该 热的储存形式的 该加热元素和 然后到 该热的储存形式的 该 bread。

front:
What are the main energy transfers in a
washing machine while on a washing
cycle?
back:
Electrical energy is transferred from the
mains supply to the kinetic store of the
motor, to the kinetic store of the drum
as it spins.
frontZh: 该主要能量转移在 一个 washing machine 当……时在 一个 washing cycle是什么？
backZh: 电的能量是 转移从 该 mains supply 到该 动能的/运动的储存形式的 该电动机， 到该 动能的/运动的储存形式的 该 drum as 它 spins。

front: Define electrical power.
back:
Electrical power is defined as the rate at
which electrical energy is transferred or
converted per unit of time, typically
measured in watts (W).
frontZh: 定义电的功率。
backZh: 电的功率定义为该 率 at 哪一个电的能量是 转移或 converted per 单位的 时间， 通常单位为瓦特 (W)。

front:
True or False?
Power is the rate of doing work.
back:
True.
Power is defined as the rate of doing
work, or, the rate of energy transfer.
It is typically measured in watts (W).
frontZh: 判断正误：功率是 该率 的 doing 功。
backZh: 正确。 功率定义为该 率的 doing 功， 或， 该率 的能量转移。 它是 通常单位为瓦特 (W)。

front: What is the electrical power equation?
back:
The electrical power equation is:
P = I × V
Where:
P = power, measured in watts (W)
V = voltage, measured in volts (V)
I = current, measured in amperes
(A)
frontZh: 什么是该电的功率公式？
backZh: 该电的功率公式是： P = I × V 其中： P = 功率， 单位为瓦特 (W) V = 电压， 单位为伏特 (V) I = 电流， 单位为安培 (一个)

front:
How is electrical power related to work
done in a circuit?
back:
Power is defined as the rate of doing
work.
Therefore, electrical power describes
the rate at which electrical energy is
transferred or converted.
frontZh: ……如何电的功率 related 到做功在 一个电路？
backZh: 功率定义为该 率的 doing 功。 因此， 电的功率 describes 该率 at 哪一个电的能量是 转移或 converted。

front:
State the equation for calculating
electrical power in terms of resistance.
back:
The equation for electrical power in
terms of resistance is: P = I2 × R
Where:
P = power, measured in watts (W)
I = current, measured in amperes
(A)
R = resistance, measured in ohms
(Ω)
frontZh: 说明……的公式为计算电的功率用……来表示电阻。
backZh: ……的公式为电的功率用……来表示电阻是： P = I2 × R 其中： P = 功率， 单位为瓦特 (W) I = 电流， 单位为安培 (一个) R = 电阻， 单位为欧姆 (Ω)

front:
True or False?
The unit of power is joules (J).
back:
False.
The unit of power is watts (W), where 1
watt is equivalent to 1 joule per second.
frontZh: 判断正误：该单位的 功率是 焦耳 (J)。
backZh: 错误。 该单位的 功率是 瓦特 (W)， 其中 1 watt 是 equivalent 到 1 joule per 秒。

front:
What does the unit kilowatt hour
(kWh) mean?
back:
The kilowatt-hour (kWh) is a unit of
energy. It is equivalent to one kilowatt
of power expended for one hour.
It is commonly used to measure and
compare energy usage in homes and
businesses.
frontZh: 表示什么该 单位 kilowatt hour (kWh) mean？
backZh: 该 kilowatt-hour (kWh) 是一个单位的 能量。 它是 equivalent 到一个 kilowatt 的功率 expended 对于/为了一个 hour。 它是 commonly 用于测量和 compare 能量 usage 在 homes 和 businesses。

front:
True or False?
Energy usage in homes is measured in
joules (J).
back:
False.
Energy usage in homes and businesses
is commonly measured in kilowatt-
hours (kWh), where 1 kWh is the energy
consumed using 1 kilowatt of power for
1 hour.
frontZh: 判断正误：能量 usage 在 homes 的单位是焦耳 (J)。
backZh: 错误。 能量 usage 在 homes 和 businesses 是 commonly 单位为 kilowatt- 小时 (kWh)， 其中 1 kWh 是该 能量 consumed 使用 1 kilowatt 的功率对于/为了 1 hour。

front:
What is the equation that defines the
kilowatt hour (kWh)?
back:
The equation that defines the kilowatt
hour (kWh) is: E = P × t
Where:
E = energy, measured in kilowatt-
hours (kWh)
P = power, measured in kilowatts
(kW)
t = time, measured in hours (h)
frontZh: 什么是该公式， defines 该 kilowatt hour (kWh)？
backZh: 该公式， defines 该 kilowatt hour (kWh) 是： E = P × t 其中： E = 能量， 单位为 kilowatt- 小时 (kWh) P = 功率， 单位为 kilowatts (kW) t = 时间， 单位为小时 (h)

front: What is electromagnetic induction?
back:
Electromagnetic induction is the effect
of inducing e.m.f. in a conductor due
to the relative motion between a
conductor and a magnetic field .
frontZh: 什么是电磁感应？
backZh: 电磁感应是 该效应/影响的 inducing 电动势在 一个导体由于该 相对运动在……之间一个导体和 一个磁场。

front: How can an e.m.f. be induced in a wire?
back:
An e.m.f. be induced in a wire by
moving it through a magnetic field.
frontZh: 怎样可以一个电动势是 感应的在 一个导线？
backZh: 一个电动势是 感应的在 一个导线由运动它 通过一个磁场。

front:
True or False?
An e.m.f. can only be induced by
moving a conductor in a magnetic field.
back:
False.
An e.m.f. can also be induced by placing
a stationary conductor in a changing
magnetic field.
frontZh: 判断正误：一个电动势可以只有/仅是 感应的由运动一个导体在 一个磁场。
backZh: 错误。 一个电动势可以也 是感应的由 placing 一个静止导体在 一个变化的磁场。

front:
How can the direction of an induced
e.m.f. be reversed?
back:
The direction of an induced e.m.f. can
be reversed by:
Reversing the direction of motion
(of the magnet or conductor)
Swapping the poles of the magnet
frontZh: 怎样可以该 方向的 一个感应电动势是 reversed？
backZh: 该方向的 一个感应电动势可以是/被 reversed 由： Reversing 该方向的 运动 (的该 磁体或 导体) Swapping 该极 的该 磁体

front:
Define Lenz's Law. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
Lenz's Law states that the direction of
an induced e.m.f. always opposes the
change producing it.
frontZh: 定义楞次定律。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 楞次定律说明， 该方向的 一个感应电动势总是 opposes 该变化产生它。

front:
How can Lenz's Law be demonstrated?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
Lenz's Law can be demonstrated using
a bar magnet and a coil of wire.
When the magnet moves into or out of
a coil of wire, the induced e.m.f. creates
a magnetic field that opposes the
motion of the magnet.
frontZh: 怎样可以楞次定律是 demonstrated？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 楞次定律可以是/被 demonstrated 使用一个条形磁体和 一个线圈的 导线。 什么时候该 磁体移动进入或 外/出的 一个线圈的 导线， 该感应电动势 creates 一个磁场， opposes 该运动的 该磁体。

front:
True or False?
When the north pole of a bar magnet is
pushed towards a coil, the end of the
coil begins to act as a south pole.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
False.
When the north pole of a bar magnet is
pushed towards a coil, the end of the
coil begins to act as a north pole.
As a result, the two like poles repel in
order to oppose the motion of the
magnet.
frontZh: 判断正误：什么时候该 北极的 一个条形磁体是 pushed 朝向一个线圈， 该结束/末端的 该线圈 begins 到 act as 一个南极。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 什么时候该 北极的 一个条形磁体是 pushed 朝向一个线圈， 该结束/末端的 该线圈 begins 到 act as 一个北极。 As 一个 result， 该两个同名磁极排斥在 顺序到 oppose 该运动的 该磁体。

front:
What is the Right-Hand Dynamo rule?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
The Right-Hand Dynamo rule is used to
determine the direction of an induced
e.m.f in a wire moving through a
magnetic field.
Where:
First Finger = Field (index finger)
ThuMb = Motion
SeCond Finger = Current (middle
finger)
frontZh: 什么是该 右-Hand Dynamo 定则？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该右-Hand Dynamo 定则用于决定该 方向的 一个感应的 e。m。f 在一个导线运动通过一个磁场。 其中： 第一手指 = 场 (index 手指) 拇指 = 运动秒 手指 = 电流 (中间手指)

front:
When using the Right-Hand Dynamo
rule, what does the first finger
represent? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
When using the Right-Hand Dynamo
rule, the first finger represents the
direction of the magnetic field from
the north pole to the south pole.
frontZh: 什么时候使用该 右-Hand Dynamo 定则， 表示什么该 第一手指表示？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 什么时候使用该 右-Hand Dynamo 定则， 该第一手指表示该 方向的 该磁场从 该北极到 该南极。

front:
True or False?
When using the Right-Hand Dynamo
rule, the second finger always indicates
the flow of current from the positive
terminal to the negative terminal of the
battery. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
When using the Right-Hand Dynamo
rule, the second finger always indicates
the direction of positive charge
carriers or the flow of current from the
positive terminal to the negative
terminal of the battery.
frontZh: 判断正误：什么时候使用该 右-Hand Dynamo 定则， 该秒 手指总是表示该 流动的 电流从 该正 接线端到 该负 接线端的 该电池组。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 什么时候使用该 右-Hand Dynamo 定则， 该秒 手指总是表示该 方向的 正电荷 carriers 或该 流动的 电流从 该正 接线端到 该负 接线端的 该电池组。

State the factors that will affect the
of the induced potential difference in

back:
size
The size of the induced potential

The speed at which the wire is

The strength of the magnetic field

backZh: 该大小的 该感应的电势差在 该导线在 该图示是 determined 由： 该速率 at 哪一个该 导线是 moved 该强度的 该磁场

front:
State the factors that will affect the
of the induced potential difference in
the coil in the diagram.
back:
size The size of the induced potential
difference in the coil in the diagram is

The speed at which the magnet is

The number of turns on the coils
of wire
The size of the coils
frontZh: 说明该因素， 将会影响该 大小的 该感应的电势差在 该线圈在 该图示。
backZh: 该大小的 该感应的电势差在 该线圈在 该图示是 determined 由： 该速率 at 哪一个该 磁体是 moved 该强度的 该磁场该 数量/数目的 匝数在 该 coils 的导线该 大小的 该 coils

front:
How can electromagnetic induction be
demonstrated using a wire and a U-
shaped magnet?
back:
Electromagnetic induction be
demonstrated using a wire and a U-
shaped magnet by:
Moving the wire up or down
between the magnet poles
Moving the magnet up or down
while holding the wire still
frontZh: 怎样可以电磁感应是 demonstrated 使用一个导线和 一个 U- shaped 磁体？
backZh: 电磁感应是 demonstrated 使用一个导线和 一个 U- shaped 磁体由： 运动该 导线向上或 向下在……之间该 磁体极 运动该 磁体向上或 向下当……时 holding 该导线 still

front:
How can electromagnetic induction be
demonstrated using a coil and a bar
magnet? the coil
back:
Electromagnetic induction be
demonstrated using a coil and a bar
magnet by:
Moving the magnet into or out of
Moving the coil towards or away
from the magnet
frontZh: 怎样可以电磁感应是 demonstrated 使用一个线圈和 一个条形磁体？
backZh: 电磁感应是 demonstrated 使用一个线圈和 一个条形磁体由： 运动该 磁体进入或 外/出的 该线圈运动该 线圈朝向或 远离从 该磁体

front:
What apparatus can be used to
determine if an e.m.f. has been induced
in a conductor?
back:
A sensitive voltmeter or ammeter can
be used to determine if an e.m.f. has
been induced in a conductor.
frontZh: 什么 apparatus 可用于决定 if 一个电动势有 被感应的在 一个导体？
backZh: 一个 sensitive 电压表或 电流表可用于决定 if 一个电动势有 被感应的在 一个导体。

front:
True or False?
An e.m.f. is induced when a wire moves
up and down between the poles of a
stationary magnet.
back:
True.
For electromagnetic induction to occur,
there must be relative motion between
the conductor and the magnetic field.
Therefore, an e.m.f. is induced when a
wire moves up and down between the
poles of a stationary magnet.
frontZh: 判断正误：一个电动势是 感应的什么时候一个导线移动向上和 向下在……之间该 极的 一个静止磁体。
backZh: 正确。 对于/为了电磁感应到 发生， there 必须是 相对运动在……之间该 导体和 该磁场。 因此， 一个电动势是 感应的什么时候一个导线移动向上和 向下在……之间该 极的 一个静止磁体。

front:
True or False?
An e.m.f. is induced when a coil and a
bar magnet move in the same direction
at the same speed.
back:
False.
For electromagnetic induction to occur,
there must be relative motion between
the conductor and the magnetic field.
Therefore, an e.m.f. is not induced
when a coil and a bar magnet move in
the same direction at the same speed.
frontZh: 判断正误：一个电动势是 感应的什么时候一个线圈和 一个条形磁体移动在 该相同方向 at 该相同速率。
backZh: 错误。 对于/为了电磁感应到 发生， there 必须是 相对运动在……之间该 导体和 该磁场。 因此， 一个电动势是 不感应的什么时候一个线圈和 一个条形磁体移动在 该相同方向 at 该相同速率。

front:
What three factors affect the
magnitude of an induced e.m.f.?
back:
Three factors that affect the magnitude
of an induced e.m.f. are:
The speed of motion of the
magnet or coil
The number of turns on the coil
The strength of the magnet
frontZh: 什么三个因素影响该 大小的 一个感应电动势？
backZh: 三个因素， 影响该 大小的 一个感应电动势是： 该速率的 运动的 该磁体或 线圈该 数量/数目的 匝数在 该线圈该 强度的 该磁体

front:
True or False?
The size of the induced e.m.f. across a
conductor is directly proportional to the
rate at which it cuts magnetic field lines.
back:
True.
The size of the induced e.m.f. across a
conductor is directly proportional to the
rate at which it cuts magnetic field lines.
frontZh: 判断正误：该大小的 该感应电动势跨过/两端一个导体与……成正比： 该率 at 哪一个它 cuts 磁场线。
backZh: 正确。 该大小的 该感应电动势跨过/两端一个导体与……成正比： 该率 at 哪一个它 cuts 磁场线。

front:
How can the size of the induced e.m.f.
be increased using a wire and a U-
shaped magnet?
back:
The induced e.m.f. can be increased
using a wire and a U-shaped magnet by:
increasing the length of the wire
between the poles, or using a
magnet with wider poles
moving the wire between the
magnet poles faster
increasing the strength of the
magnet
frontZh: 怎样可以该 大小的 该感应电动势是 增大使用一个导线和 一个 U- shaped 磁体？
backZh: 该感应电动势可以是/被增大使用一个导线和 一个 U-shaped 磁体由： 增大该 长度的 该导线在……之间该 极， 或使用一个磁体与 wider 极运动该 导线在……之间该 磁体极 更快增大该 强度的 该磁体

front:
How can the size of the induced e.m.f.
be increased in the experiment using a
coil and a bar magnet?
back:
The induced e.m.f. can be increased
using a coil and a bar magnet by:
adding more turns to the coil
moving the magnet into the coil
faster
increasing the strength of the
magnet
frontZh: 怎样可以该 大小的 该感应电动势是 增大在 该实验使用一个线圈和 一个条形磁体？
backZh: 该感应电动势可以是/被增大使用一个线圈和 一个条形磁体由： adding 更多匝数到 该线圈运动该 磁体进入该 线圈更快增大该 强度的 该磁体

front:
True or False?
The number of paper clips attracted by
a strong electromagnet can be
increased by reducing the number of
coils of wire.
back:
False.
The number of paper clips attracted by
a strong electromagnet can be
increased by increasing the number of
coils of wire.
frontZh: 判断正误：该数量/数目的 纸/试卷 clips attracted 由一个 strong 电磁铁可以是/被增大由 reducing 该数量/数目的 coils 的导线。
backZh: 错误。 该数量/数目的 纸/试卷 clips attracted 由一个 strong 电磁铁可以是/被增大由增大该 数量/数目的 coils 的导线。

front:
What is an A.C. generator? (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
An A.C. generator is a device which
converts energy from a mechanical
store to an electrical store.
frontZh: 什么是一个一个。C。 发电机？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 一个一个。C。 发电机是 一个装置哪一个 converts 能量从 一个 mechanical 储存形式到 一个电的储存形式。

front:
What is the output of an A.C.
generator? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The output of an A.C. generator is
alternating current.
frontZh: 什么是该 输出的 一个一个。C。 发电机？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该输出的 一个一个。C。 发电机是 交流电。

front:
What components make up a simple
A.C. generator? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
A simple A.C. generator consists of:
1. A rectangular coil of wire rotating in
a magnetic field
2. Slip rings and brushes
frontZh: 什么元件 make 向上一个 simple 一个。C。 发电机？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 一个 simple 一个。C。 发电机 consists 的： 1。 一个 rectangular 线圈的 导线 rotating 在一个磁场 2。 Slip rings 和 brushes

front:
What is the purpose of the slip rings?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
The purpose of slip rings is to provide a
connection between the rotating coil
and the external circuit.
frontZh: ……的用途是什么？ 该 slip rings？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该目的 slip rings 是到 provide 一个 connection 在……之间该 rotating 线圈和 该 external 电路。

front:
How often does the direction of the
current reverse as an A.C. generator
rotates? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The direction of the current reverses
every half rotation of the coil in the
A.C. generator.
frontZh: 如何 often 做/会该 方向的 该电流 reverse as 一个一个。C。 发电机 rotates？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该方向的 该电流 reverses every 一半自转的 该线圈在 该一个。C。 发电机。

front:
True or False?
A maximum value of current is induced
when the coil is parallel to the magnetic
field. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
False.
A maximum value of current is induced
when the coil is perpendicular to the
magnetic field.
frontZh: 判断正误：一个 maximum 数值的 电流是 感应的什么时候该 线圈是 并联到 该磁场。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 一个 maximum 数值的 电流是 感应的什么时候该 线圈是 垂直到 该磁场。

front:
True or False?
There is a point in the rotation of the
coil where no current is induced.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
No current is induced when the coil is
parallel to the field.
frontZh: 判断正误：有一个点 在该 自转的 该线圈其中 no 电流是 感应的。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 No 电流是 感应的什么时候该 线圈是 并联到 该场。

front:
What is the shape of the graph of
output current against time for an A.C.
generator? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
For an A.C. generator, the shape of the
graph of output current against time is
a sine or cosine curve.
frontZh: 什么是该 形状的 该图像的 输出电流 against 时间对于/为了一个一个。C。 发电机？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 对于/为了一个一个。C。 发电机， 该形状的 该图像的 输出电流 against 时间是 一个 sine 或 cosine curve。

front:
What is the frequency of an A.C. output?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
The frequency of an A.C. output is the
number of complete cycles it makes
each second e.g. 1 cycle per second = 1
Hz.
frontZh: 什么是该 频率的 一个一个。C。 输出？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该频率的 一个一个。C。 输出是 该数量/数目的 完成 cycles 它 makes 每个秒 例如 1 cycle per 秒 = 1 Hz。

front:
How can the size of the induced current
be increased in an A.C. generator?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
In an A.C. generator, the size of the
induced current can be increased by:
adding more turns to the coil
rotating the coil faster
increasing the strength of the
magnet
frontZh: 怎样可以该 大小的 该感应的电流是 增大在 一个一个。C。 发电机？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 在一个一个。C。 发电机， 该大小的 该感应的电流可以是/被增大由： adding 更多匝数到 该线圈 rotating 该线圈更快增大该 强度的 该磁体

front:
What is the pattern of the magnetic
field due to the current in a straight
wire?
back:
The magnetic field due to a current in a
straight wire forms concentric circles
that get further apart with increasing
distance from the wire.

magnets.

front:
True or False?
The south pole of one magnet repels
the north pole of another magnet.
back:
False.
Opposite poles attract.
frontZh: 判断正误：该南极的 一个磁体 repels 该北极的 另一个磁体。
backZh: 错误。 异名磁极吸引。

front: Define the term permanent magnet.
back:
Permanent magnets produce their own
magnetic field and do not lose their
magnetism.
frontZh: 定义该术语永久磁体。
backZh: 永久磁体产生它们的 own 磁场和 do 不 lose 它们的 magnetism。

front: What is induced magnetism?
back:
Induced magnetism is when a magnetic
material is placed in a magnetic field
and the material can temporarily be
turned into a magnet.
frontZh: 什么是感应的 magnetism？
backZh: 感应的 magnetism 是什么时候一个磁的材料是 放置在 一个磁场和 该材料可以 temporarily 是 turned 进入一个磁体。

front: Define the term magnetic material.
back:
Magnetic materials are materials that
are attracted to a magnet.
frontZh: 定义该术语磁的材料。
backZh: 磁性材料是 材料， 是 attracted 到一个磁体。

front:
True or False?
Induced magnets retain their
magnetism after being removed from
the magnetic field.
back:
False.
Induced magnets lose most/all of their
magnetism quickly after being removed
from the magnetic field.
frontZh: 判断正误：感应的磁体 retain 它们的 magnetism 之后被 removed 从该 磁场。
backZh: 错误。 感应的磁体 lose 大多数/所有的 它们的 magnetism quickly 之后被 removed 从该 磁场。

front:
What happens to the ends of a
magnetic material when it becomes an
induced magnet?
back:
When magnetism is induced in a
material, one end of the material will
become a north pole, and the other end
will become a south pole.
frontZh: 什么发生到 该 ends 的一个磁的材料什么时候它 becomes 一个感应的磁体？
backZh: 什么时候 magnetism 是感应的在 一个材料， 一个结束/末端的 该材料将会 become 一个北极， 和该 其他结束/末端将会 become 一个南极。

front:
True or False?
Aluminium is a magnetic material.
back:
False.
Aluminium is not a magnetic material.
frontZh: 判断正误：Aluminium 是一个磁的材料。
backZh: 错误。 Aluminium 是不 一个磁的材料。

front:
What is an example of a magnetic
material?
back:
Iron, cobalt, nickel, and steel (an alloy
containing iron) are examples of
magnetic materials.
frontZh: 什么是一个例子的 一个磁的材料？
backZh: 铁， cobalt， nickel， 和钢 (一个 alloy 包含铁) 是例子的 磁性材料。

front:
How can you determine which pole is
induced at a particular end of a
magnetic material?
back:
To determine which pole is induced at
one end of a magnetic material, hold a
south pole near that end. If the end is
repelled, it is a south pole. If it attracts,
it is a north pole.
frontZh: 怎样可以你 决定哪一个极 是感应的 at 一个 particular 结束/末端的 一个磁的材料？
backZh: 到决定哪一个极 是感应的 at 一个结束/末端的 一个磁的材料， hold 一个南极 near， 结束/末端。 If 该结束/末端是 repelled， 它是 一个南极。 If 它 attracts， 它是 一个北极。

front:
What is an example of a non-magnetic
material?
back:
Any material other than iron, cobalt,
nickel, and steel (or alloys containing
these metals) is a non-magnetic
material. For example, aluminum,
copper, wood, plastic, etc.
frontZh: 什么是一个例子的 一个 non-磁的材料？
backZh: 任何材料其他比 铁， cobalt， nickel， 和钢 (或 alloys 包含这些 metals) 是一个 non-磁的材料。 例如， aluminum， copper， wood， 塑性的， etc。

front:
True or False?
The south pole of an induced magnet
will repel an iron paperclip.
back:
False.
The iron paperclip, a magnetic material,
can only be attracted by a magnet, not
repelled.
frontZh: 判断正误：该南极的 一个感应的磁体将会排斥一个铁 paperclip。
backZh: 错误。 该铁 paperclip， 一个磁的材料， 可以只有/仅是 attracted 由一个磁体， 不 repelled。

front: Define the term magnetic field .
back:
A magnetic field is the region around a
magnet where a force acts on another
magnet or on a magnetic material.
frontZh: 定义该术语磁场。
backZh: 一个磁场是 该区域周围一个磁体其中一个力 作用在 另一个磁体或 在一个磁的材料。

front:
Define the term uniform magnetic
field.
back:
A uniform magnetic field is a magnetic
field that has the same strength and
direction at all points.
frontZh: 定义该术语均匀磁场。
backZh: 一个均匀磁场是 一个磁场， 有该 相同强度和 方向 at 所有点。

front:
How is a uniform magnetic field
represented in diagrams?
back:
In a uniform magnetic field, the
magnetic field lines are equally spaced,
and all arrows point in the same
direction.
frontZh: ……如何一个均匀磁场表示为在 diagrams？
backZh: 在一个均匀磁场， 该磁场线是 equally spaced， 和所有 arrows 点在 该相同方向。

front: What are magnetic field lines?
back:
Magnetic field lines are lines drawn to
represent the strength and direction of
a magnetic field.
frontZh: 磁场线是什么？
backZh: 磁场线是 lines drawn 到表示该 强度和 方向的 一个磁场。

front:
What are the two rules for drawing
magnetic field lines?
back:
Two rules for drawing magnetic field
lines are:
1. Magnetic field lines must always go
from north to south (indicated by
an arrow midway along the line)
2. Field lines must never touch or
cross other field lines
frontZh: 该两个 rules 对于/为了 drawing 磁场线是什么？
backZh: 两个 rules 对于/为了 drawing 磁场线是： 1。 磁场线必须总是 go 从北 到南 (indicated 由一个箭头 midway along 该线) 2。 场线必须 never touch 或交叉/横截面其他场线

front:
True or False?
The magnetic field is strongest at the
poles of a bar magnet.
back:
True.
The magnetic field is strongest at the
poles of a bar magnet, where the
magnetic field lines are closest together.
frontZh: 判断正误：该磁场是 strongest at 该极 的一个条形磁体。
backZh: 正确。 该磁场是 strongest at 该极 的一个条形磁体， 其中该 磁场线是 closest 一起。

front:
What do closely spaced magnetic field
lines indicate? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
Closely spaced magnetic field lines
indicate a strong magnetic field.
frontZh: 什么 do closely spaced 磁场线 indicate？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: Closely spaced 磁场线 indicate 一个 strong 磁场。

front:
What do widely spaced magnetic field
lines indicate? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
Widely spaced magnetic field lines
indicate a weak magnetic field.
frontZh: 什么 do widely spaced 磁场线 indicate？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: Widely spaced 磁场线 indicate 一个 weak 磁场。

front:
What causes magnetic forces?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
Magnetic forces are caused by
interactions between magnetic fields.
frontZh: 什么导致磁的力？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 磁的力 由……引起： interactions 在……之间磁的 fields。

front:
The magnetic field of a bar magnet gets
weaker further from the magnet. How is
this represented in a diagram?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
To represent the fact that a bar
magnet's field weakens with distance
from the magnet, the field lines get
further apart further from the bar
magnet.
frontZh: 该磁场的 一个条形磁体 gets weaker 进一步从 该磁体。 ……如何这 表示为在 一个图示？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 到表示该 fact， 一个条形磁体's 场 weakens 与距离从 该磁体， 该场线 get 进一步 apart 进一步从 该条形磁体。

front:
What are the two principal ways of
plotting the magnetic field around a bar
magnet?
back:
The two principal ways of plotting the
magnetic field around a bar magnet are
using iron filings and using plotting
compasses.
frontZh: 该两个 principal ways 的绘制该 磁场周围一个条形磁体是什么？
backZh: 该两个 principal ways 的绘制该 磁场周围一个条形磁体是 使用铁 filings 和使用绘制 compasses。

front:
What is the method for plotting
magnetic field lines using iron filings?
back:
To plot magnetic field lines using iron
filings:
1. Place a piece of paper on top of the
magnet
2. Gently sprinkle iron filings on top of
the paper
3. Carefully tap the paper to allow the
iron filings to settle on the field
lines
frontZh: 什么是该方法对于/为了绘制磁场线使用铁 filings？
backZh: 到 plot 磁场线使用铁 filings： 1。 位置/发生一个 piece 的纸/试卷在 top 的该 磁体 2。 Gently sprinkle 铁 filings 在 top 的该 纸/试卷 3。 Carefully tap 该纸/试卷到 allow 该铁 filings 到 settle 在该 场线

front:
What is the method for plotting
magnetic field lines using a plotting
compass?
back:
To plot magnetic field lines using a
plotting compass:
1. Place the magnet on top of a piece
of paper and draw a dot at one end
2. Place a plotting compass next to
the dot so that one end of the
needle points towards the dot
3. Draw a new dot at the other side of
the compass needle
4. Move the compass to point towards
the new dot
5. Repeat the process to create a
chain of dots representing the
magnetic field line
frontZh: 什么是该方法对于/为了绘制磁场线使用一个绘制指南针？
backZh: 到 plot 磁场线使用一个绘制指南针： 1。 位置/发生该 磁体在 top 的一个 piece 的纸/试卷和 draw 一个 dot at 一个结束/末端 2。 位置/发生一个绘制指南针 next 到该 dot so， 一个结束/末端的 该 needle 点朝向该 dot 3。 Draw 一个 new dot at 该其他侧 的该 指南针 needle 4。 移动该 指南针到 点朝向该 new dot 5。 Repeat 该过程到 create 一个 chain 的 dots representing 该磁场线

front:
True or False?
The direction of the magnetic field line
plotted using a compass is the same as
the direction of the plotting compass.
back:
True.
The direction of the magnetic field line
plotted using a compass is the same as
the direction of the plotting compass.
frontZh: 判断正误：该方向的 该磁场线 plotted 使用一个指南针是 与……相同该 方向的 该绘制指南针。
backZh: 正确。 该方向的 该磁场线 plotted 使用一个指南针是 与……相同该 方向的 该绘制指南针。

front:
What do you need to do after creating a
chain of dots using a plotting compass?
back:
After creating a chain of dots using a
plotting compass, you need to remove
the compass and link the dots using a
smooth curve to represent the magnetic
field line.
frontZh: 什么 do 你需要到 do 之后形成一个 chain 的 dots 使用一个绘制指南针？
backZh: 之后形成一个 chain 的 dots 使用一个绘制指南针， 你需要到 remove 该指南针和 link 该 dots 使用一个 smooth curve 到表示该 磁场线。

front:
How can you plot multiple magnetic
field lines around a bar magnet?
back:
To plot multiple magnetic field lines
around a bar magnet, you need to
repeat the process of using the plotting
compass several times, starting from
different points on the magnet.
frontZh: 怎样可以你 plot multiple 磁场线周围一个条形磁体？
backZh: 到 plot multiple 磁场线周围一个条形磁体， 你需要到 repeat 该过程的 使用该 绘制指南针 several times， starting 从不同点 在该 磁体。

front:
True or False?
The compass needle points in the
opposite direction to the arrows on the
field lines.
back:
False.
The needle points in the same direction
as the arrows on the field lines.
frontZh: 判断正误：该指南针 needle 点在 该相反方向到 该 arrows 在该 场线。
backZh: 错误。 该 needle 点在 该相同方向 as 该 arrows 在该 场线。

front:
True or False?
In the iron filing experiment, more
filings will gather near the magnet's
poles than at the edge of the paper.
back:
True.
The magnetic field is stronger at the
magnet's poles, so more iron filings will
gather here.
frontZh: 判断正误：在该 铁 filing 实验， 更多 filings 将会 gather near 该磁体's 极比 at 该 edge 的该 纸/试卷。
backZh: 正确。 该磁场是 stronger at 该磁体's 极， so 更多铁 filings 将会 gather here。

front: Define background radiation.
back:
Background radiation is the radiation
that exists around us all the time.
frontZh: 定义本底辐射。
backZh: 本底辐射是一直存在于我们周围的辐射。

front:
True or False?
Radiation is solely a human-made
phenomenon.
back:
False.
Radiation is a natural phenomenon that
has always existed on Earth and in
outer space.
frontZh: 判断正误：辐射是 solely 一个人为制造的 phenomenon。
backZh: 错误。 辐射是 一个天然 phenomenon， 有总是 existed 在地球和 在外部太空。

front:
What are the natural sources of
background radiation?
back:
Natural sources of background
radiation include:
radon gas
cosmic rays from space
radioactive elements in rocks and
soil
carbon-14 in biological material
some food and drink
frontZh: 该天然来源的 本底辐射是什么？
backZh: 天然来源的 本底辐射 include： radon 气体宇宙的射线从 太空放射性的 elements 在岩石和 土壤 carbon-14 在生物材料 some food 和 drink

front:
True or False?
Ionising nuclear radiation can be
measured using a detector connected
to an emitter.
back:
False.
Ionising nuclear radiation can be
measured using a detector connected
to a counter.
frontZh: 判断正误：电离的核辐射可以是/被测量使用一个探测器连接到 一个发射体。
backZh: 错误。 电离的核辐射可以是/被测量使用一个探测器连接到 一个计数器。

front: What are the units of count rate?
back:
Count rate is measured in counts per
second or counts per minute.
frontZh: 计数率的单位是什么？
backZh: 计数率的单位是每秒计数或 每分钟计数。

front:
True or False?
A corrected count rate can be
calculated by adding the count rate
found with no radioactive source
present to the count rate with the
radioactive source present. (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
False.
A corrected count rate can be calculated
by subtracting the count rate found
with no radioactive source present from
the count rate with the radioactive
source present. (Extended Tier Only)
frontZh: 判断正误：一个 corrected 计数率可以是/被计算出的由 adding 该计数率存在与 no 放射性的来源 present 到该 计数率与该 放射性的来源 present。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 一个 corrected 计数率可以是/被计算出的由 subtracting 该计数率存在与 no 放射性的来源 present 从该 计数率与该 放射性的来源 present。 （仅拓展内容）

front:
Does the count rate increase or
decrease as the detector moves further
from the radiation source?
back:
The count rate decreases as the
detector moves further from the
radiation source.
frontZh: 做/会该 计数率增大或 减小 as 该探测器移动进一步从 该辐射来源？
backZh: 该计数率减小 as 该探测器移动进一步从 该辐射来源。

front:
What is the procedure for determining
background radiation count. (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
To determine background radiation
count, move the radiation source back
until the count rate remains constant,
indicating only background radiation,
then record the count rate.
frontZh: 什么是该 procedure 对于/为了 determining 本底辐射计数。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 到决定本底辐射计数， 移动该 辐射来源 back until 该计数率保持恒定， indicating 只有/仅本底辐射， 然后 record 该计数率。

front:
True or False?
The emission of radiation from a
nucleus is spontaneous and occurs
randomly.
back:
True.
The emission of radiation from a
nucleus is spontaneous and occurs
randomly.
frontZh: 判断正误：该发射的 辐射从 一个原子核是 自发的和 发生 randomly。
backZh: 正确。 该发射的 辐射从 一个原子核是 自发的和 发生 randomly。

front:
What are the three types of radiation
that a nucleus can emit?
back:
The three types of radiation that a
nucleus can emit are:
alpha (α )
beta (β )
gamma (γ )
frontZh: 该三个类型的 辐射， 一个原子核可以发射是什么？
backZh: 该三个类型的 辐射， 一个原子核可以发射是： α (α) β (β) γ (γ)

front:
True or False?
Nuclear decay is predictable and
organised.
back:
False.
Nuclear decay is spontaneous and
random.
frontZh: 判断正误：核衰变是 predictable 和 organised。
backZh: 错误。 核衰变是 自发的和 随机。

front:
True or False?
It is possible to predict when a nucleus
will decay but not which nucleus will
decay.
back:
False.
It is not possible to predict when a
nucleus will decay or which nucleus will
decay. But it is possible to estimate
how many nuclei will decay, or the
probability that a nucleus will decay in
a given time frame.
frontZh: 判断正误：它是 可能的到 predict 什么时候一个原子核将会衰变但是不 哪一个原子核将会衰变。
backZh: 错误。 它是 不可能的到 predict 什么时候一个原子核将会衰变或 哪一个原子核将会衰变。 但是它 是可能的到 estimate 多少原子核将会衰变， 或该 probability， 一个原子核将会衰变在 一个给定的时间 frame。

front:
What is the composition of an alpha
particle?
back:
An alpha particle is composed of two
protons and two neutrons. It is
essentially a helium nucleus.
frontZh: 什么是该 composition 的一个 α粒子？
backZh: 一个 α粒子是 composed 的两个质子和 两个中子。 它是 essentially 一个 helium 原子核。

front:
What is the composition of a beta
particle?
back:
A beta particle is composed of a fast-
moving electron.
frontZh: 什么是该 composition 的一个 β粒子？
backZh: 一个 β粒子是 composed 的一个 fast- 运动电子。

front:
True or False?
Alpha particles have a charge of -1.
back:
False.
Alpha particles have a charge of +2 due
to having two positively charged
protons. It is beta particles that have a
charge of -1 due to the negatively
charged electron.
frontZh: 判断正误：α粒子有 一个电荷的 -1。
backZh: 错误。 α粒子有 一个电荷的 +2 由于 having 两个 positively 带电质子。 它是 β粒子， 有一个电荷的 -1 由于该 negatively 带电电子。

front:
Which type of nuclear radiation is the
most ionising?
back:
Alpha particles are the most ionising
form of nuclear radiation. Beta particles
are next, and gamma radiation is the
least ionising.
frontZh: 哪一个类型的 核辐射是 该大多数电离的？
backZh: α粒子是 该大多数电离的形式的 核辐射。 β粒子是 next， 和 γ 辐射是 该 least 电离的。

front:
What are the types of nuclear radiation
in order of increasing penetrating
power?
back:
The types of nuclear radiation in order
of increasing penetrating power are:
alpha (least penetrating, can be
stopped by paper)
beta (can stopped by a few mm of
aluminium)
gamma (most penetrating, can be
reduced by a few mm of lead)
frontZh: 该类型的 核辐射在 顺序的 增大 penetrating 功率是什么？
backZh: 该类型的 核辐射在 顺序的 增大 penetrating 功率是： α (least penetrating， 可以是/被 stopped 由纸/试卷) β (可以 stopped 由一个 few mm 的 aluminium) γ (大多数 penetrating， 可以是/被 reduced 由一个 few mm 的导致/铅)

front:
Why are alpha particles the most
ionising of all the types of nuclear
radiation? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
Alpha particles have the greatest
charge of all the nuclear decay
radiation at +2. Therefore, they attract
electrons from other atoms very
strongly. Alpha particles also have the
greatest mass, and therefore a high
kinetic energy. These factors
combined make alpha particles highly
ionising.
frontZh: 为什么是α粒子该 大多数电离的 所有该 类型的 核辐射？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: α粒子有 该 greatest 电荷的 所有该 核衰变辐射 at +2。 因此， 它们吸引电子从 其他原子非常 strongly。 α粒子也 有该 greatest 质量， 和因此一个高 动能。 这些因素合成的 make α粒子 highly 电离的。

front:
Why is gamma radiation the least
ionising of all the types of nuclear
radiation? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
Gamma radiation has no charge so it is
less ionising than alpha and beta
particles. However, gamma radiation is
still capable of ionising atoms as it is the
highest energy electromagnetic wave.
(Remember that UV, X-rays and gamma
rays are ionising.)
frontZh: 为什么 γ 辐射该 least 电离的 所有该 类型的 核辐射？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: γ 辐射有 no 电荷 so 它是 较少电离的比 α 和 β粒子。 然而， γ 辐射是 still capable 的电离的原子 as 它是 该 highest 能量电磁的波。 (Remember， UV， X射线和 γ射线是 电离的。)

front:
Why are beta particles ionising?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
Beta particles have a negligible mass,
but they travel at very high speeds. This
means that they have a high kinetic
energy. Beta (minus) particles also have
a charge of -1 so they repel electrons,
knocking them out of atoms. These
factors combined make them ionising.
frontZh: 为什么是β粒子电离的？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: β粒子有 一个 negligible 质量， 但是它们传播 at 非常高 speeds。 这意味着， 它们有 一个高 动能。 β (minus) 粒子也 有一个电荷的 -1 so 它们排斥电子， knocking 它们外/出的 原子。 这些因素合成的 make 它们电离的。

front:
Which types of nuclear radiation can be
deflected in an electric field? (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
Nuclear radiation can be deflected in an
electric field if it has charge. Therefore,
alpha and beta particles can be
deflected in an electric field.
frontZh: 哪一个类型的 核辐射可以是/被偏转在 一个电场？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 核辐射可以是/被偏转在 一个电场 if 它有 电荷。 因此， α 和 β粒子可以是/被偏转在 一个电场。

front:
True or False?
Alpha particles in an electric field will be
deflected toward the positively charged
plate. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
False.
Alpha particles are positively charged
and opposite charges attract, therefore
alpha particles will deflect toward the
negatively charged plate in an electric
field.
frontZh: 判断正误：α粒子在 一个电场将会是 偏转 toward 该 positively 带电 plate。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。 α粒子是 positively 带电和 异种电荷吸引， 因此 α粒子将会 deflect toward 该 negatively 带电 plate 在一个电场。

front:
True or False?
Gamma radiation cannot be deflected
by electric or magnetic fields.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
Gamma radiation has no charge
therefore it cannot be deflected by
electric or magnetic fields.
frontZh: 判断正误：γ 辐射不能是 偏转由电的或 磁的 fields。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 γ 辐射有 no 电荷因此它 不能是 偏转由电的或 磁的 fields。

front:
Are alpha or beta particles deflected the
most when travelling through an
electric field? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
Beta particles are deflected the most
when travelling through an electric field.
Alpha particles have a greater mass so
they get deflected the least.
frontZh: 是 α 或 β粒子偏转该 大多数什么时候运动/传播通过一个电场？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: β粒子是 偏转该 大多数什么时候运动/传播通过一个电场。 α粒子有 一个更大质量 so 它们 get 偏转该 least。

front:
True or False?
The most stable nuclei have
approximately equal numbers of
protons and neutrons. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
True.
The most stable nuclei have
approximately equal numbers of
protons and neutrons.
frontZh: 判断正误：该大多数稳定原子核有 大约相等 numbers 的质子和 中子。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 该大多数稳定原子核有 大约相等 numbers 的质子和 中子。

front:
True or False?
A nucleus becomes stable by reducing
its overall nuclear energy. (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
True.
A nucleus becomes stable by reducing
its overall nuclear energy. It does this by
emitting high-energy alpha and beta
particles and gamma radiation.
frontZh: 判断正误：一个原子核 becomes 稳定由 reducing 它的总的核能。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 一个原子核 becomes 稳定由 reducing 它的总的核能。 它做/会这 由 emitting 高-能量 α 和 β粒子和 γ 辐射。

front:
What two factors can cause an isotope
to be radioactive? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The two factors that can cause an
isotope to be radioactive are:
an excess of neutrons in the
nucleus
the nucleus being too heavy
frontZh: 哪两个因素可以引起一个同位素到 是放射性的？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该两个因素， 可以引起一个同位素到 是放射性的是： 一个 excess 的中子在 该原子核该 原子核被 too heavy

front:
Which types of nuclear decay cause the
isotope to decay into a new element?
back:
An isotope will decay into a new
element if the number of protons
changes. Therefore, alpha and beta
decay will produce a new element.
frontZh: 哪一个类型的 核衰变导致该 同位素到 衰变进入一个 new 元素？
backZh: 一个同位素将会衰变进入一个 new 元素 if 该数量/数目的 质子变化。 因此， α 和 β 衰变将会产生一个 new 元素。

front:
By what value does the mass number
decrease as a result of alpha decay?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
Alpha decay results in the mass
number decreasing by 4, because 4
nucleons are emitted.
frontZh: 由什么数值做/会该 质量数减小 as 一个 result 的 α 衰变？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: α 衰变 results 在该 质量数 decreasing 由 4， 因为 4 nucleons 是发射。

front:
True or False?
In beta decay, a neutron changes into a
proton and an electron. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
True.
A neutron changes into a proton and
an electron during beta decay. The
high-energy electron is emitted from
the nucleus.
frontZh: 判断正误：在 β 衰变， 一个中子变化进入一个质子和 一个电子。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。 一个中子变化进入一个质子和 一个电子在……期间 β 衰变。 该高-能量电子是 发射从 该原子核。

front:
By what value does the atomic number
decrease as a result of alpha decay?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
Alpha decay results in the atomic
number decreasing by 2, because 2
protons are emitted.
frontZh: 由什么数值做/会该 原子序数减小 as 一个 result 的 α 衰变？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: α 衰变 results 在该 原子序数 decreasing 由 2， 因为 2 质子是 发射。

front:
How are the mass and atomic numbers
affected by gamma decay? (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
Gamma decay has no effect on the
mass number or the atomic number.
Gamma radiation reduces the energy
of the nucleus but has no effect on the
number of particles.
frontZh: 如何是 该质量和 atomic numbers affected 由 γ 衰变？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: γ 衰变有 no 效应/影响在 该质量数或 该原子序数。 γ 辐射 reduces 该能量的 该原子核但是有 no 效应/影响在 该数量/数目的 粒子。

front:
By what value does the atomic number
change as a result of beta decay?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
The atomic number increases by 1 as
a result of beta decay. A neutron
changes into a proton and an electron.
The extra proton causes the atomic
number to increase by 1, so a new
element is formed.
frontZh: 由什么数值做/会该 原子序数变化 as 一个 result 的 β 衰变？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该原子序数增大由 1 as 一个 result 的 β 衰变。 一个中子变化进入一个质子和 一个电子。 该 extra 质子导致该 原子序数到 增大由 1， so 一个 new 元素是 形成。

front:
By what value does the charge on a
nucleus decrease when it emits an
alpha particle? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The charge on a nucleus will decrease
by 2 after it emits an alpha particle
because 2 protons are emitted.
frontZh: 由什么数值做/会该 电荷在 一个原子核减小什么时候它 发射一个 α粒子？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该电荷在 一个原子核将会减小由 2 之后它 发射一个 α粒子因为 2 质子是 发射。

front:
By what value does the mass number
decrease as a result of beta decay?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
The mass number remains unchanged
by beta decay. A neutron changes into
a proton which has the same mass. A
beta particle is emitted but this change
in mass is negligible.
frontZh: 由什么数值做/会该 质量数减小 as 一个 result 的 β 衰变？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该质量数保持 unchanged 由 β 衰变。 一个中子变化进入一个质子哪一个有 该相同质量。 一个 β粒子是 发射但是这 变化在 质量是 negligible。

front: Define the term half-life.
back:
Half-life is the time taken for half the
nuclei of a particular isotope in any
sample to decay.
frontZh: 定义该术语半衰期。
backZh: 半衰期是 该所用时间对于/为了一半该 原子核的 一个 particular 同位素在 任何样品到 衰变。

front:
True or False?
The half-life for a particular isotope is
always the same.
back:
True.
Half-life is constant for any particular
isotope.
frontZh: 判断正误：该半衰期对于/为了一个 particular 同位素是 总是该 相同。
backZh: 正确。 半衰期是 恒定对于/为了任何 particular 同位素。

front:
How is the activity of a radioactive
sample affected after one half-life?
back:
The activity of a radioactive sample will
have halved after one half-life
frontZh: ……如何该 活度的 一个放射性的样品 affected 之后一个半衰期？
backZh: 该活度的 一个放射性的样品将会有 halved 之后一个半衰期

front:
True or False?
Half-life is different for different
isotopes.
back:
True.
Half-life is different for different
isotopes.
frontZh: 判断正误：半衰期是 不同对于/为了不同同位素。
backZh: 正确。 半衰期是 不同对于/为了不同同位素。

front:
What is the symbol for activity on a half-
life graph?
back:
The symbol for activity on a half-life
graph is A .
frontZh: 什么是该符号对于/为了活度在 一个一半- life 图像？
backZh: 该符号对于/为了活度在 一个半衰期图像是 一个。

front:
What is the value of the activity of a
radioactive sample after two half-lives?
back:
The value of the activity of a radioactive
sample after two half-lives is 1 of its
4
original value.
frontZh: 什么是该数值的 该活度的 一个放射性的样品之后两个一半-lives？
backZh: 该数值的 该活度的 一个放射性的样品之后两个一半-lives 是 1 4 的它的 original 数值。

front:
What is the symbol for original activity
on a half-life graph?
back:
The symbol for original activity on a
half-life graph is A 0.
frontZh: 什么是该符号对于/为了 original 活度在 一个半衰期图像？
backZh: 该符号对于/为了 original 活度在 一个半衰期图像是 一个0。

front:
How do you determine the half-life of
an isotope on a graph of activity over
time?
back:
To determine the half-life of an isotope
on a graph of activity over time:
identify the point at which the
activity has halved and draw a line
to the curve
track that point down to the time
axis
frontZh: ……如何你 决定该 半衰期的 一个同位素在 一个图像的 活度在……上/超过时间？
backZh: 到决定该 半衰期的 一个同位素在 一个图像的 活度在……上/超过时间： 识别该 点 at 哪一个该 活度有 halved 和 draw 一个线 到该 curve track， 点向下到 该时间轴

front:
What proportion of original nuclei in a
radioactive sample will remain after
three half-lives?
back:
After three half-lives, the proportion of
original nuclei remaining in the sample
will be 1 .
frontZh: 什么 proportion 的 original 原子核在 一个放射性的样品将会 remain 之后三个一半-lives？
backZh: 之后三个一半-lives， 该 proportion 的 original 原子核 remaining 在该 样品将会是 1 8。

front:
When determining the activity of a
radioactive sample, how do you adjust
for background radiation? (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
When determining the activity of a
radioactive sample, the count rate of
the background radiation must be
subtracted from the activity of the
sample.
frontZh: 什么时候 determining 该活度的 一个放射性的样品， ……如何你 adjust 对于/为了本底辐射？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 什么时候 determining 该活度的 一个放射性的样品， 该计数率的 该本底辐射必须是 subtracted 从该 活度的 该样品。

front:
Which type of nuclear radiation is used
in smoke detectors? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
Alpha radiation is used in smoke
detectors.
frontZh: 哪一个类型的 核辐射是 使用在 smoke detectors？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: α 辐射是 使用在 smoke detectors。

front:
Which type of nuclear radiation is used
for measuring and controlling the
thickness of materials? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
Beta radiation is used in measuring and
controlling the thickness of materials.
frontZh: 哪一个类型的 核辐射是 使用对于/为了 measuring 和 controlling 该 thickness 的材料？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: β 辐射是 使用在 measuring 和 controlling 该 thickness 的材料。

front:
Which type of nuclear radiation is used
for irradiating food to kill bacteria?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
Gamma radiation is used for irradiating
food to kill bacteria.
frontZh: 哪一个类型的 核辐射是 使用对于/为了 irradiating food 到 kill bacteria？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: γ 辐射是 使用对于/为了 irradiating food 到 kill bacteria。

front:
Which type of nuclear radiation is used
for sterilising equipment? (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
Gamma radiation is used for sterilising
equipment.
frontZh: 哪一个类型的 核辐射是 使用对于/为了 sterilising equipment？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: γ 辐射是 使用对于/为了 sterilising equipment。

front:
How does a smoke alarm work?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
A smoke alarm works as follows:
alpha particles ionise the air inside
the detector creating a current
the alpha emitter is blocked by the
presence of smoke particles
the alarm is triggered when the
sensor no longer detects alpha
particles
frontZh: ……如何一个 smoke alarm 功？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 一个 smoke alarm works as follows： α粒子 ionise 该空气 inside 该探测器形成一个电流该 α 发射体是 blocked 由该 presence 的 smoke 粒子该 alarm 是 triggered 什么时候该 sensor no 更长 detects α粒子

front:
Why are alpha particles not used to
detect the thickness of materials?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
Alpha particles are stopped by paper,
so they would not penetrate the
material to reach the detector.
frontZh: 为什么是α粒子不 用于 detect 该 thickness 的材料？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: α粒子是 stopped 由纸/试卷， so 它们会 不 penetrate 该材料到 reach 该探测器。

front:
Why is gamma radiation used in the
sterilisation of food and equipment?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
Gamma radiation can penetrate
packaging and objects so all surfaces of
the food or equipment can be
irradiated. Gamma radiation is
ionising enough to kill any
microorganism, therefore it is used for
sterilisation.
frontZh: 为什么 γ 辐射使用在 该 sterilisation 的 food 和 equipment？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: γ 辐射可以 penetrate packaging 和物体 so 所有表面的 该 food 或 equipment 可以是/被 irradiated。 γ 辐射是 电离的 enough 到 kill 任何 microorganism， 因此它 是使用对于/为了 sterilisation。

front:
Why are beta particles used to detect
the thickness of materials? (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
Beta particles can penetrate materials
such as paper and aluminium foil, so
the number of beta particles detected
by a sensor can be used to measure
and control the thickness of the
substance.
frontZh: 为什么是β粒子用于 detect 该 thickness 的材料？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: β粒子可以 penetrate 材料例如/这样的 as 纸/试卷和 aluminium 箔， so 该数量/数目的 β粒子 detected 由一个 sensor 可用于测量和 control 该 thickness 的该 物质。

front:
How is gamma radiation used in the
treatment of cancer? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
Gamma radiation is used in the
treatment of cancer in the process of
radiotherapy. Gamma radiation can
damage cells and tissues so this can be
used to target cancer cells. Gamma rays
can penetrate the body to reach the
cancer cells, but the beams must be
emitted from different angles to reduce
the damage to healthy tissues.
frontZh: ……如何 γ 辐射使用在 该 treatment 的 cancer？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: γ 辐射是 使用在 该 treatment 的 cancer 在该 过程的 radiotherapy。 γ 辐射可以损伤电池和 tissues so 这可用于 target cancer 电池。 γ射线可以 penetrate 物体到 reach 该 cancer 电池， 但是该 beams 必须是 发射从 不同角 到 reduce 该损伤到 healthy tissues。

front:
What are the three effects of ionising
nuclear radiation on living things?
back:
The three effects of ionising nuclear
radiation that you need to know are:
cell death (and therefore tissue
damage)
mutations
cancer
frontZh: 该三个影响的 电离的核辐射在 living things是什么？
backZh: 该三个影响的 电离的核辐射， 需要知道是： 电池 death (和因此 tissue 损伤) mutations cancer

front:
How does ionising radiation cause cell
mutations?
back:
Ionising radiation can remove
electrons from the atoms that make up
DNA and therefore change the
structure of the molecule. A structural
change in DNA can lead to mutated
cells. Mutated cells usually either die or
get destroyed by the immune system,
but some mutations can cause cells to
replicate uncontrollably and lead to
cancer.
frontZh: ……如何电离辐射导致电池 mutations？
backZh: 电离辐射可以 remove 电子从 该原子， make 向上 DNA 和因此变化该 structure 的该 molecule。 一个 structural 变化在 DNA 可以导致/铅到 mutated 电池。 Mutated 电池 usually 任一/两者之一 die 或 get destroyed 由该 immune 系统， 但是 some mutations 可以引起电池到 replicate uncontrollably 和导致/铅到 cancer。

front: How is radioactive waste disposed of?
back:
Radioactive waste is disposed of by:
containing it in marked containers
burying it underground
leaving it undisturbed for
thousands of years
frontZh: ……如何放射性的 waste disposed 的？
backZh: 放射性的 waste 是 disposed 的由： 包含它 在 marked 容器 burying 它 underground leaving 它 undisturbed 对于/为了 thousands 的年 放射性的 samples 应该是 handled

front:
How should radioactive samples be
handled? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
Radioactive samples should be handled
by:
storing the sample encased in lead
using gloves and tongues to move
the sample
wearing protective clothing
keeping the sample at a distance
from the body
minimising the exposure time
washing hands after to avoid
contamination
frontZh: 如何应该放射性的 samples 是 handled？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 放射性的 samples 应该是 handled 由： storing 该样品 encased 在导致/铅使用 gloves 和 tongues 到移动该 样品 wearing protective clothing keeping 该样品 at 一个距离从 物体 minimising 该 exposure 时间 washing hands 之后到 avoid 污染

front:
Define the term dose in relation to
radioactive substances. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
A dose is the amount of radiation
received by a person. It is measured in
sieverts (Sv).
frontZh: 定义术语 dose 在 relation 到放射性的 substances。 （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 一个 dose 是该 量的 辐射 received 由一个人。 它的单位是 sieverts (Sv)。

front:
What could over-exposure to nuclear
radiation lead to?
back:
Over-exposure to nuclear radiation
could lead to radiation poisoning.
frontZh: 什么 could 在……上/超过-exposure 到核辐射导致/铅到？
backZh: 在……上/超过-exposure 到核辐射 could 导致/铅到 辐射 poisoning。

front: What is a dosemeter?
back:
A dosemeter is a device worn by
people who work with radiation that
measures the amount of radiation
received.
frontZh: 什么是一个 dosemeter？
backZh: 一个 dosemeter 是一个装置由……穿着 people 谁功 与辐射， measures 该量 的辐射 received。

True or False?
In Rutherford's experiment, most alpha
particles fired at gold foil passed
straight through. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
Most of the alpha particles passed
straight through the gold foil in
Rutherford's experiment.
frontZh: 判断正误：在卢瑟福's 实验， 大多数 α粒子 fired at 金箔通过直 通过。 （仅拓展内容）

front:
What caused the deflection of some
alpha particles in Rutherford's
Experiment? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
In Rutherford's experiment, the positive
alpha particles were repelled by the
small, dense positive nucleus, which
caused deflection.
frontZh: 什么 caused 该偏转的 some α粒子在 卢瑟福's 实验？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 在卢瑟福's 实验， 该正 α粒子是 repelled 由该 小， 致密正 原子核， 哪一个 caused 偏转。

front:
In Rutherford's experiment, what
observation provided evidence that an
atom has a very small nucleus
surrounded by mostly empty space?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
The observation which provided
evidence that an atom has a very small
nucleus surrounded by mostly empty
space was that most alpha particles
passed straight through the gold foil
undeflected.
frontZh: 在卢瑟福's 实验， 什么 observation provided 证据， 一个原子有 一个非常小 原子核 surrounded 由 mostly empty 太空？ （仅拓展内容）
backZh: 该 observation 哪一个 provided 证据， 一个原子有 一个非常小 原子核 surrounded 由 mostly empty 太空是， 大多数 α粒子通过直 通过该 金箔 undeflected。

front:
True or False?
An atom is neutral because it has an
equal number of protons and neutrons.
back:
False.
An atom is neutral because it has an
equal number of protons and
